namespace InternHub.Tests.AI.Evaluation.Running.Manual;

/// <summary>Fact that is skipped unless INTERNHUB_AI_EVAL=1, so the real run is opt-in.</summary>
public sealed class ManualEvaluationFactAttribute : FactAttribute
{
    public const string EnableVariable = "INTERNHUB_AI_EVAL";

    public ManualEvaluationFactAttribute()
    {
        var reason = SkipReasonFor(Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable(EnableVariable));

        if (reason is not null)
            Skip = reason;
    }

    public static string? SkipReasonFor(string? value) =>
        value == "1"
            ? null
            : $"Manual AI evaluation: set {EnableVariable}=1 to run it.";
}


===== tests\InternHub.Tests\AI\Evaluation\Running\Manual\ManualEvaluationSettings.cs =====

using System.Globalization;
using InternHub.Tests.AI.Evaluation.Running;

namespace InternHub.Tests.AI.Evaluation.Running.Manual;

public sealed record ManualEvaluationSettings(
    string? OllamaEndpoint,
    string? OllamaModel,
    int RunsPerCase,
    string Temperature,
    string PromptVersion,
    string Commit,
    string RunDate)
{
    public const int DefaultRunsPerCase = 5;
    public const string NotSet = "not set";

    public static ManualEvaluationSettings FromEnvironment() =>
        FromEnvironment(Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable);

    public static ManualEvaluationSettings FromEnvironment(Func<string, string?> read)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(read);

        return new ManualEvaluationSettings(
            read("INTERNHUB_AI_EVAL_OLLAMA_ENDPOINT"),
            read("INTERNHUB_AI_EVAL_OLLAMA_MODEL"),
            ParseRuns(read("INTERNHUB_AI_EVAL_RUNS")),
            ContextValue(read("INTERNHUB_AI_EVAL_TEMPERATURE")),
            ContextValue(read("INTERNHUB_AI_EVAL_PROMPT_VERSION")),
            ContextValue(read("INTERNHUB_AI_EVAL_COMMIT")),
            ContextValue(read("INTERNHUB_AI_EVAL_DATE")));
    }

    private static int ParseRuns(string? value)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value))
            return DefaultRunsPerCase;

        return int.TryParse(value, NumberStyles.None, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out var runs) && runs >= 1
            ? runs
            : throw new EvaluationSetupException(
                $"INTERNHUB_AI_EVAL_RUNS must be a whole number of at least 1, but was '{value}'.");
    }

    private static string ContextValue(string? value) =>
        string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value) ? NotSet : value.Trim();
}


===== tests\InternHub.Tests\AI\Evaluation\Running\Manual\ManualEvaluationTests.cs =====

using FluentAssertions;
using InternHub.Api.Infrastructure.AI.Baseline;
using InternHub.Api.Infrastructure.AI.Ollama;
using InternHub.Tests.AI.Evaluation.Dataset;
using InternHub.Tests.AI.Evaluation.Running;
using InternHub.Tests.AI.Evaluation.Running.Outcomes;
using InternHub.Tests.AI.Evaluation.Running.Reporting;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
using Xunit.Abstractions;

namespace InternHub.Tests.AI.Evaluation.Running.Manual;

public sealed class ManualEvaluationTests(ITestOutputHelper output)
{
    private static readonly TimeSpan OllamaTimeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(120);

    [ManualEvaluationFact]
    public async Task Given_KeywordBaseline_When_RunningManualEvaluation_Then_WritesReport()
    {
        // Arrange
        var settings = ManualEvaluationSettings.FromEnvironment();
        var context = BaselineContext(settings);
        var service = new KeywordRecruiterEvaluationService();
        var runner = new EvaluationRunner(new OutcomeClassifier());

        // Act
        var report = await runner.RunAsync(
            EvaluationDatasetLoader.Load(),
            service,
            new Dictionary<string, string?>(),
            context);
        var path = WriteReport(report);

        // Assert
        File.Exists(path).Should().BeTrue();
    }

    [ManualEvaluationFact]
    public async Task Given_OllamaProvider_When_RunningManualEvaluation_Then_WritesReport()
    {
        // Arrange
        var settings = ManualEvaluationSettings.FromEnvironment();
        var requiredSettings = OllamaSettings(settings);
        var configuration = new ConfigurationBuilder().AddInMemoryCollection(requiredSettings).Build();
        using var httpClient = new HttpClient { Timeout = OllamaTimeout };
        var service = new OllamaRecruiterEvaluationService(httpClient, configuration);
        var runner = new EvaluationRunner(new OutcomeClassifier());

        // Act
        var report = await runner.RunAsync(
            EvaluationDatasetLoader.Load(),
            service,
            requiredSettings,
            OllamaContext(settings));
        var path = WriteReport(report);

        // Assert
        File.Exists(path).Should().BeTrue();
    }

    private static EvaluationRunContext BaselineContext(ManualEvaluationSettings settings) =>
        new("keyword-baseline", "n/a", "n/a", "n/a", 1, settings.RunDate, settings.Commit);

    private static EvaluationRunContext OllamaContext(ManualEvaluationSettings settings) =>
        new(
            "ollama",
            settings.OllamaModel ?? ManualEvaluationSettings.NotSet,
            settings.Temperature,
            settings.PromptVersion,
            settings.RunsPerCase,
            settings.RunDate,
            settings.Commit);

    private static Dictionary<string, string?> OllamaSettings(ManualEvaluationSettings settings) =>
        new()
        {
            ["Ai:Ollama:Endpoint"] = settings.OllamaEndpoint,
            ["Ai:Ollama:Model"] = settings.OllamaModel
        };

    private string WriteReport(EvaluationRunReport report)
    {
        var markdown = MarkdownReportWriter.Write(report);
        var path = Path.Combine(AppContext.BaseDirectory, MarkdownReportWriter.FileName(report.Context));
        File.WriteAllText(path, markdown);
        output.WriteLine(markdown);
        output.WriteLine($"Report written to {path}");

        return path;
    }
}


===== tests\InternHub.Tests\AI\Evaluation\Running\Outcomes\OutcomeClassifier.cs =====

using InternHub.Api.Features.RecruiterEvaluation;

namespace InternHub.Tests.AI.Evaluation.Running.Outcomes;

public sealed class OutcomeClassifier
{
    private static readonly IReadOnlyDictionary<Type, OutcomeKind> ExceptionKinds =
        new Dictionary<Type, OutcomeKind>
        {
            [typeof(InvalidOperationException)] = OutcomeKind.InvalidResponse,
            [typeof(HttpRequestException)] = OutcomeKind.InfrastructureUnavailable,
            [typeof(TaskCanceledException)] = OutcomeKind.InfrastructureUnavailable
        };

    public OutcomeKind ClassifyResult(RecruiterEvaluationResult? result)
    {
        var valid =
            result is not null &&
            result.MatchedSkills is not null &&
            result.MissingSkills is not null &&
            result.Suggestions is not null &&
            !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(result.Summary);

        return valid ? OutcomeKind.Success : OutcomeKind.InvalidResponse;
    }
    
    public bool TryClassify(Exception exception, CancellationToken callerToken, out OutcomeKind kind)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(exception);

        kind = default;
        var cancelledByCaller = exception is OperationCanceledException && callerToken.IsCancellationRequested;

        return !cancelledByCaller && ExceptionKinds.TryGetValue(exception.GetType(), out kind);
    }
}

===== tests\InternHub.Tests\AI\Evaluation\Running\Reporting\MarkdownReportWriter.cs =====

using System.Globalization;
using System.Text;
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;
using InternHub.Tests.AI.Evaluation.Metrics.Aggregation;
using InternHub.Tests.AI.Evaluation.Metrics.Strategies;
using InternHub.Tests.AI.Evaluation.Running.Outcomes;

namespace InternHub.Tests.AI.Evaluation.Running.Reporting;

/// <summary>Writes a run report as Markdown with only case ids, categories, context values and numbers; never CV or provider-generated text.</summary>
public static class MarkdownReportWriter
{
    private static readonly string[] MicroMacroMetricNames =
    [
        "Matched precision",
        "Matched recall",
        "Matched F1",
        "Missing precision",
        "Missing recall",
        "Missing F1"
    ];

    private static readonly IReadOnlyDictionary<string, Func<AggregateScores, double>> MicroValues =
        new Dictionary<string, Func<AggregateScores, double>>
        {
            ["Matched precision"] = scores => scores.Micro["Matched"].Precision,
            ["Matched recall"] = scores => scores.Micro["Matched"].Recall,
            ["Matched F1"] = scores => scores.Micro["Matched"].F1,
            ["Missing precision"] = scores => scores.Micro["Missing"].Precision,
            ["Missing recall"] = scores => scores.Micro["Missing"].Recall,
            ["Missing F1"] = scores => scores.Micro["Missing"].F1
        };

    public static string Write(EvaluationRunReport report)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(report);

        var markdown = new StringBuilder();
        WriteContext(markdown, report.Context);
        WriteOutcomes(markdown, report);
        WriteAggregate(markdown, report.Aggregate);
        WriteStability(markdown, report);
        WriteCategories(markdown, report);
        WriteNonSuccessCalls(markdown, report);

        return markdown.ToString();
    }

    public static string FileName(EvaluationRunContext context)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(context);

        return $"ai-evaluation-{Sanitize(context.Provider)}-{Sanitize(context.Model)}.md";
    }

    private static void WriteContext(StringBuilder markdown, EvaluationRunContext context)
    {
        markdown.AppendLine($"# AI evaluation report: {context.Provider} / {context.Model}");
        markdown.AppendLine();
        markdown.AppendLine("## Run context");
        markdown.AppendLine();
        markdown.AppendLine("| Field | Value |");
        markdown.AppendLine("|---|---|");
        markdown.AppendLine($"| Provider | {context.Provider} |");
        markdown.AppendLine($"| Model | {context.Model} |");
        markdown.AppendLine($"| Temperature | {context.Temperature} |");
        markdown.AppendLine($"| Prompt version | {context.PromptVersion} |");
        markdown.AppendLine($"| Runs per case (K) | {context.RunsPerCase.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)} |");
        markdown.AppendLine($"| Date | {context.RunDate} |");
        markdown.AppendLine($"| Commit | {context.Commit} |");
        markdown.AppendLine();
    }

    private static void WriteOutcomes(StringBuilder markdown, EvaluationRunReport report)
    {
        markdown.AppendLine("## Outcomes");
        markdown.AppendLine();
        markdown.AppendLine("| Outcome | Calls |");
        markdown.AppendLine("|---|---|");

        foreach (var kind in Enum.GetValues<OutcomeKind>())
            markdown.AppendLine($"| {kind} | {report.OutcomeCounts[kind].ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)} |");

        markdown.AppendLine($"| Total | {report.TotalCalls.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)} |");
        markdown.AppendLine();
        markdown.AppendLine($"- Valid-response rate (calls that reached the model): {Format(report.ValidResponseRate)}");
        markdown.AppendLine($"- Unavailability rate (all calls): {Format(report.UnavailabilityRate)}");
        markdown.AppendLine("- Provider-internal retries are invisible to the evaluator: all rates are measured after them.");

        if (report.StoppedAfterFirstUnavailableCall)
        {
            markdown.AppendLine();
            markdown.AppendLine(
                "> **Run stopped:** the first call ended in InfrastructureUnavailable, so no further calls were made. " +
                "Check that the service is reachable and run again.");
        }

        markdown.AppendLine();
    }

    private static void WriteAggregate(StringBuilder markdown, AggregateScores? aggregate)
    {
        markdown.AppendLine("## Aggregate metrics");
        markdown.AppendLine();

        if (aggregate is null)
        {
            markdown.AppendLine("No successful outcomes; metrics were not computed.");
            markdown.AppendLine();
            return;
        }

        markdown.AppendLine($"Computed over {aggregate.CaseCount.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)} successful result(s).");
        markdown.AppendLine();
        markdown.AppendLine("| Metric | Micro | Macro |");
        markdown.AppendLine("|---|---|---|");

        foreach (var name in MicroMacroMetricNames)
            markdown.AppendLine($"| {name} | {Format(MicroValues[name](aggregate))} | {Format(aggregate.Macro[name])} |");

        markdown.AppendLine();
        markdown.AppendLine("### Extended metrics (macro)");
        markdown.AppendLine();
        markdown.AppendLine("| Metric | Macro |");
        markdown.AppendLine("|---|---|");

        foreach (var metric in aggregate.Macro.Where(metric => !MicroValues.ContainsKey(metric.Key)))
            markdown.AppendLine($"| {metric.Key} | {Format(metric.Value)} |");

        markdown.AppendLine();
    }

    private static void WriteStability(StringBuilder markdown, EvaluationRunReport report)
    {
        markdown.AppendLine("## Stability");
        markdown.AppendLine();

        if (report.Stability is null)
        {
            markdown.AppendLine(
                $"Not computed (K = {report.Context.RunsPerCase.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)}; " +
                "needs K >= 2 and at least two successful runs of a case).");
            markdown.AppendLine();
            return;
        }

        markdown.AppendLine(
            $"Mean pairwise Jaccard similarity over {report.StabilityCaseCount.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)} case(s).");
        markdown.AppendLine();
        markdown.AppendLine("| List | Stability |");
        markdown.AppendLine("|---|---|");
        markdown.AppendLine($"| Matched | {Format(report.Stability.Matched)} |");
        markdown.AppendLine($"| Missing | {Format(report.Stability.Missing)} |");
        markdown.AppendLine();
    }

    private static void WriteCategories(StringBuilder markdown, EvaluationRunReport report)
    {
        markdown.AppendLine("## Per category");
        markdown.AppendLine();

        if (report.ByCategory.Count == 0)
        {
            markdown.AppendLine("No successful outcomes.");
            markdown.AppendLine();
            return;
        }

        var metricNames = CaseMetrics.Default.Select(metric => metric.Name).ToList();
        markdown.AppendLine(
            $"| Category | Results | Matched F1 (micro) | Missing F1 (micro) | {string.Join(" | ", metricNames)} |");
        markdown.AppendLine($"|---|---|---|---|{string.Concat(metricNames.Select(_ => "---|"))}");

        foreach (var category in report.ByCategory.OrderBy(entry => entry.Key))
        {
            var scores = category.Value;
            var macroValues = metricNames.Select(name => Format(scores.Macro[name]));
            markdown.AppendLine(
                $"| {category.Key} | {scores.CaseCount.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)} | " +
                $"{Format(scores.Micro["Matched"].F1)} | {Format(scores.Micro["Missing"].F1)} | " +
                $"{string.Join(" | ", macroValues)} |");
        }

        markdown.AppendLine();
    }

    private static void WriteNonSuccessCalls(StringBuilder markdown, EvaluationRunReport report)
    {
        markdown.AppendLine("## Non-success calls");
        markdown.AppendLine();

        var failures = report.Outcomes.Where(outcome => outcome.Kind != OutcomeKind.Success).ToList();

        if (failures.Count == 0)
        {
            markdown.AppendLine("None.");
            return;
        }

        markdown.AppendLine("| Case | Category | Run | Outcome |");
        markdown.AppendLine("|---|---|---|---|");

        foreach (var failure in failures)
            markdown.AppendLine(
                $"| {failure.CaseId} | {failure.Category} | {failure.Run.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)} | {failure.Kind} |");
    }

    private static string Format(double? value) =>
        value?.ToString("0.0000", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) ?? "n/a";

    private static string Sanitize(string value) =>
        Regex.Replace(value.Trim().ToLowerInvariant(), "[^a-z0-9.]+", "-").Trim('-');
}


===== tests\InternHub.Tests\AI\Evaluation\Running\EvaluationRunner.cs =====

using InternHub.Api.Features.RecruiterEvaluation;
using InternHub.Tests.AI.Evaluation.Dataset;
using InternHub.Tests.AI.Evaluation.Metrics.Aggregation;
using InternHub.Tests.AI.Evaluation.Metrics.Core;
using InternHub.Tests.AI.Evaluation.Metrics.Stability;
using InternHub.Tests.AI.Evaluation.Metrics.Strategies;
using InternHub.Tests.AI.Evaluation.Running.Outcomes;
using InternHub.Tests.AI.Evaluation.Running.Reporting;

namespace InternHub.Tests.AI.Evaluation.Running;

public sealed class EvaluationRunner
{
    private readonly OutcomeClassifier _classifier;

    public EvaluationRunner(OutcomeClassifier classifier)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(classifier);
        _classifier = classifier;
    }

    public async Task<EvaluationRunReport> RunAsync(
        EvaluationDataset dataset,
        IRecruiterEvaluationService service,
        IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string?> requiredSettings,
        EvaluationRunContext context,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(dataset);
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(service);
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(requiredSettings);
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(context);

        EnsureConfigured(requiredSettings);

        if (context.RunsPerCase < 1)
            throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(context), context.RunsPerCase, "RunsPerCase must be at least 1.");

        var outcomes = new List<ProviderRunOutcome>();

        foreach (var evaluationCase in dataset.Cases)
        {
            for (var run = 1; run <= context.RunsPerCase; run++)
            {
                var outcome = await RunOnceAsync(service, evaluationCase, run, cancellationToken);
                outcomes.Add(outcome);

                if (outcomes.Count == 1 && outcome.Kind == OutcomeKind.InfrastructureUnavailable)
                    return BuildReport(dataset, context, outcomes, stoppedAfterFirstUnavailableCall: true);
            }
        }

        return BuildReport(dataset, context, outcomes, stoppedAfterFirstUnavailableCall: false);
    }

    private static void EnsureConfigured(IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string?> requiredSettings)
    {
        var missingKeys = requiredSettings
            .Where(setting => string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(setting.Value))
            .Select(setting => setting.Key)
            .ToList();

        if (missingKeys.Count > 0)
            throw new EvaluationSetupException(
                $"Evaluation setup is incomplete. Missing configuration value(s): {string.Join(", ", missingKeys)}. No provider call was made.");
    }

    private async Task<ProviderRunOutcome> RunOnceAsync(
        IRecruiterEvaluationService service,
        EvaluationCase evaluationCase,
        int run,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        try
        {
            var result = await service.AnalyzeAsync(
                evaluationCase.CvText,
                evaluationCase.RequirementsText,
                cancellationToken);
            var resultKind = _classifier.ClassifyResult(result);

            return new ProviderRunOutcome(
                evaluationCase.Id,
                evaluationCase.Category,
                run,
                resultKind,
                resultKind == OutcomeKind.Success ? result : null);
        }
        catch (Exception exception) when (_classifier.TryClassify(exception, cancellationToken, out var exceptionKind))
        {
            return new ProviderRunOutcome(evaluationCase.Id, evaluationCase.Category, run, exceptionKind, null);
        }
    }

    private static EvaluationRunReport BuildReport(
        EvaluationDataset dataset,
        EvaluationRunContext context,
        IReadOnlyList<ProviderRunOutcome> outcomes,
        bool stoppedAfterFirstUnavailableCall)
    {
        var counts = Enum.GetValues<OutcomeKind>()
            .ToDictionary(kind => kind, kind => outcomes.Count(outcome => outcome.Kind == kind));

        var reachedModel = counts[OutcomeKind.Success] + counts[OutcomeKind.InvalidResponse];
        double? validResponseRate = reachedModel == 0
            ? null
            : (double)counts[OutcomeKind.Success] / reachedModel;
        var unavailabilityRate = Ratio.Divide(counts[OutcomeKind.InfrastructureUnavailable], outcomes.Count, 0);

        var casesById = dataset.Cases.ToDictionary(evaluationCase => evaluationCase.Id);
        var successes = outcomes
            .Where(outcome => outcome.Kind == OutcomeKind.Success)
            .Select(outcome => (Case: casesById[outcome.CaseId], Result: outcome.Result!))
            .ToList();

        var normalizer = new SkillNormalizer(dataset.Aliases);
        var aggregator = new MetricAggregator(CaseMetrics.Default, [SkillList.Matched, SkillList.Missing], normalizer);
        AggregateScores? aggregate = successes.Count == 0 ? null : aggregator.Aggregate(successes);
        var byCategory = new CategoryBreakdown(aggregator).Aggregate(successes);

        var repeatedCases = successes
            .Where(_ => context.RunsPerCase >= 2)
            .GroupBy(pair => pair.Case.Id)
            .Where(group => group.Count() >= 2)
            .Select(group => (IReadOnlyList<RecruiterEvaluationResult>)group.Select(pair => pair.Result).ToList())
            .ToList();
        StabilityScores? stability = repeatedCases.Count == 0
            ? null
            : new StabilityCalculator(normalizer).MeanOverCases(repeatedCases);

        return new EvaluationRunReport(
            context,
            outcomes.Count,
            counts,
            validResponseRate,
            unavailabilityRate,
            stoppedAfterFirstUnavailableCall,
            aggregate,
            byCategory,
            stability,
            repeatedCases.Count,
            outcomes.ToList());
    }
}

===== tests\InternHub.Tests\Integration\Infrastructure\InternHubSqliteFactory.cs =====

using InternHub.Api.Infrastructure.Persistence;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Hosting;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.Testing;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.TestHost;
using Microsoft.Data.Sqlite;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Infrastructure;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection.Extensions;

namespace InternHub.Tests.Integration.Infrastructure;

public sealed class InternHubSqliteFactory : WebApplicationFactory<Program>
{
    private readonly SqliteConnection _connection;
    private readonly TimeProvider _timeProvider;
    private readonly bool _useSeparateConnections;
    private readonly string? _sharedMemoryConnectionString;
    private readonly Action<IServiceCollection>? _configureTestServices;

    public InternHubSqliteFactory(
        TimeProvider? timeProvider = null,
        bool useSeparateConnections = false,
        Action<IServiceCollection>? configureTestServices = null)
    {
        _timeProvider = timeProvider ?? TimeProvider.System;
        _useSeparateConnections = useSeparateConnections;
        _configureTestServices = configureTestServices;
        _sharedMemoryConnectionString = useSeparateConnections
            ? new SqliteConnectionStringBuilder
            {
                DataSource = $"InternHub-{Guid.NewGuid():N}",
                Mode = SqliteOpenMode.Memory,
                Cache = SqliteCacheMode.Shared,
                DefaultTimeout = 1,
                Pooling = false
            }.ToString()
            : null;
        _connection = new SqliteConnection(
            _sharedMemoryConnectionString ?? "Data Source=:memory:");
        _connection.Open();
    }

    protected override void ConfigureWebHost(IWebHostBuilder builder)
    {
        builder.UseEnvironment("Testing");
        builder.ConfigureTestServices(services =>
        {
            services.RemoveAll<DbContextOptions<InternHubDbContext>>();
            services.RemoveAll<IDbContextOptionsConfiguration<InternHubDbContext>>();
            services.AddDbContext<InternHubDbContext>(options =>
            {
                if (_useSeparateConnections)
                    options.UseSqlite(_sharedMemoryConnectionString!);
                else
                    options.UseSqlite(_connection);
            });
            services.RemoveAll<TimeProvider>();
            services.AddSingleton(_timeProvider);
            _configureTestServices?.Invoke(services);
        });
    }

    protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
    {
        base.Dispose(disposing);

        if (disposing)
            _connection.Dispose();
    }
}

using System.Net;
using System.Net.Http.Json;
using FluentAssertions;
using InternHub.Api.Domain.InternshipCandidacies;

    private static readonly DateTime Now =
        new(2027, 1, 15, 12, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_EligibleStudentAndOpenOffer_When_Applying_Then_ReturnsCreatedAndPersistsSubmittedCandidacy()
    {
        // Arrange
        using var factory = new InternHubSqliteFactory(new FixedTimeProvider(Now));
        using var client = factory.CreateClient();
        var student = CreateStudent();
        var offer = CreateOffer(Now.AddDays(1));
        await SeedAsync(factory, [student], [offer]);
        var request = new CreateInternshipCandidacyRequest(student.Id, offer.Id);

        // Act
        using var response = await client.PostAsJsonAsync("/api/v1/candidacies", request);

        // Assert
        response.StatusCode.Should().Be(HttpStatusCode.Created);
        var body = await response.Content.ReadFromJsonAsync<CreateInternshipCandidacyResponse>();
        body.Should().NotBeNull();
        body!.Id.Should().NotBeEmpty();
        body.StudentId.Should().Be(student.Id);
        body.OfferId.Should().Be(offer.Id);
        body.ApplicationDate.Should().Be(Now);
        body.Status.Should().Be(InternshipCandidacyStatus.Submitted);
        response.Headers.Location.Should().NotBeNull();
        response.Headers.Location!.ToString().Should().Be($"/api/v1/candidacies/{body.Id}");

        using var verificationScope = factory.Services.CreateScope();
        var verificationDb = verificationScope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<InternHubDbContext>();
        var persisted = await verificationDb.InternshipCandidacies.AsNoTracking()
            .SingleAsync(item => item.Id == body.Id);
        persisted.StudentId.Should().Be(student.Id);
        persisted.OfferId.Should().Be(offer.Id);
        persisted.ApplicationDate.Should().Be(Now);
        persisted.Status.Should().Be(InternshipCandidacyStatus.Submitted);
    }

    [Fact]

    {

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_FiveActiveCandidacies_When_ApplyingToAnotherOffer_Then_ReturnsConflictAndDoesNotAddRows()
    {
        // Arrange
        using var factory = new InternHubSqliteFactory(new FixedTimeProvider(Now));
        using var client = factory.CreateClient();
        var student = CreateStudent();
        var activeOffers = Enumerable.Range(0, 5)
            .Select(_ => CreateOffer(Now.AddDays(1)))
            .ToArray();
        var requestedOffer = CreateOffer(Now.AddDays(1));
        var activeCandidacies = activeOffers
            .Select((offer, index) => CreateCandidacy(
                student.Id,
                offer.Id,
                Now.AddDays(-index - 1),
                InternshipCandidacyStatus.Submitted))
            .ToArray();
        await SeedAsync(factory, [student], activeOffers.Append(requestedOffer).ToArray(), activeCandidacies);

        // Act
        using var response = await client.PostAsJsonAsync(
            "/api/v1/candidacies",
            new CreateInternshipCandidacyRequest(student.Id, requestedOffer.Id));

        // Assert
        response.StatusCode.Should().Be(HttpStatusCode.Conflict);
        (await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync()).Should().Contain("maximum of 5 active candidacies");

        using var verificationScope = factory.Services.CreateScope();
        var verificationDb = verificationScope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<InternHubDbContext>();
        (await verificationDb.InternshipCandidacies.AsNoTracking().CountAsync()).Should().Be(5);
        (await verificationDb.InternshipCandidacies.AsNoTracking()
            .Select(item => item.Id).ToArrayAsync())
            .Should().BeEquivalentTo(activeCandidacies.Select(item => item.Id));
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_FourActiveCandidaciesAndTwoConcurrentApplications_When_Applying_Then_OnlyOneReachesTheFiveActiveLimit()
    {
        // Arrange
        using var factory = new InternHubSqliteFactory(
            new FixedTimeProvider(Now),
            useSeparateConnections: true);
        using var client = factory.CreateClient();
        var student = CreateStudent();
        var existingOffers = Enumerable.Range(0, 4)
            .Select(_ => CreateOffer(Now.AddDays(1)))
            .ToArray();
        var requestedOffers = Enumerable.Range(0, 2)
            .Select(_ => CreateOffer(Now.AddDays(1)))
            .ToArray();
        var existingCandidacies = existingOffers
            .Select((offer, index) => CreateCandidacy(
                student.Id,
                offer.Id,
                Now.AddDays(-index - 1),
                InternshipCandidacyStatus.Submitted))
            .ToArray();
        await SeedAsync(
            factory,
            [student],
            [.. existingOffers, .. requestedOffers],
            existingCandidacies);
        var firstRequest = client.PostAsJsonAsync(
            "/api/v1/candidacies",
            new CreateInternshipCandidacyRequest(student.Id, requestedOffers[0].Id));
        var secondRequest = client.PostAsJsonAsync(
            "/api/v1/candidacies",
            new CreateInternshipCandidacyRequest(student.Id, requestedOffers[1].Id));

        // Act
        var responses = await Task.WhenAll(firstRequest, secondRequest);
        using var firstResponse = responses[0];
        using var secondResponse = responses[1];

        // Assert
        responses.Select(response => response.StatusCode)
            .Should().BeEquivalentTo(
                [HttpStatusCode.Created, HttpStatusCode.Conflict]);
        var createdResponse = responses.Single(
            response => response.StatusCode == HttpStatusCode.Created);
        var conflictResponse = responses.Single(
            response => response.StatusCode == HttpStatusCode.Conflict);
        (await conflictResponse.Content.ReadAsStringAsync())
            .Should().Contain("maximum of 5 active candidacies");
        var created = await createdResponse.Content
            .ReadFromJsonAsync<CreateInternshipCandidacyResponse>();
        created.Should().NotBeNull();
        created!.StudentId.Should().Be(student.Id);
        requestedOffers.Select(offer => offer.Id).Should().Contain(created.OfferId);
        created.Status.Should().Be(InternshipCandidacyStatus.Submitted);
        createdResponse.Headers.Location.Should().NotBeNull();
        createdResponse.Headers.Location!.ToString()
            .Should().Be($"/api/v1/candidacies/{created.Id}");

        using var verificationScope = factory.Services.CreateScope();
        var verificationDb =
            verificationScope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<InternHubDbContext>();
        var studentCandidacies = await verificationDb.InternshipCandidacies
            .AsNoTracking()
            .Where(item => item.StudentId == student.Id)
            .ToArrayAsync();
        var activeCandidacies = studentCandidacies
            .Where(item => item.IsActive)
            .ToArray();
        activeCandidacies.Should().HaveCount(5);
        activeCandidacies.Select(item => item.Id)
            .Should().Contain(existingCandidacies.Select(item => item.Id));
        activeCandidacies.Where(item =>
                requestedOffers.Select(offer => offer.Id).Contains(item.OfferId))
            .Should().ContainSingle()
            .Which.Id.Should().Be(created.Id);
    }

    private static Student CreateStudent() =>
        new(Guid.NewGuid(), "Integration Student", $"student-{Guid.NewGuid():N}@example.test");

    private static Offer CreateOffer(DateTime deadline) =>
        new("Software Intern", "Example Company", ".NET", deadline, 1);

    private static InternshipCandidacy CreateCandidacy(
        Guid studentId,
        Guid offerId,
        DateTime applicationDate,
        InternshipCandidacyStatus status) =>
        new(Guid.NewGuid(), studentId, offerId, applicationDate, status);

    private static async Task SeedAsync(
        InternHubSqliteFactory factory,
        IReadOnlyCollection<Student> students,
        IReadOnlyCollection<Offer> offers,
        IReadOnlyCollection<InternshipCandidacy>? candidacies = null)
    {
        using var scope = factory.Services.CreateScope();
        var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<InternHubDbContext>();
        db.Students.AddRange(students);
        db.Offers.AddRange(offers);

        if (candidacies is not null)
            db.InternshipCandidacies.AddRange(candidacies);

        await db.SaveChangesAsync();
    }

    private sealed class FixedTimeProvider(DateTime utcNow) : TimeProvider
    {
        public override DateTimeOffset GetUtcNow() => new(utcNow);
    }
}


===== tests\InternHub.Tests\Integration\InternshipCandidacies\DecideInternshipCandidacy\DecideInternshipCandidacyEndpointTests.cs =====

using System.Net;
using System.Net.Http.Json;
using FluentAssertions;
using InternHub.Api.Domain.InternshipCandidacies;
using InternHub.Api.Domain.Offers;
using InternHub.Api.Features.InternshipCandidacies.DecideInternshipCandidacy;
using InternHub.Api.Infrastructure.Persistence;
using InternHub.Domain.Students;
using InternHub.Tests.Integration.Infrastructure;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;

namespace InternHub.Tests.Integration.InternshipCandidacies.DecideInternshipCandidacy;

[Collection("Integration")]
public sealed class DecideInternshipCandidacyEndpointTests
{
    private static readonly DateTime ApplicationDate =
        new(2027, 1, 15, 12, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_SubmittedCandidacy_When_Shortlisting_Then_ReturnsOkAndPersistsShortlisted()
    {
        // Arrange
        using var factory = new InternHubSqliteFactory();
        using var client = factory.CreateClient();
        var student = CreateStudent();
        var offer = CreateOffer(maximumAvailableSlots: 1);
        var candidacy = CreateCandidacy(student.Id, offer.Id, InternshipCandidacyStatus.Submitted);
        await SeedAsync(factory, [student], [offer], [candidacy]);

        // Act
        using var response = await PostDecisionAsync(client, candidacy.Id, "Shortlist");

        // Assert
        response.StatusCode.Should().Be(HttpStatusCode.OK);
        (await response.Content.ReadFromJsonAsync<DecideInternshipCandidacyResponse>())
            .Should().Be(new DecideInternshipCandidacyResponse(
                candidacy.Id,
                InternshipCandidacyStatus.Shortlisted));
        (await ReadStatusAsync(factory, candidacy.Id)).Should().Be(InternshipCandidacyStatus.Shortlisted);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_SubmittedCandidacyAndFreeSlot_When_Accepting_Then_ReturnsOkAndPersistsAccepted()
    {
        // Arrange
        using var factory = new InternHubSqliteFactory();
        using var client = factory.CreateClient();
        var student = CreateStudent();
        var offer = CreateOffer(maximumAvailableSlots: 1);
        var candidacy = CreateCandidacy(student.Id, offer.Id, InternshipCandidacyStatus.Submitted);
        await SeedAsync(factory, [student], [offer], [candidacy]);

        // Act
        using var response = await PostDecisionAsync(client, candidacy.Id, "Accept");

        // Assert
        response.StatusCode.Should().Be(HttpStatusCode.OK);
        (await response.Content.ReadFromJsonAsync<DecideInternshipCandidacyResponse>())
            .Should().Be(new DecideInternshipCandidacyResponse(
                candidacy.Id,
                InternshipCandidacyStatus.Accepted));
        (await ReadStatusAsync(factory, candidacy.Id)).Should().Be(InternshipCandidacyStatus.Accepted);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_AcceptedCountReachedMaximumSlots_When_Accepting_Then_ReturnsOkAndPersistsWaitlisted()
    {
        // Arrange
        using var factory = new InternHubSqliteFactory();
        using var client = factory.CreateClient();
        var acceptedStudent = CreateStudent();
        var student = CreateStudent();
        var offer = CreateOffer(maximumAvailableSlots: 1);
        var accepted = CreateCandidacy(acceptedStudent.Id, offer.Id, InternshipCandidacyStatus.Accepted);
        var candidacy = CreateCandidacy(student.Id, offer.Id, InternshipCandidacyStatus.Submitted);
        await SeedAsync(factory, [acceptedStudent, student], [offer], [accepted, candidacy]);

        // Act
        using var response = await PostDecisionAsync(client, candidacy.Id, "Accept");

        // Assert
        response.StatusCode.Should().Be(HttpStatusCode.OK);
        (await response.Content.ReadFromJsonAsync<DecideInternshipCandidacyResponse>())
            .Should().Be(new DecideInternshipCandidacyResponse(
                candidacy.Id,
                InternshipCandidacyStatus.Waitlisted));
        (await ReadStatusAsync(factory, candidacy.Id)).Should().Be(InternshipCandidacyStatus.Waitlisted);

        using var verificationScope = factory.Services.CreateScope();
        var verificationDb = verificationScope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<InternHubDbContext>();
        (await verificationDb.InternshipCandidacies.AsNoTracking()
            .CountAsync(item => item.OfferId == offer.Id && item.Status == InternshipCandidacyStatus.Accepted))
            .Should().Be(1);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_ClosedOffer_When_Accepting_Then_ReturnsOkAndPersistsAccepted()
    {
        // Arrange
        using var factory = new InternHubSqliteFactory();
        using var client = factory.CreateClient();
        var student = CreateStudent();
        var offer = CreateOffer(maximumAvailableSlots: 1);
        offer.Close();
        var candidacy = CreateCandidacy(student.Id, offer.Id, InternshipCandidacyStatus.Shortlisted);
        await SeedAsync(factory, [student], [offer], [candidacy]);

        // Act
        using var response = await PostDecisionAsync(client, candidacy.Id, "Accept");

        // Assert
        response.StatusCode.Should().Be(HttpStatusCode.OK);
        (await response.Content.ReadFromJsonAsync<DecideInternshipCandidacyResponse>())
            .Should().Be(new DecideInternshipCandidacyResponse(
                candidacy.Id,
                InternshipCandidacyStatus.Accepted));
        (await ReadStatusAsync(factory, candidacy.Id)).Should().Be(InternshipCandidacyStatus.Accepted);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_NumericAction_When_Deciding_Then_ReturnsBadRequestAndPreservesStatus()
    {
        // Arrange
        using var factory = new InternHubSqliteFactory();
        using var client = factory.CreateClient();
        var student = CreateStudent();
        var offer = CreateOffer(maximumAvailableSlots: 1);
        var candidacy = CreateCandidacy(student.Id, offer.Id, InternshipCandidacyStatus.Submitted);
        await SeedAsync(factory, [student], [offer], [candidacy]);

        // Act
        using var response = await PostDecisionAsync(client, candidacy.Id, "1");

        // Assert
        response.StatusCode.Should().Be(HttpStatusCode.BadRequest);
        (await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync())
            .Should().Contain("Action '1' is not valid.");
        (await ReadStatusAsync(factory, candidacy.Id)).Should().Be(InternshipCandidacyStatus.Submitted);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_MissingCandidacy_When_Deciding_Then_ReturnsNotFoundAndCreatesNoCandidacy()
    {
        // Arrange
        using var factory = new InternHubSqliteFactory();
        using var client = factory.CreateClient();
        var candidacyId = Guid.NewGuid();

        // Act
        using var response = await PostDecisionAsync(client, candidacyId, "Accept");

        // Assert
        response.StatusCode.Should().Be(HttpStatusCode.NotFound);
        (await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync())
            .Should().Contain($"Candidacy {candidacyId} not found.");

        using var verificationScope = factory.Services.CreateScope();
        var verificationDb = verificationScope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<InternHubDbContext>();
        (await verificationDb.InternshipCandidacies.AsNoTracking().CountAsync()).Should().Be(0);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_RejectedCandidacy_When_Accepting_Then_ReturnsConflictAndPreservesStatus()
    {
        // Arrange
        using var factory = new InternHubSqliteFactory();
        using var client = factory.CreateClient();
        var student = CreateStudent();
        var offer = CreateOffer(maximumAvailableSlots: 1);
        var candidacy = CreateCandidacy(student.Id, offer.Id, InternshipCandidacyStatus.Rejected);
        await SeedAsync(factory, [student], [offer], [candidacy]);

        // Act
        using var response = await PostDecisionAsync(client, candidacy.Id, "Accept");

        // Assert
        response.StatusCode.Should().Be(HttpStatusCode.Conflict);
        (await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync())
            .Should().Contain($"Candidacy {candidacy.Id} cannot be accepted from its current status.");
        (await ReadStatusAsync(factory, candidacy.Id)).Should().Be(InternshipCandidacyStatus.Rejected);
    }

    private static Task<HttpResponseMessage> PostDecisionAsync(
        HttpClient client,
        Guid candidacyId,
        string action) =>
        client.PostAsJsonAsync(
            $"/api/v1/candidacies/{candidacyId}/decision",
            new DecideInternshipCandidacyRequest(action));

    private static async Task<InternshipCandidacyStatus> ReadStatusAsync(
        InternHubSqliteFactory factory,
        Guid candidacyId)
    {
        using var scope = factory.Services.CreateScope();
        var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<InternHubDbContext>();

        return await db.InternshipCandidacies.AsNoTracking()
            .Where(candidacy => candidacy.Id == candidacyId)
            .Select(candidacy => candidacy.Status)
            .SingleAsync();
    }

    private static Student CreateStudent() =>
        new(Guid.NewGuid(), "Integration Student", $"student-{Guid.NewGuid():N}@example.test");

    private static Offer CreateOffer(int maximumAvailableSlots) =>
        new("Offer", "Company", ".NET", ApplicationDate.AddDays(10), maximumAvailableSlots);

    private static InternshipCandidacy CreateCandidacy(
        Guid studentId,
        Guid offerId,
        InternshipCandidacyStatus status) =>
        new(Guid.NewGuid(), studentId, offerId, ApplicationDate, status);

    private static async Task SeedAsync(
        InternHubSqliteFactory factory,
        IReadOnlyCollection<Student> students,
        IReadOnlyCollection<Offer> offers,
        IReadOnlyCollection<InternshipCandidacy> candidacies)
    {
        using var scope = factory.Services.CreateScope();
        var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<InternHubDbContext>();
        db.Students.AddRange(students);
        db.Offers.AddRange(offers);
        db.InternshipCandidacies.AddRange(candidacies);

        await db.SaveChangesAsync();
    }
}


===== tests\InternHub.Tests\Integration\InternshipCandidacies\GetInternshipCandidacyById\GetInternshipCandidacyByIdEndpointTests.cs =====

using System.Net;
using System.Net.Http.Json;
using FluentAssertions;
using InternHub.Api.Domain.InternshipCandidacies;
using InternHub.Api.Domain.Offers;
using InternHub.Api.Features.InternshipCandidacies.GetInternshipCandidacyById;
using InternHub.Api.Infrastructure.Persistence;
using InternHub.Domain.Students;
using InternHub.Tests.Integration.Infrastructure;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;

namespace InternHub.Tests.Integration.InternshipCandidacies.GetInternshipCandidacyById;

[Collection("Integration")]
public sealed class GetInternshipCandidacyByIdEndpointTests
{
    private static readonly DateTime ApplicationDate =
        new(2027, 1, 15, 0, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);

    private static readonly DateTime Deadline =
        new(2027, 2, 15, 0, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_ExistingCandidacy_When_GettingById_Then_ReturnsCandidacyAndPreservesDatabaseState()
    {
        // Arrange
        using var factory = new InternHubSqliteFactory();
        using var client = factory.CreateClient();
        var student = new Student(
            Guid.NewGuid(),
            "Integration Student",
            $"integration-{Guid.NewGuid():N}@example.com");
        var offer = new Offer(
            "Backend Intern",
            "Example Company",
            "C#, Git",
            Deadline,
            2);
        var candidacy = new InternshipCandidacy(
            Guid.NewGuid(),
            student.Id,
            offer.Id,
            ApplicationDate,
            InternshipCandidacyStatus.Shortlisted);
        await SeedAsync(factory, student, offer, candidacy);

        // Act
        using var response = await client.GetAsync(
            $"/api/v1/candidacies/{candidacy.Id}");
        var body = await response.Content.ReadFromJsonAsync<GetInternshipCandidacyByIdResponse>();

        // Assert
        response.StatusCode.Should().Be(HttpStatusCode.OK);
        body.Should().BeEquivalentTo(new GetInternshipCandidacyByIdResponse(
            candidacy.Id,
            student.Id,
            offer.Id,
            ApplicationDate,
            InternshipCandidacyStatus.Shortlisted));

        using var scope = factory.Services.CreateScope();
        var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<InternHubDbContext>();
        var persisted = await db.InternshipCandidacies
            .AsNoTracking()
            .SingleAsync(item => item.Id == candidacy.Id);
        persisted.Should().BeEquivalentTo(candidacy);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_MissingCandidacy_When_GettingById_Then_ReturnsNotFoundAndLeavesDatabaseUnchanged()
    {
        // Arrange
        using var factory = new InternHubSqliteFactory();
        using var client = factory.CreateClient();
        var candidacyId = Guid.NewGuid();

        // Act
        using var response = await client.GetAsync(
            $"/api/v1/candidacies/{candidacyId}");
        var error = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();

        // Assert
        response.StatusCode.Should().Be(HttpStatusCode.NotFound);
        error.Should().Contain($"Internship candidacy {candidacyId} was not found.");

        using var scope = factory.Services.CreateScope();
        var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<InternHubDbContext>();
        (await db.InternshipCandidacies.AsNoTracking().CountAsync()).Should().Be(0);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_ExistingCandidacy_When_GettingById_Then_DoesNotModifyPersistedCandidacy()
    {
        // Arrange
        using var factory = new InternHubSqliteFactory();
        using var client = factory.CreateClient();
        var student = new Student(
            Guid.NewGuid(),
            "Read Only Student",
            $"readonly-{Guid.NewGuid():N}@example.com");
        var offer = new Offer(
            "Data Intern",
            "Example Company",
            "SQL, C#",
            Deadline,
            1);
        var candidacy = new InternshipCandidacy(
            Guid.NewGuid(),
            student.Id,
            offer.Id,
            ApplicationDate,
            InternshipCandidacyStatus.Submitted);
        await SeedAsync(factory, student, offer, candidacy);

        // Act
        using var response = await client.GetAsync(
            $"/api/v1/candidacies/{candidacy.Id}");

        // Assert
        response.StatusCode.Should().Be(HttpStatusCode.OK);
        using var scope = factory.Services.CreateScope();
        var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<InternHubDbContext>();
        var persisted = await db.InternshipCandidacies
            .AsNoTracking()
            .SingleAsync(item => item.Id == candidacy.Id);
        persisted.Id.Should().Be(candidacy.Id);
        persisted.StudentId.Should().Be(candidacy.StudentId);
        persisted.OfferId.Should().Be(candidacy.OfferId);
        persisted.ApplicationDate.Should().Be(candidacy.ApplicationDate);
        persisted.Status.Should().Be(candidacy.Status);
    }

    private static async Task SeedAsync(
        InternHubSqliteFactory factory,
        Student student,
        Offer offer,
        InternshipCandidacy candidacy)
    {
        using var scope = factory.Services.CreateScope();
        var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<InternHubDbContext>();
        db.Students.Add(student);
        db.Offers.Add(offer);
        db.InternshipCandidacies.Add(candidacy);
        await db.SaveChangesAsync();
    }
}

===== tests\InternHub.Tests\Integration\InternshipCandidacies\GetOfferCandidacies\GetOfferCandidaciesEndpointTests.cs =====

using System.Net;
using System.Net.Http.Json;
using FluentAssertions;
using InternHub.Api.Domain.InternshipCandidacies;
using InternHub.Api.Domain.Offers;
using InternHub.Api.Features.InternshipCandidacies.GetOfferCandidacies;
using InternHub.Api.Infrastructure.Persistence;
using InternHub.Domain.Students;
using InternHub.Tests.Integration.Infrastructure;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;

namespace InternHub.Tests.Integration.InternshipCandidacies.GetOfferCandidacies;

[Collection("Integration")]
public sealed class GetOfferCandidaciesEndpointTests
{
    private static readonly DateTime Now =
        new(2027, 1, 15, 12, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_OfferWithCandidacies_When_Getting_Then_ReturnsOnlyThatOfferNewestFirstWithStudentNames()
    {
        // Arrange
        using var factory = new InternHubSqliteFactory();
        using var client = factory.CreateClient();
        var olderStudent = CreateStudent("Older Student");
        var newerStudent = CreateStudent("Newer Student");
        var offer = CreateOffer();
        var otherOffer = CreateOffer();
        var older = CreateCandidacy(olderStudent.Id, offer.Id, Now.AddDays(-1));
        var newer = CreateCandidacy(newerStudent.Id, offer.Id, Now);
        var otherOfferCandidacy = CreateCandidacy(olderStudent.Id, otherOffer.Id, Now.AddDays(1));
        await SeedAsync(
            factory,
            [olderStudent, newerStudent],
            [offer, otherOffer],
            [older, otherOfferCandidacy, newer]);

        // Act
        using var response = await client.GetAsync($"/api/v1/offers/{offer.Id}/candidacies");

        // Assert
        response.StatusCode.Should().Be(HttpStatusCode.OK);
        var body = await response.Content.ReadFromJsonAsync<GetOfferCandidaciesResponse[]>();
        body.Should().Equal(
            new GetOfferCandidaciesResponse(
                newer.Id,
                newerStudent.Id,
                "Newer Student",
                Now,
                InternshipCandidacyStatus.Submitted),
            new GetOfferCandidaciesResponse(
                older.Id,
                olderStudent.Id,
                "Older Student",
                Now.AddDays(-1),
                InternshipCandidacyStatus.Submitted));

        using var verificationScope = factory.Services.CreateScope();
        var verificationDb = verificationScope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<InternHubDbContext>();
        (await verificationDb.InternshipCandidacies.AsNoTracking().CountAsync()).Should().Be(3);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_OfferWithoutCandidacies_When_Getting_Then_ReturnsEmptyList()
    {
        // Arrange
        using var factory = new InternHubSqliteFactory();
        using var client = factory.CreateClient();
        var offer = CreateOffer();
        await SeedAsync(factory, [], [offer], []);

        // Act
        using var response = await client.GetAsync($"/api/v1/offers/{offer.Id}/candidacies");

        // Assert
        response.StatusCode.Should().Be(HttpStatusCode.OK);
        (await response.Content.ReadFromJsonAsync<GetOfferCandidaciesResponse[]>())
            .Should().BeEmpty();
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_MissingOffer_When_Getting_Then_ReturnsNotFoundAndCreatesNoRows()
    {
        // Arrange
        using var factory = new InternHubSqliteFactory();
        using var client = factory.CreateClient();
        var offerId = Guid.NewGuid();

        // Act
        using var response = await client.GetAsync($"/api/v1/offers/{offerId}/candidacies");

        // Assert
        response.StatusCode.Should().Be(HttpStatusCode.NotFound);
        (await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync()).Should().Contain($"Offer {offerId} not found.");

        using var verificationScope = factory.Services.CreateScope();
        var verificationDb = verificationScope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<InternHubDbContext>();
        (await verificationDb.Students.AsNoTracking().CountAsync()).Should().Be(0);
        (await verificationDb.Offers.AsNoTracking().CountAsync()).Should().Be(0);
        (await verificationDb.InternshipCandidacies.AsNoTracking().CountAsync()).Should().Be(0);
    }

    private static Student CreateStudent(string fullName) =>
        new(Guid.NewGuid(), fullName, $"student-{Guid.NewGuid():N}@example.test");

    private static Offer CreateOffer() =>
        new("Offer", "Company", ".NET", Now.AddDays(10), 1);

    private static InternshipCandidacy CreateCandidacy(
        Guid studentId,
        Guid offerId,
        DateTime applicationDate) =>
        new(
            Guid.NewGuid(),
            studentId,
            offerId,
            applicationDate,
            InternshipCandidacyStatus.Submitted);

    private static async Task SeedAsync(
        InternHubSqliteFactory factory,
        IReadOnlyCollection<Student> students,
        IReadOnlyCollection<Offer> offers,
        IReadOnlyCollection<InternshipCandidacy> candidacies)
    {

        db.Students.AddRange(students);
        db.Offers.AddRange(offers);
        db.InternshipCandidacies.AddRange(candidacies);

    }
