===== tests\InternHub.Tests\Integration\InternshipCandidacies\GetStudentCandidacies\GetStudentCandidaciesEndpointTests.cs =====

using System.Net;
using System.Net.Http.Json;
using FluentAssertions;
using InternHub.Api.Domain.InternshipCandidacies;
using InternHub.Api.Domain.Offers;
using InternHub.Api.Features.InternshipCandidacies.GetStudentCandidacies;
using InternHub.Api.Infrastructure.Persistence;
using InternHub.Domain.Students;
using InternHub.Tests.Integration.Infrastructure;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;

namespace InternHub.Tests.Integration.InternshipCandidacies.GetStudentCandidacies;

[Collection("Integration")]
public sealed class GetStudentCandidaciesEndpointTests
{
    private static readonly DateTime Now =
        new(2027, 1, 15, 12, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_StudentWithCandidacies_When_GettingCandidacies_Then_ReturnsNewestFirstWithOfferDetails()
    {
        // Arrange
        using var factory = new InternHubSqliteFactory(new FixedTimeProvider(Now));
        using var client = factory.CreateClient();
        var student = CreateStudent();
        var olderOffer = CreateOffer("Older Offer", "Older Company");
        var newerOffer = CreateOffer("Newer Offer", "Newer Company");
        var olderCandidacy = CreateCandidacy(student.Id, olderOffer.Id, Now.AddDays(-1));
        var newerCandidacy = CreateCandidacy(student.Id, newerOffer.Id, Now);
        await SeedAsync(factory, [student], [olderOffer, newerOffer], [olderCandidacy, newerCandidacy]);

        // Act
        using var response = await client.GetAsync($"/api/v1/students/{student.Id}/candidacies");

        // Assert
        response.StatusCode.Should().Be(HttpStatusCode.OK);
        var body = await response.Content.ReadFromJsonAsync<GetStudentCandidaciesResponse[]>();
        body.Should().NotBeNull();
        body.Should().HaveCount(2);
        body![0].Id.Should().Be(newerCandidacy.Id);
        body[0].OfferId.Should().Be(newerOffer.Id);
        body[0].OfferTitle.Should().Be("Newer Offer");
        body[0].CompanyName.Should().Be("Newer Company");
        body[0].ApplicationDate.Should().Be(Now);
        body[0].Status.Should().Be(InternshipCandidacyStatus.Submitted);
        body[1].Id.Should().Be(olderCandidacy.Id);
        body[1].OfferTitle.Should().Be("Older Offer");
        body[1].CompanyName.Should().Be("Older Company");
        body[1].ApplicationDate.Should().Be(Now.AddDays(-1));

        using var verificationScope = factory.Services.CreateScope();
        var verificationDb = verificationScope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<InternHubDbContext>();
        (await verificationDb.InternshipCandidacies.AsNoTracking().CountAsync()).Should().Be(2);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_StudentWithoutCandidacies_When_GettingCandidacies_Then_ReturnsEmptyList()
    {
        // Arrange
        using var factory = new InternHubSqliteFactory(new FixedTimeProvider(Now));
        using var client = factory.CreateClient();
        var student = CreateStudent();
        await SeedAsync(factory, [student], []);

        // Act
        using var response = await client.GetAsync($"/api/v1/students/{student.Id}/candidacies");

        // Assert
        response.StatusCode.Should().Be(HttpStatusCode.OK);
        (await response.Content.ReadFromJsonAsync<GetStudentCandidaciesResponse[]>())
            .Should().BeEmpty();

        using var verificationScope = factory.Services.CreateScope();
        var verificationDb = verificationScope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<InternHubDbContext>();
        (await verificationDb.InternshipCandidacies.AsNoTracking().CountAsync()).Should().Be(0);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_MissingStudent_When_GettingCandidacies_Then_ReturnsNotFound()
    {
        // Arrange
        using var factory = new InternHubSqliteFactory(new FixedTimeProvider(Now));
        using var client = factory.CreateClient();
        var studentId = Guid.NewGuid();

        // Act
        using var response = await client.GetAsync($"/api/v1/students/{studentId}/candidacies");

        // Assert
        response.StatusCode.Should().Be(HttpStatusCode.NotFound);
        (await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync()).Should().Contain($"Student {studentId} not found.");

        using var verificationScope = factory.Services.CreateScope();
        var verificationDb = verificationScope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<InternHubDbContext>();
        (await verificationDb.Students.AsNoTracking().CountAsync()).Should().Be(0);
        (await verificationDb.InternshipCandidacies.AsNoTracking().CountAsync()).Should().Be(0);
    }

    private static Student CreateStudent() =>
        new(Guid.NewGuid(), "Integration Student", $"student-{Guid.NewGuid():N}@example.test");

    private static Offer CreateOffer(string title, string companyName) =>
        new(title, companyName, ".NET", Now.AddDays(10), 1);

    private static InternshipCandidacy CreateCandidacy(
        Guid studentId,
        Guid offerId,
        DateTime applicationDate) =>
        new(
            Guid.NewGuid(),
            studentId,
            offerId,
            applicationDate,
            InternshipCandidacyStatus.Submitted);

    private static async Task SeedAsync(
        InternHubSqliteFactory factory,
        IReadOnlyCollection<Student> students,
        IReadOnlyCollection<Offer> offers,
        IReadOnlyCollection<InternshipCandidacy>? candidacies = null)
    {
        using var scope = factory.Services.CreateScope();
        var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<InternHubDbContext>();
        db.Students.AddRange(students);
        db.Offers.AddRange(offers);

        if (candidacies is not null)
            db.InternshipCandidacies.AddRange(candidacies);

        await db.SaveChangesAsync();
    }

    private sealed class FixedTimeProvider(DateTime utcNow) : TimeProvider
    {
        public override DateTimeOffset GetUtcNow() => new(utcNow);
    }
}


===== tests\InternHub.Tests\Integration\InternshipCandidacies\GetStudentCandidacySummary\GetStudentCandidacySummaryEndpointTests.cs =====

using System.Net;
using System.Net.Http.Json;
using FluentAssertions;
using InternHub.Api.Domain.InternshipCandidacies;
using InternHub.Api.Domain.Offers;
using InternHub.Api.Features.InternshipCandidacies.GetStudentCandidacySummary;
using InternHub.Api.Infrastructure.Persistence;
using InternHub.Domain.Students;
using InternHub.Tests.Integration.Infrastructure;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;

namespace InternHub.Tests.Integration.InternshipCandidacies.GetStudentCandidacySummary;

[Collection("Integration")]
public sealed class GetStudentCandidacySummaryEndpointTests
{
    private static readonly DateTime ApplicationDate =
        new(2027, 1, 15, 12, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);

    private static readonly DateTime Deadline =
        new(2027, 2, 15, 12, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_StudentWithAllStatuses_When_GettingSummary_Then_ReturnsAllCounts()
    {
        // Arrange
        using var factory = new InternHubSqliteFactory();
        using var client = factory.CreateClient();
        var student = CreateStudent();
        var statuses = new[]
        {
            InternshipCandidacyStatus.Submitted,
            InternshipCandidacyStatus.Shortlisted,
            InternshipCandidacyStatus.Accepted,
            InternshipCandidacyStatus.Rejected,
            InternshipCandidacyStatus.Waitlisted,
            InternshipCandidacyStatus.Withdrawn
        };
        var offers = statuses.Select((_, index) =>
                CreateOffer($"Offer {index}", $"Company {index}"))
            .ToArray();
        var candidacies = statuses
            .Select((status, index) =>
                CreateCandidacy(student.Id, offers[index].Id, status))
            .ToArray();
        await SeedAsync(factory, [student], offers, candidacies);

        // Act
        using var response = await client.GetAsync(
            $"/api/v1/students/{student.Id}/candidacies/summary");
        var body = await response.Content.ReadFromJsonAsync<GetStudentCandidacySummaryResponse>();

        // Assert
        response.StatusCode.Should().Be(HttpStatusCode.OK);
        body.Should().BeEquivalentTo(new GetStudentCandidacySummaryResponse(
            student.Id,
            6,
            4,
            1,
            1,
            1,
            1,
            1,
            1));
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_StudentWithoutCandidacies_When_GettingSummary_Then_ReturnsZeroCounts()
    {
        // Arrange
        using var factory = new InternHubSqliteFactory();
        using var client = factory.CreateClient();
        var student = CreateStudent();
        await SeedAsync(factory, [student], []);

        // Act
        using var response = await client.GetAsync(
            $"/api/v1/students/{student.Id}/candidacies/summary");
        var body = await response.Content.ReadFromJsonAsync<GetStudentCandidacySummaryResponse>();

        // Assert
        response.StatusCode.Should().Be(HttpStatusCode.OK);
        body.Should().BeEquivalentTo(new GetStudentCandidacySummaryResponse(
            student.Id,
            0,
            0,
            0,
            0,
            0,
            0,
            0,
            0));
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_MissingStudent_When_GettingSummary_Then_ReturnsNotFound()
    {
        // Arrange
        using var factory = new InternHubSqliteFactory();
        using var client = factory.CreateClient();
        var studentId = Guid.NewGuid();

        // Act
        using var response = await client.GetAsync(
            $"/api/v1/students/{studentId}/candidacies/summary");
        var error = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();

        // Assert
        response.StatusCode.Should().Be(HttpStatusCode.NotFound);
        error.Should().Contain($"Student {studentId} not found.");

        using var verificationScope = factory.Services.CreateScope();
        var verificationDb =
            verificationScope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<InternHubDbContext>();
        (await verificationDb.Students.AsNoTracking().CountAsync()).Should().Be(0);
        (await verificationDb.InternshipCandidacies.AsNoTracking().CountAsync()).Should().Be(0);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_CandidaciesForMultipleStudents_When_GettingSummary_Then_ReturnsOnlyRequestedStudentAndPreservesState()
    {
        // Arrange
        using var factory = new InternHubSqliteFactory();
        using var client = factory.CreateClient();
        var student = CreateStudent();
        var otherStudent = CreateStudent();
        var studentOffer = CreateOffer("Requested Offer", "Requested Company");
        var otherOffer = CreateOffer("Other Offer", "Other Company");
        var studentCandidacy = CreateCandidacy(
            student.Id,
            studentOffer.Id,
            InternshipCandidacyStatus.Accepted);
        var otherCandidacy = CreateCandidacy(
            otherStudent.Id,
            otherOffer.Id,
            InternshipCandidacyStatus.Submitted);
        await SeedAsync(
            factory,
            [student, otherStudent],
            [studentOffer, otherOffer],
            [studentCandidacy, otherCandidacy]);

        // Act
        using var response = await client.GetAsync(
            $"/api/v1/students/{student.Id}/candidacies/summary");
        var body = await response.Content.ReadFromJsonAsync<GetStudentCandidacySummaryResponse>();

        // Assert
        response.StatusCode.Should().Be(HttpStatusCode.OK);
        body.Should().BeEquivalentTo(new GetStudentCandidacySummaryResponse(
            student.Id,
            1,
            1,
            0,
            0,
            1,
            0,
            0,
            0));

        using var verificationScope = factory.Services.CreateScope();
        var verificationDb =
            verificationScope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<InternHubDbContext>();
        var persistedCandidacies = await verificationDb.InternshipCandidacies
            .AsNoTracking()
            .OrderBy(item => item.Id)
            .ToArrayAsync();
        persistedCandidacies.Should().HaveCount(2);
        persistedCandidacies.Should().ContainEquivalentOf(studentCandidacy);
        persistedCandidacies.Should().ContainEquivalentOf(otherCandidacy);
        persistedCandidacies.Single(item => item.Id == studentCandidacy.Id).Status
            .Should().Be(InternshipCandidacyStatus.Accepted);
        persistedCandidacies.Single(item => item.Id == otherCandidacy.Id).Status
            .Should().Be(InternshipCandidacyStatus.Submitted);
    }

    private static Student CreateStudent() =>
        new(
            Guid.NewGuid(),
            "Integration Student",
            $"student-{Guid.NewGuid():N}@example.test");

    private static Offer CreateOffer(string title, string companyName) =>
        new(title, companyName, ".NET, SQL", Deadline, 1);

    private static InternshipCandidacy CreateCandidacy(
        Guid studentId,
        Guid offerId,
        InternshipCandidacyStatus status) =>
        new(
            Guid.NewGuid(),
            studentId,
            offerId,
            ApplicationDate,
            status);

    private static async Task SeedAsync(
        InternHubSqliteFactory factory,
        IReadOnlyCollection<Student> students,
        IReadOnlyCollection<Offer> offers,
        IReadOnlyCollection<InternshipCandidacy>? candidacies = null)
    {
        using var scope = factory.Services.CreateScope();
        var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<InternHubDbContext>();
        db.Students.AddRange(students);
        db.Offers.AddRange(offers);

        if (candidacies is not null)
            db.InternshipCandidacies.AddRange(candidacies);

        await db.SaveChangesAsync();
    }
}


===== tests\InternHub.Tests\Integration\InternshipCandidacies\WithdrawInternshipCandidacy\WithdrawInternshipCandidacyEndpointTests.cs =====

using System.Net;
using FluentAssertions;
using InternHub.Api.Domain.InternshipCandidacies;
using InternHub.Api.Domain.Offers;
using InternHub.Api.Infrastructure.Persistence;
using InternHub.Domain.Students;
using InternHub.Tests.Integration.Infrastructure;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;

namespace InternHub.Tests.Integration.InternshipCandidacies.WithdrawInternshipCandidacy;

[Collection("Integration")]
public sealed class WithdrawInternshipCandidacyEndpointTests
{
    private static readonly DateTime ApplicationDate =
        new(2027, 1, 15, 12, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);

    [Theory]
    [InlineData(InternshipCandidacyStatus.Submitted)]
    [InlineData(InternshipCandidacyStatus.Shortlisted)]
    public async Task Given_OpenCandidacy_When_Withdrawing_Then_ReturnsNoContentAndPersistsWithdrawn(
        InternshipCandidacyStatus initialStatus)
    {
        // Arrange
        using var factory = new InternHubSqliteFactory();
        using var client = factory.CreateClient();
        var student = CreateStudent();
        var offer = CreateOffer();
        var candidacy = CreateCandidacy(student.Id, offer.Id, initialStatus);
        await SeedAsync(factory, student, offer, candidacy);

        // Act
        using var response = await client.PostAsync(
            $"/api/v1/candidacies/{candidacy.Id}/withdraw",
            content: null);

        // Assert
        response.StatusCode.Should().Be(HttpStatusCode.NoContent);
        (await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync()).Should().BeEmpty();
        (await ReadStatusAsync(factory, candidacy.Id)).Should().Be(InternshipCandidacyStatus.Withdrawn);
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData(InternshipCandidacyStatus.Accepted)]
    [InlineData(InternshipCandidacyStatus.Rejected)]
    [InlineData(InternshipCandidacyStatus.Waitlisted)]
    [InlineData(InternshipCandidacyStatus.Withdrawn)]
    public async Task Given_FinalCandidacy_When_Withdrawing_Then_ReturnsConflictAndPreservesStatus(
        InternshipCandidacyStatus finalStatus)
    {
        // Arrange
        using var factory = new InternHubSqliteFactory();
        using var client = factory.CreateClient();
        var student = CreateStudent();
        var offer = CreateOffer();
        var candidacy = CreateCandidacy(student.Id, offer.Id, finalStatus);
        await SeedAsync(factory, student, offer, candidacy);

        // Act
        using var response = await client.PostAsync(
            $"/api/v1/candidacies/{candidacy.Id}/withdraw",
            content: null);
        var error = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();

        // Assert
        response.StatusCode.Should().Be(HttpStatusCode.Conflict);
        error.Should().Contain(
            $"Candidacy {candidacy.Id} cannot be withdrawn from status {finalStatus}.");
        (await ReadStatusAsync(factory, candidacy.Id)).Should().Be(finalStatus);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_MissingCandidacy_When_Withdrawing_Then_ReturnsNotFoundAndLeavesDatabaseUnchanged()
    {
        // Arrange
        using var factory = new InternHubSqliteFactory();
        using var client = factory.CreateClient();
        var candidacyId = Guid.NewGuid();

        // Act
        using var response = await client.PostAsync(
            $"/api/v1/candidacies/{candidacyId}/withdraw",
            content: null);
        var error = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();

        // Assert
        response.StatusCode.Should().Be(HttpStatusCode.NotFound);
        error.Should().Contain($"Candidacy {candidacyId} not found.");

        using var scope = factory.Services.CreateScope();
        var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<InternHubDbContext>();
        (await db.InternshipCandidacies.AsNoTracking().CountAsync()).Should().Be(0);
    }

    private static Student CreateStudent() =>
        new(Guid.NewGuid(), "Integration Student", $"student-{Guid.NewGuid():N}@example.test");

    private static Offer CreateOffer() =>
        new("Software Intern", "Example Company", ".NET", ApplicationDate.AddDays(10), 1);

    private static InternshipCandidacy CreateCandidacy(
        Guid studentId,
        Guid offerId,
        InternshipCandidacyStatus status) =>
        new(Guid.NewGuid(), studentId, offerId, ApplicationDate, status);

    private static async Task SeedAsync(
        InternHubSqliteFactory factory,
        Student student,
        Offer offer,
        InternshipCandidacy candidacy)
    {
        using var scope = factory.Services.CreateScope();
        var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<InternHubDbContext>();
        db.Students.Add(student);
        db.Offers.Add(offer);
        db.InternshipCandidacies.Add(candidacy);
        await db.SaveChangesAsync();
    }

    private static async Task<InternshipCandidacyStatus> ReadStatusAsync(
        InternHubSqliteFactory factory,
        Guid candidacyId)
    {
        using var scope = factory.Services.CreateScope();
        var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<InternHubDbContext>();

        return await db.InternshipCandidacies
            .AsNoTracking()
            .Where(item => item.Id == candidacyId)
            .Select(item => item.Status)
            .SingleAsync();
    }
}


===== tests\InternHub.Tests\Integration\Offers\CloseOffer\CloseOfferEndpointTests.cs =====

using System.Net;
using System.Net.Http.Json;
using FluentAssertions;
using InternHub.Api.Domain.InternshipCandidacies;
using InternHub.Api.Infrastructure.Persistence;
using InternHub.Domain.Students;
using InternHub.Tests.Integration.Infrastructure;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;

namespace InternHub.Tests.Integration.Offers.CloseOffer;

[Collection("Integration")]
public sealed class CloseOfferEndpointTests
{
    private static readonly DateTime Deadline =
        new(2027, 1, 15, 0, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_ExistingOpenOffer_When_ClosingOffer_Then_ReturnsNoContentAndPersistsClosedOfferWithSingleVersionIncrement()
    {
        // Arrange
        using var factory = new InternHubSqliteFactory();
        using var client = factory.CreateClient();
        var offer = await CreateOffer(client);

        // Act
        using var response = await client.PostAsync(
            $"/api/v1/offers/{offer.Id}/close",
            content: null);

        // Assert
        response.StatusCode.Should().Be(HttpStatusCode.NoContent);
        (await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync()).Should().BeEmpty();

        using var scope = factory.Services.CreateScope();
        var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<InternHubDbContext>();
        var persisted = await db.Offers.AsNoTracking()
            .SingleAsync(item => item.Id == offer.Id);
        persisted.IsClosed.Should().BeTrue();
        persisted.Version.Should().Be(offer.Version + 1);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_AlreadyClosedOffer_When_ClosingOfferAgain_Then_ReturnsNoContentAndPreservesVersion()
    {
        // Arrange
        using var factory = new InternHubSqliteFactory();
        using var client = factory.CreateClient();
        var offer = await CreateOffer(client);
        using var firstResponse = await client.PostAsync(
            $"/api/v1/offers/{offer.Id}/close",
            content: null);
        firstResponse.StatusCode.Should().Be(HttpStatusCode.NoContent);

        // Act
        using var response = await client.PostAsync(
            $"/api/v1/offers/{offer.Id}/close",
            content: null);

        // Assert
        response.StatusCode.Should().Be(HttpStatusCode.NoContent);
        (await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync()).Should().BeEmpty();

        using var scope = factory.Services.CreateScope();
        var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<InternHubDbContext>();
        var persisted = await db.Offers.AsNoTracking()
            .SingleAsync(item => item.Id == offer.Id);
        persisted.IsClosed.Should().BeTrue();
        persisted.Version.Should().Be(offer.Version + 1);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_MissingOffer_When_ClosingOffer_Then_ReturnsNotFoundAndLeavesDatabaseUnchanged()
    {
        // Arrange
        using var factory = new InternHubSqliteFactory();
        using var client = factory.CreateClient();
        var offerId = Guid.NewGuid();

        // Act
        using var response = await client.PostAsync(
            $"/api/v1/offers/{offerId}/close",
            content: null);

        // Assert
        response.StatusCode.Should().Be(HttpStatusCode.NotFound);
        (await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync())
            .Should().Contain($"Offer {offerId} not found.");

        using var scope = factory.Services.CreateScope();
        var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<InternHubDbContext>();
        (await db.Offers.AsNoTracking().CountAsync()).Should().Be(0);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_OpenOfferWithExistingFieldsAndCandidacy_When_ClosingOffer_Then_PreservesFieldsAndCandidacy()
    {
        // Arrange
        using var factory = new InternHubSqliteFactory();
        using var client = factory.CreateClient();
        var offer = await CreateOffer(client);
        var student = new Student(
            Guid.NewGuid(),
            "Intern Hub Student",
            $"student-{Guid.NewGuid():N}@example.com");
        var candidacy = new InternshipCandidacy(
            Guid.NewGuid(),
            student.Id,
            offer.Id,
            new DateTime(2026, 10, 1, 0, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc),
            InternshipCandidacyStatus.Submitted);
        using (var seedScope = factory.Services.CreateScope())
        {
            var seedDb = seedScope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<InternHubDbContext>();
            seedDb.Students.Add(student);
            seedDb.InternshipCandidacies.Add(candidacy);
            await seedDb.SaveChangesAsync();
        }

        // Act
        using var response = await client.PostAsync(
            $"/api/v1/offers/{offer.Id}/close",
            content: null);

        // Assert
        response.StatusCode.Should().Be(HttpStatusCode.NoContent);

        using var scope = factory.Services.CreateScope();
        var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<InternHubDbContext>();
        var persistedOffer = await db.Offers.AsNoTracking()
            .SingleAsync(item => item.Id == offer.Id);
        persistedOffer.Title.Should().Be(offer.Title);
        persistedOffer.CompanyName.Should().Be(offer.CompanyName);
        persistedOffer.Requirements.Should().Be(offer.Requirements);
        persistedOffer.Deadline.Should().Be(offer.Deadline);
        persistedOffer.MaximumAvailableSlots.Should().Be(offer.MaximumAvailableSlots);
        persistedOffer.IsClosed.Should().BeTrue();
        persistedOffer.Version.Should().Be(offer.Version + 1);

        var persistedCandidacy = await db.InternshipCandidacies.AsNoTracking()
            .SingleAsync(item => item.Id == candidacy.Id);
        persistedCandidacy.Should().BeEquivalentTo(candidacy);
    }

    private static async Task<OfferResponse> CreateOffer(HttpClient client)
    {
        var request = new
        {
            title = "Backend Intern",
            companyName = "Example Company",
            requirements = "C#, Git",
            deadline = Deadline,
            maximumAvailableSlots = 2
        };

        using var response = await client.PostAsJsonAsync("/api/v1/offers", request);
        response.StatusCode.Should().Be(HttpStatusCode.Created);
        var created = await response.Content.ReadFromJsonAsync<OfferResponse>();
        created.Should().NotBeNull();
        return created!;
    }

    private sealed record OfferResponse(
        Guid Id,
        string Title,
        string CompanyName,
        string Requirements,
        DateTime Deadline,
        int MaximumAvailableSlots,
        bool IsClosed,
        int Version);
}


===== tests\InternHub.Tests\Integration\Offers\CvFeedback\CvFeedbackEndpointTests.cs =====

using System.Collections.Concurrent;
using System.Net;
using System.Net.Http.Json;
using FluentAssertions;
using InternHub.Api.Domain.Offers;
using InternHub.Api.Features.Offers.CvFeedback;
using InternHub.Api.Features.RecruiterEvaluation;
using InternHub.Api.Infrastructure.Persistence;
using InternHub.Tests.Integration.Infrastructure;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection.Extensions;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;

namespace InternHub.Tests.Integration.Offers.CvFeedback;

[Collection("Integration")]
public sealed class CvFeedbackEndpointTests
{
    private static readonly DateTime Deadline =
        new(2027, 1, 15, 0, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_ValidCvAndExistingOffer_When_RequestingCvFeedback_Then_ReturnsFeedbackAndDoesNotPersistOrLogCv()
    {
        // Arrange
        const string cvText = "Candidate CV content that must remain private.";
        const string offerRequirements = "C#, ASP.NET Core";
        var evaluation = new RecruiterEvaluationResult(
            ["C#"],
            ["ASP.NET Core"],
            ["Add a project demonstrating API design."],
            "The candidate has a relevant foundation.");
        var evaluator = new FakeRecruiterEvaluationService(evaluation);
        using var factory = CreateFactory(evaluator);
        using var client = factory.CreateClient();
        var logProvider = new RecordingLoggerProvider();
        factory.Services.GetRequiredService<ILoggerFactory>().AddProvider(logProvider);
        var offer = await SeedOffer(factory, offerRequirements);

        // Act
        using var response = await client.PostAsJsonAsync(
            $"/api/v1/offers/{offer.Id}/cv-feedback",
            new { cvText });
        var body = await response.Content.ReadFromJsonAsync<CvFeedbackResponse>();

        // Assert
        response.StatusCode.Should().Be(HttpStatusCode.OK);
        body.Should().NotBeNull();
        body!.MatchedSkills.Should().Equal("C#");
        body.MissingSkills.Should().Equal("ASP.NET Core");
        body.Suggestions.Should().Equal("Add a project demonstrating API design.");
        body.Summary.Should().Be("The candidate has a relevant foundation.");
        evaluator.Calls.Should().Be(1);
        evaluator.ReceivedCv.Should().Be(cvText);
        evaluator.ReceivedRequirements.Should().Be(offerRequirements);
        logProvider.Entries.Should().NotContain(
            entry => entry.Contains(cvText, StringComparison.Ordinal));
        await AssertOnlyOfferIsPersisted(factory, offer.Id);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_MissingOffer_When_RequestingCvFeedback_Then_ReturnsNotFoundWithoutCallingEvaluatorOrChangingDatabase()
    {
        // Arrange
        var evaluator = new FakeRecruiterEvaluationService();
        using var factory = CreateFactory(evaluator);
        using var client = factory.CreateClient();
        var offerId = Guid.NewGuid();

        // Act
        using var response = await client.PostAsJsonAsync(
            $"/api/v1/offers/{offerId}/cv-feedback",
            new { cvText = "Candidate CV content." });
        var error = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();

        // Assert
        response.StatusCode.Should().Be(HttpStatusCode.NotFound);
        error.Should().Contain($"Offer {offerId} not found.");
        evaluator.Calls.Should().Be(0);
        await AssertNoOffersOrCandidacies(factory);
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData(null)]
    [InlineData("")]
    [InlineData(" \t\r\n ")]
    public async Task Given_InvalidCv_When_RequestingCvFeedback_Then_ReturnsBadRequestWithoutCallingEvaluatorOrChangingDatabase(
        string? cvText)
    {
        // Arrange
        var evaluator = new FakeRecruiterEvaluationService();
        using var factory = CreateFactory(evaluator);
        using var client = factory.CreateClient();
        var offer = await SeedOffer(factory);

        // Act
        using var response = await client.PostAsJsonAsync(
            $"/api/v1/offers/{offer.Id}/cv-feedback",
            new { cvText });
        var error = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();

        // Assert
        response.StatusCode.Should().Be(HttpStatusCode.BadRequest);
        error.Should().Contain("CV text must not be empty.");
        evaluator.Calls.Should().Be(0);
        await AssertOnlyOfferIsPersisted(factory, offer.Id);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_CvOverMaximumLength_When_RequestingCvFeedback_Then_ReturnsBadRequestWithoutCallingEvaluatorOrChangingDatabase()
    {
        // Arrange
        var evaluator = new FakeRecruiterEvaluationService();
        using var factory = CreateFactory(evaluator);
        using var client = factory.CreateClient();
        var offer = await SeedOffer(factory);
        var cvText = new string('a', 20_001);

        // Act
        using var response = await client.PostAsJsonAsync(
            $"/api/v1/offers/{offer.Id}/cv-feedback",
            new { cvText });
        var error = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();

        // Assert
        response.StatusCode.Should().Be(HttpStatusCode.BadRequest);
        error.Should().Contain("CV text must not exceed 20000 characters.");
        evaluator.Calls.Should().Be(0);
        await AssertOnlyOfferIsPersisted(factory, offer.Id);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_EvaluatorUnavailable_When_RequestingCvFeedback_Then_ReturnsServiceUnavailableWithoutLeakingCvOrChangingDatabase()
    {
        // Arrange
        const string cvText = "Private CV content for provider failure.";
        var evaluator = new FakeRecruiterEvaluationService(
            exception: new HttpRequestException("Provider connection failed."));
        using var factory = CreateFactory(evaluator);
        using var client = factory.CreateClient();
        var logProvider = new RecordingLoggerProvider();
        factory.Services.GetRequiredService<ILoggerFactory>().AddProvider(logProvider);
        var offer = await SeedOffer(factory);

        // Act
        using var response = await client.PostAsJsonAsync(
            $"/api/v1/offers/{offer.Id}/cv-feedback",
            new { cvText });
        var problem = await response.Content.ReadFromJsonAsync<ProblemDetails>();

        // Assert
        response.StatusCode.Should().Be(HttpStatusCode.ServiceUnavailable);
        problem.Should().NotBeNull();
        problem!.Detail.Should().Be("CV feedback is temporarily unavailable.");
        problem.Detail.Should().NotContain(cvText);
        logProvider.Entries.Should().NotContain(
            entry => entry.Contains(cvText, StringComparison.Ordinal));
        evaluator.Calls.Should().Be(1);
        await AssertOnlyOfferIsPersisted(factory, offer.Id);
    }

    private static InternHubSqliteFactory CreateFactory(
        FakeRecruiterEvaluationService evaluator) =>
        new(configureTestServices: services =>
        {
            services.RemoveAll<IRecruiterEvaluationService>();
            services.AddSingleton<IRecruiterEvaluationService>(evaluator);
        });

    private static async Task<Offer> SeedOffer(
        InternHubSqliteFactory factory,
        string requirements = "C#")
    {
        var offer = new Offer(
            "Software Engineering Intern",
            "InternHub",
            requirements,
            Deadline,
            2);

        using var scope = factory.Services.CreateScope();
        var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<InternHubDbContext>();
        db.Offers.Add(offer);
        await db.SaveChangesAsync();

        return offer;
    }

    private static async Task AssertOnlyOfferIsPersisted(
        InternHubSqliteFactory factory,
        Guid offerId)
    {
        using var scope = factory.Services.CreateScope();
        var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<InternHubDbContext>();

        var offers = await db.Offers.AsNoTracking().ToListAsync();
        offers.Should().ContainSingle().Which.Id.Should().Be(offerId);
        (await db.InternshipCandidacies.AsNoTracking().CountAsync()).Should().Be(0);
        (await db.Students.AsNoTracking().CountAsync()).Should().Be(0);
    }

    private static async Task AssertNoOffersOrCandidacies(InternHubSqliteFactory factory)
    {
        using var scope = factory.Services.CreateScope();
        var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<InternHubDbContext>();

        (await db.Offers.AsNoTracking().CountAsync()).Should().Be(0);
        (await db.InternshipCandidacies.AsNoTracking().CountAsync()).Should().Be(0);
        (await db.Students.AsNoTracking().CountAsync()).Should().Be(0);
    }

    private sealed class FakeRecruiterEvaluationService(
        RecruiterEvaluationResult? result = null,
        Exception? exception = null) : IRecruiterEvaluationService
    {
        private readonly RecruiterEvaluationResult _result = result ?? new(
            Array.Empty<string>(),
            Array.Empty<string>(),
            Array.Empty<string>(),
            string.Empty);

        public int Calls { get; private set; }
        public string? ReceivedCv { get; private set; }
        public string? ReceivedRequirements { get; private set; }

        public Task<RecruiterEvaluationResult> AnalyzeAsync(
            string cvContent,
            string offerRequirements,
            CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            Calls++;
            ReceivedCv = cvContent;
            ReceivedRequirements = offerRequirements;

            if (exception is not null)
                throw exception;

            return Task.FromResult(_result);
        }
    }

    private sealed class RecordingLoggerProvider : ILoggerProvider
    {
        private readonly ConcurrentQueue<string> _entries = new();

        public IReadOnlyCollection<string> Entries => _entries.ToArray();

        public ILogger CreateLogger(string categoryName) => new RecordingLogger(_entries);

        public void Dispose()
        {
        }

        private sealed class RecordingLogger(ConcurrentQueue<string> entries) : ILogger
        {
            public IDisposable? BeginScope<TState>(TState state)
                where TState : notnull =>
                NullScope.Instance;

            public bool IsEnabled(LogLevel logLevel) => true;

            public void Log<TState>(
                LogLevel logLevel,
                EventId eventId,
                TState state,
                Exception? exception,
                Func<TState, Exception?, string> formatter) =>
                entries.Enqueue(formatter(state, exception));
        }

        private sealed class NullScope : IDisposable
        {
            public static NullScope Instance { get; } = new();

            public void Dispose()
            {
            }
        }
    }
}

using System.Net;
using System.Net.Http.Json;
using FluentAssertions;
using InternHub.Api.Infrastructure.Persistence;
using InternHub.Tests.Integration.Infrastructure;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;

namespace InternHub.Tests.Integration.Offers.DeleteOffer;

public sealed class DeleteOfferEndpointTests
{
    private static readonly DateTime Deadline =
        new(2027, 1, 15, 0, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_ExistingOffer_When_DeletingOffer_Then_ReturnsNoContentAndRemovesOffer()
    {
        // Arrange
        using var factory = new InternHubSqliteFactory();
        using var client = factory.CreateClient();
        var offerId = await CreateOffer(client);

        // Act
        using var response = await client.DeleteAsync($"/api/v1/offers/{offerId}");

        // Assert
        response.StatusCode.Should().Be(HttpStatusCode.NoContent);
        (await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync()).Should().BeEmpty();

        using var scope = factory.Services.CreateScope();
        var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<InternHubDbContext>();
        (await db.Offers.AsNoTracking().AnyAsync(item => item.Id == offerId)).Should().BeFalse();
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_MissingOffer_When_DeletingOffer_Then_ReturnsNotFoundAndPreservesDatabase()
    {
        // Arrange
        using var factory = new InternHubSqliteFactory();
        using var client = factory.CreateClient();
        var offerId = Guid.NewGuid();

        // Act
        using var response = await client.DeleteAsync($"/api/v1/offers/{offerId}");

        // Assert
        response.StatusCode.Should().Be(HttpStatusCode.NotFound);
        (await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync()).Should().Contain(offerId.ToString());

        using var scope = factory.Services.CreateScope();
        var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<InternHubDbContext>();
        (await db.Offers.AsNoTracking().CountAsync()).Should().Be(0);
    }

    private static async Task<Guid> CreateOffer(HttpClient client)
    {
        var request = new
        {
            title = "Backend Intern",
            companyName = "Example Company",
            requirements = "C#, Git",
            deadline = Deadline,
            maximumAvailableSlots = 2
        };

        using var response = await client.PostAsJsonAsync("/api/v1/offers", request);
        response.StatusCode.Should().Be(HttpStatusCode.Created);
        var created = await response.Content.ReadFromJsonAsync<OfferResponse>();
        created.Should().NotBeNull();
        return created!.Id;
    }

    private sealed record OfferResponse(Guid Id);
}


===== tests\InternHub.Tests\Integration\Offers\GetOffers\GetOffersEndpointTests.cs =====

using System.Net;
using System.Net.Http.Json;
using FluentAssertions;
using InternHub.Api.Domain.Offers;
using InternHub.Api.Infrastructure.Persistence;
using InternHub.Tests.Integration.Infrastructure;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;

namespace InternHub.Tests.Integration.Offers.GetOffers;

[Collection("Integration")]
public sealed class GetOffersEndpointTests
{
    private static readonly DateTime CurrentUtc =
        new(2027, 1, 15, 12, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_OpenOfferWithFutureDeadline_When_GettingActiveOffers_Then_ReturnsOnlyThatOffer()
    {
        // Arrange
        using var factory = CreateFactory();
        using var client = factory.CreateClient();
        var activeOffer = CreateOffer("Active Intern", CurrentUtc.AddMinutes(1));
        var closedOffer = CreateOffer("Closed Intern", CurrentUtc.AddMinutes(1));
        closedOffer.Close();
        var expiredOffer = CreateOffer("Expired Intern", CurrentUtc.AddMinutes(-1));
        var equalDeadlineOffer = CreateOffer("Due Now Intern", CurrentUtc);
        await SeedOffers(factory, activeOffer, closedOffer, expiredOffer, equalDeadlineOffer);

        // Act
        using var response = await client.GetAsync("/api/v1/offers?activeOnly=true");
        var returned = await response.Content
            .ReadFromJsonAsync<IReadOnlyList<OfferResponse>>();

        // Assert
        response.StatusCode.Should().Be(HttpStatusCode.OK);
        returned.Should().BeEquivalentTo(
            new[] { ToResponse(activeOffer) },
            options => options.WithStrictOrdering());
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_ClosedOffer_When_GettingActiveOffers_Then_ExcludesClosedOffer()
    {
        // Arrange
        using var factory = CreateFactory();
        using var client = factory.CreateClient();
        var closedOffer = CreateOffer("Closed Intern", CurrentUtc.AddMinutes(1));
        closedOffer.Close();
        await SeedOffers(factory, closedOffer);

        // Act
        using var response = await client.GetAsync("/api/v1/offers?activeOnly=true");
        var returned = await response.Content
            .ReadFromJsonAsync<IReadOnlyList<OfferResponse>>();

        // Assert
        response.StatusCode.Should().Be(HttpStatusCode.OK);
        returned.Should().NotBeNull();
        returned.Should().BeEmpty();
        await AssertPersistedOffer(factory, closedOffer);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_ExpiredOffer_When_GettingActiveOffers_Then_ExcludesExpiredOffer()
    {
        // Arrange
        using var factory = CreateFactory();
        using var client = factory.CreateClient();
        var expiredOffer = CreateOffer("Expired Intern", CurrentUtc.AddMinutes(-1));
        await SeedOffers(factory, expiredOffer);

        // Act
        using var response = await client.GetAsync("/api/v1/offers?activeOnly=true");
        var returned = await response.Content
            .ReadFromJsonAsync<IReadOnlyList<OfferResponse>>();

        // Assert
        response.StatusCode.Should().Be(HttpStatusCode.OK);
        returned.Should().NotBeNull();
        returned.Should().BeEmpty();
        await AssertPersistedOffer(factory, expiredOffer);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_OfferDueAtCurrentTime_When_GettingActiveOffers_Then_ExcludesOffer()
    {
        // Arrange
        using var factory = CreateFactory();
        using var client = factory.CreateClient();
        var offer = CreateOffer("Due Now Intern", CurrentUtc);
        await SeedOffers(factory, offer);

        // Act
        using var response = await client.GetAsync("/api/v1/offers?activeOnly=true");
        var returned = await response.Content
            .ReadFromJsonAsync<IReadOnlyList<OfferResponse>>();

        // Assert
        response.StatusCode.Should().Be(HttpStatusCode.OK);
        returned.Should().NotBeNull();
        returned.Should().BeEmpty();
        await AssertPersistedOffer(factory, offer);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_OpenClosedAndExpiredOffers_When_GettingAllOffersExplicitly_Then_ReturnsAllOffers()
    {
        // Arrange
        using var factory = CreateFactory();
        using var client = factory.CreateClient();
        var openOffer = CreateOffer("Open Intern", CurrentUtc.AddMinutes(1));
        var closedOffer = CreateOffer("Closed Intern", CurrentUtc.AddMinutes(1));
        closedOffer.Close();
        var expiredOffer = CreateOffer("Expired Intern", CurrentUtc.AddMinutes(-1));
        await SeedOffers(factory, openOffer, closedOffer, expiredOffer);

        // Act
        using var response = await client.GetAsync("/api/v1/offers?activeOnly=false");
        var returned = await response.Content
            .ReadFromJsonAsync<IReadOnlyList<OfferResponse>>();

        // Assert
        response.StatusCode.Should().Be(HttpStatusCode.OK);
        returned.Should().BeEquivalentTo(
            new[]
            {
                ToResponse(openOffer),
                ToResponse(closedOffer),
                ToResponse(expiredOffer)
            },
            options => options.WithoutStrictOrdering());
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_OpenClosedAndExpiredOffers_When_GettingOffersWithoutActiveOnlyParameter_Then_ReturnsAllOffers()
    {
        // Arrange
        using var factory = CreateFactory();
        using var client = factory.CreateClient();
        var openOffer = CreateOffer("Open Intern", CurrentUtc.AddMinutes(1));
        var closedOffer = CreateOffer("Closed Intern", CurrentUtc.AddMinutes(1));
        closedOffer.Close();
        var expiredOffer = CreateOffer("Expired Intern", CurrentUtc.AddMinutes(-1));
        await SeedOffers(factory, openOffer, closedOffer, expiredOffer);

        // Act
        using var response = await client.GetAsync("/api/v1/offers");
        var returned = await response.Content
            .ReadFromJsonAsync<IReadOnlyList<OfferResponse>>();

        // Assert
        response.StatusCode.Should().Be(HttpStatusCode.OK);
        returned.Should().BeEquivalentTo(
            new[]
            {
                ToResponse(openOffer),
                ToResponse(closedOffer),
                ToResponse(expiredOffer)
            },
            options => options.WithoutStrictOrdering());
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_NoActiveOffers_When_GettingActiveOffers_Then_ReturnsOkAndEmptyJsonArray()
    {
        // Arrange
        using var factory = CreateFactory();
        using var client = factory.CreateClient();
        var closedOffer = CreateOffer("Closed Intern", CurrentUtc.AddMinutes(1));
        closedOffer.Close();
        var expiredOffer = CreateOffer("Expired Intern", CurrentUtc.AddMinutes(-1));
        await SeedOffers(factory, closedOffer, expiredOffer);

        // Act
        using var response = await client.GetAsync("/api/v1/offers?activeOnly=true");
        var body = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
        var returned = await response.Content
            .ReadFromJsonAsync<IReadOnlyList<OfferResponse>>();

        // Assert
        response.StatusCode.Should().Be(HttpStatusCode.OK);
        body.Should().Be("[]");
        returned.Should().NotBeNull();
        returned.Should().BeEmpty();
    }

    private static InternHubSqliteFactory CreateFactory() =>
        new(new FixedTimeProvider(CurrentUtc));

    private static Offer CreateOffer(string title, DateTime deadline) =>
        new(title, "Example Company", "C#, Git", deadline, 2);

    private static async Task SeedOffers(
        InternHubSqliteFactory factory,
        params Offer[] offers)
    {
        using var scope = factory.Services.CreateScope();
        var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<InternHubDbContext>();
        db.Offers.AddRange(offers);
        await db.SaveChangesAsync();
    }

    private static async Task AssertPersistedOffer(
        InternHubSqliteFactory factory,
        Offer expected)
    {
        using var scope = factory.Services.CreateScope();
        var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<InternHubDbContext>();
        var persisted = await db.Offers.AsNoTracking()
            .SingleAsync(offer => offer.Id == expected.Id);
        persisted.Should().BeEquivalentTo(expected);
    }

    private static OfferResponse ToResponse(Offer offer) =>
        new(
            offer.Id,
            offer.Title,
            offer.CompanyName,
            offer.Requirements,
            offer.Deadline,
            offer.MaximumAvailableSlots,
            offer.IsClosed,
            offer.Version);

    private sealed class FixedTimeProvider(DateTime utcNow) : TimeProvider
    {
        public override DateTimeOffset GetUtcNow() => new(utcNow);
    }

    private sealed record OfferResponse(
        Guid Id,
        string Title,
        string CompanyName,
        string Requirements,
        DateTime Deadline,
        int MaximumAvailableSlots,
        bool IsClosed,
        int Version);
}

using System.Net;
using System.Net.Http.Json;
using FluentAssertions;
using InternHub.Api.Infrastructure.Persistence;
using InternHub.Tests.Integration.Infrastructure;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;

namespace InternHub.Tests.Integration.Offers.UpdateOffer;

public sealed class UpdateOfferEndpointTests
{
    private static readonly DateTime InitialDeadline =
        new(2027, 1, 15, 0, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);
    private static readonly DateTime UpdatedDeadline =
        new(2027, 2, 20, 0, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_ExistingOfferWithCurrentVersion_When_UpdatingOffer_Then_ReturnsNoContentAndPersistsVersionIncrement()
    {
        // Arrange
        using var factory = new InternHubSqliteFactory();
        using var client = factory.CreateClient();
        var offer = await CreateOffer(client);
        var request = new
        {
            title = "Updated Backend Intern",
            companyName = "Updated Company",
            requirements = "C#, EF Core",
            deadline = UpdatedDeadline,
            maximumAvailableSlots = 4,
            version = offer.Version
        };

        // Act
        using var response = await client.PutAsJsonAsync($"/api/v1/offers/{offer.Id}", request);

        // Assert
        response.StatusCode.Should().Be(HttpStatusCode.NoContent);
        (await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync()).Should().BeEmpty();

        using var scope = factory.Services.CreateScope();
        var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<InternHubDbContext>();
        var persisted = await db.Offers.AsNoTracking().SingleAsync(item => item.Id == offer.Id);
        persisted.Title.Should().Be("Updated Backend Intern");
        persisted.CompanyName.Should().Be("Updated Company");
        persisted.Requirements.Should().Be("C#, EF Core");
        persisted.Deadline.Should().Be(UpdatedDeadline);
        persisted.MaximumAvailableSlots.Should().Be(4);
        persisted.Version.Should().Be(offer.Version + 1);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_InvalidOfferData_When_UpdatingOffer_Then_ReturnsBadRequestAndPreservesPersistedData()
    {
        // Arrange
        using var factory = new InternHubSqliteFactory();
        using var client = factory.CreateClient();
        var offer = await CreateOffer(client);
        var request = new
        {
            title = "",
            companyName = "Updated Company",
            requirements = "C#, EF Core",
            deadline = UpdatedDeadline,
            maximumAvailableSlots = 4,
            version = offer.Version
        };

        // Act
        using var response = await client.PutAsJsonAsync($"/api/v1/offers/{offer.Id}", request);

        // Assert
        response.StatusCode.Should().Be(HttpStatusCode.BadRequest);
        (await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync()).Should().Contain("Title is required.");

        using var scope = factory.Services.CreateScope();
        var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<InternHubDbContext>();
        var persisted = await db.Offers.AsNoTracking().SingleAsync(item => item.Id == offer.Id);
        persisted.Title.Should().Be(offer.Title);
        persisted.CompanyName.Should().Be(offer.CompanyName);
        persisted.Requirements.Should().Be(offer.Requirements);
        persisted.Deadline.Should().Be(offer.Deadline);
        persisted.MaximumAvailableSlots.Should().Be(offer.MaximumAvailableSlots);
        persisted.Version.Should().Be(offer.Version);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_MissingOffer_When_UpdatingOffer_Then_ReturnsNotFoundAndLeavesDatabaseEmpty()
    {
        // Arrange
        using var factory = new InternHubSqliteFactory();
        using var client = factory.CreateClient();
        var offerId = Guid.NewGuid();
        var request = new
        {
            title = "Updated Backend Intern",
            companyName = "Updated Company",
            requirements = "C#, EF Core",
            deadline = UpdatedDeadline,
            maximumAvailableSlots = 4,

        using var scope = factory.Services.CreateScope();

        (await db.Offers.AsNoTracking().CountAsync()).Should().Be(0);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_OfferUpdatedWithCurrentVersion_When_UpdatingWithStaleVersion_Then_ReturnsConflictAndPreservesLatestData()
    {
        // Arrange
        using var factory = new InternHubSqliteFactory();
        using var client = factory.CreateClient();
        var offer = await CreateOffer(client);
        var firstUpdate = new
        {
            title = "Latest Backend Intern",
            companyName = "Latest Company",
            requirements = "C#, EF Core",
            deadline = UpdatedDeadline,
            maximumAvailableSlots = 4,
            version = offer.Version
        };
        using var firstResponse = await client.PutAsJsonAsync($"/api/v1/offers/{offer.Id}", firstUpdate);
        firstResponse.StatusCode.Should().Be(HttpStatusCode.NoContent);

        var staleUpdate = new
        {
            title = "Stale Backend Intern",
            companyName = "Stale Company",
            requirements = "Old requirements",
            deadline = InitialDeadline,
            maximumAvailableSlots = 1,
            version = offer.Version
        };

        // Act
        using var response = await client.PutAsJsonAsync($"/api/v1/offers/{offer.Id}", staleUpdate);

        // Assert
        response.StatusCode.Should().Be(HttpStatusCode.Conflict);
        (await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync()).Should().Contain("stale version");

        using var scope = factory.Services.CreateScope();
        var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<InternHubDbContext>();
        var persisted = await db.Offers.AsNoTracking().SingleAsync(item => item.Id == offer.Id);
        persisted.Title.Should().Be("Latest Backend Intern");
        persisted.CompanyName.Should().Be("Latest Company");
        persisted.Requirements.Should().Be("C#, EF Core");
        persisted.Deadline.Should().Be(UpdatedDeadline);
        persisted.MaximumAvailableSlots.Should().Be(4);
        persisted.Version.Should().Be(offer.Version + 1);
    }

    private static async Task<OfferResponse> CreateOffer(HttpClient client)
    {
        var request = new
        {
            title = "Backend Intern",
            companyName = "Example Company",
            requirements = "C#, Git",
            deadline = InitialDeadline,
            maximumAvailableSlots = 2
        };

        using var response = await client.PostAsJsonAsync("/api/v1/offers", request);
        response.StatusCode.Should().Be(HttpStatusCode.Created);

        var created = await response.Content.ReadFromJsonAsync<OfferResponse>();
        created.Should().NotBeNull();
        return created!;
    }

    private sealed record OfferResponse(
        Guid Id,
        string Title,
        string CompanyName,
        string Requirements,
        DateTime Deadline,
        int MaximumAvailableSlots,
        bool IsClosed,
        int Version);
