===== tests\InternHub.Tests\Integration\Offers\OfferEndpointTests.cs =====

using System.Net;
using System.Net.Http.Json;
using FluentAssertions;
using InternHub.Api.Infrastructure.Persistence;
using InternHub.Tests.Integration.Infrastructure;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;

namespace InternHub.Tests.Integration.Offers;

[Collection("Integration")]
public sealed class OfferEndpointTests
{
    private static readonly DateTime BackendDeadline =
        new(2027, 1, 15, 0, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);

    private static readonly DateTime FrontendDeadline =
        new(2027, 2, 15, 0, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_ValidOfferData_When_CreatingOffer_Then_ReturnsCreatedAndPersistsOffer()
    {
        // Arrange
        using var factory = new InternHubSqliteFactory();
        using var client = factory.CreateClient();
        var request = new CreateOfferRequest(
            "Backend Intern",
            "Example Company",
            "C#, Git",
            BackendDeadline,
            2);

        // Act
        using var response = await client.PostAsJsonAsync("/api/v1/offers", request);
        var created = await response.Content.ReadFromJsonAsync<OfferResponse>();

        // Assert
        response.StatusCode.Should().Be(HttpStatusCode.Created);
        response.Headers.Location.Should().NotBeNull();
        created.Should().NotBeNull();
        created!.Id.Should().NotBe(Guid.Empty);
        created.Title.Should().Be(request.Title);
        created.CompanyName.Should().Be(request.CompanyName);
        created.Requirements.Should().Be(request.Requirements);
        created.Deadline.Should().Be(request.Deadline);
        created.MaximumAvailableSlots.Should().Be(request.MaximumAvailableSlots);
        created.IsClosed.Should().BeFalse();
        created.Version.Should().Be(0);
        response.Headers.Location!.ToString()
            .Should().Be($"/api/v1/offers/{created.Id}");

        using var scope = factory.Services.CreateScope();
        var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<InternHubDbContext>();
        var persisted = await db.Offers.AsNoTracking()
            .SingleOrDefaultAsync(offer => offer.Id == created.Id);
        persisted.Should().NotBeNull();
        persisted!.Title.Should().Be(request.Title);
        persisted.CompanyName.Should().Be(request.CompanyName);
        persisted.Requirements.Should().Be(request.Requirements);
        persisted.Deadline.Should().Be(request.Deadline);
        persisted.MaximumAvailableSlots.Should().Be(request.MaximumAvailableSlots);
        persisted.IsClosed.Should().BeFalse();
        persisted.Version.Should().Be(0);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_InvalidOfferData_When_CreatingOffer_Then_ReturnsBadRequestAndPersistsNothing()
    {
        // Arrange
        using var factory = new InternHubSqliteFactory();
        using var client = factory.CreateClient();
        var request = new CreateOfferRequest(
            "",
            "Example Company",
            "C#, Git",
            BackendDeadline,
            2);

        // Act
        using var response = await client.PostAsJsonAsync("/api/v1/offers", request);
        var error = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();

        // Assert
        response.StatusCode.Should().Be(HttpStatusCode.BadRequest);
        error.Should().Contain("Title is required.");

        using var scope = factory.Services.CreateScope();
        var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<InternHubDbContext>();
        (await db.Offers.AsNoTracking().CountAsync()).Should().Be(0);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_ExistingOffer_When_GettingOfferById_Then_ReturnsOkAndOfferData()
    {
        // Arrange
        using var factory = new InternHubSqliteFactory();
        using var client = factory.CreateClient();
        var request = new CreateOfferRequest(
            "Backend Intern",
            "Example Company",
            "C#, Git",
            BackendDeadline,
            2);
        var created = await CreateOffer(client, request);

        // Act
        using var response = await client.GetAsync($"/api/v1/offers/{created.Id}");
        var returned = await response.Content.ReadFromJsonAsync<OfferResponse>();

        // Assert
        response.StatusCode.Should().Be(HttpStatusCode.OK);
        returned.Should().BeEquivalentTo(created);

        using var scope = factory.Services.CreateScope();
        var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<InternHubDbContext>();
        (await db.Offers.AsNoTracking().AnyAsync(offer => offer.Id == created.Id))
            .Should().BeTrue();
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_MissingOffer_When_GettingOfferById_Then_ReturnsNotFound()
    {
        // Arrange
        using var factory = new InternHubSqliteFactory();
        using var client = factory.CreateClient();
        var missingOfferId = Guid.NewGuid();

        // Act
        using var response = await client.GetAsync($"/api/v1/offers/{missingOfferId}");
        var error = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();

        // Assert
        response.StatusCode.Should().Be(HttpStatusCode.NotFound);
        error.Should().Contain(missingOfferId.ToString());

        using var scope = factory.Services.CreateScope();
        var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<InternHubDbContext>();
        (await db.Offers.AsNoTracking().CountAsync()).Should().Be(0);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_MultipleOffers_When_GettingOffers_Then_ReturnsAllPersistedOffers()
    {
        // Arrange
        using var factory = new InternHubSqliteFactory();
        using var client = factory.CreateClient();
        var first = await CreateOffer(client, new CreateOfferRequest(
            "Backend Intern",
            "Example Company",
            "C#, Git",
            BackendDeadline,
            2));
        var second = await CreateOffer(client, new CreateOfferRequest(
            "Frontend Intern",
            "Example Company",
            "TypeScript, CSS",
            FrontendDeadline,
            1));

        // Act
        using var response = await client.GetAsync("/api/v1/offers");
        var returned = await response.Content
            .ReadFromJsonAsync<IReadOnlyList<OfferResponse>>();

        // Assert
        response.StatusCode.Should().Be(HttpStatusCode.OK);
        returned.Should().NotBeNull();
        returned.Should().BeEquivalentTo(new[] { first, second });

        using var scope = factory.Services.CreateScope();
        var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<InternHubDbContext>();
        (await db.Offers.AsNoTracking().CountAsync()).Should().Be(2);
        (await db.Offers.AsNoTracking().AnyAsync(offer => offer.Id == first.Id))
            .Should().BeTrue();
        (await db.Offers.AsNoTracking().AnyAsync(offer => offer.Id == second.Id))
            .Should().BeTrue();
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_NoOffers_When_GettingOffers_Then_ReturnsOkAndEmptyCollection()
    {
        // Arrange
        using var factory = new InternHubSqliteFactory();
        using var client = factory.CreateClient();

        // Act
        using var response = await client.GetAsync("/api/v1/offers");
        var returned = await response.Content
            .ReadFromJsonAsync<IReadOnlyList<OfferResponse>>();

        // Assert
        response.StatusCode.Should().Be(HttpStatusCode.OK);
        returned.Should().NotBeNull();
        returned.Should().BeEmpty();

        using var scope = factory.Services.CreateScope();
        var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<InternHubDbContext>();
        (await db.Offers.AsNoTracking().CountAsync()).Should().Be(0);
    }

    private static async Task<OfferResponse> CreateOffer(
        HttpClient client,
        CreateOfferRequest request)
    {
        using var response = await client.PostAsJsonAsync("/api/v1/offers", request);
        response.StatusCode.Should().Be(HttpStatusCode.Created);
        var created = await response.Content.ReadFromJsonAsync<OfferResponse>();
        created.Should().NotBeNull();
        return created!;
    }

    private sealed record CreateOfferRequest(
        string Title,
        string CompanyName,
        string Requirements,
        DateTime Deadline,
        int MaximumAvailableSlots);

    private sealed record OfferResponse(
        Guid Id,
        string Title,
        string CompanyName,
        string Requirements,
        DateTime Deadline,
        int MaximumAvailableSlots,
        bool IsClosed,
        int Version);
}


===== tests\InternHub.Tests\Integration\Persistence\AtomicDecision\EfCoreAtomicCandidacyDecisionConcurrencyTests.cs =====

using System.Data.Common;
using FluentAssertions;
using InternHub.Api.Domain.InternshipCandidacies;
using InternHub.Api.Domain.Offers;
using InternHub.Api.Features.InternshipCandidacies.AtomicDecision;
using InternHub.Api.Features.InternshipCandidacies.DecideInternshipCandidacy;
using InternHub.Api.Infrastructure.Persistence;
using InternHub.Api.Infrastructure.Persistence.AtomicDecision;
using InternHub.Domain.Students;
using Microsoft.Data.Sqlite;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Diagnostics;

namespace InternHub.Tests.Integration.Persistence.AtomicDecision;

public sealed class EfCoreAtomicCandidacyDecisionConcurrencyTests
{
    private static readonly DateTime Now =
        new(2027, 1, 15, 12, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_OneSlotLeftAndTwoConcurrentAccepts_When_Deciding_Then_OneIsAcceptedAndOneIsWaitlisted()
    {
        // Arrange
        using var database = CreateDatabase();
        var databasePath = database.Path;
        var offer = CreateOffer(maximumAvailableSlots: 1);
        var students = Enumerable.Range(0, 2).Select(_ => CreateStudent()).ToArray();
        var candidacies = students
            .Select(student => CreateCandidacy(student.Id, offer.Id, InternshipCandidacyStatus.Submitted))
            .ToArray();
        Seed(databasePath, students, [offer], candidacies);
        var observers = candidacies.Select(_ => new TransactionAttemptObserver()).ToArray();
        using var writeLock = AcquireWriteLock(databasePath);

        // Act
        var decisions = candidacies
            .Zip(observers, (candidacy, observer) => Task.Run(() =>
                DecideAsync(databasePath, candidacy.Id, CandidacyDecision.Accept, observer.Interceptor)))
            .ToArray();
        await AwaitTransactionAttemptsAsync(observers);
        writeLock.Dispose();
        var results = await Task.WhenAll(decisions);

        // Assert
        results.Select(result => result.Status)
            .Should().OnlyContain(status => status == AtomicCandidacyDecisionStatus.Decided);
        results.Select(result => result.Candidacy!.Status)
            .Should().BeEquivalentTo(
                [InternshipCandidacyStatus.Accepted,
                 InternshipCandidacyStatus.Waitlisted]);
        CountAccepted(databasePath, offer.Id).Should().Be(1);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_OneSlotLeftAndFiveConcurrentAccepts_When_Deciding_Then_NeverExceedsMaximumSlots()
    {
        // Arrange
        using var database = CreateDatabase();
        var databasePath = database.Path;
        var offer = CreateOffer(maximumAvailableSlots: 2);
        var acceptedStudent = CreateStudent();
        var accepted = CreateCandidacy(acceptedStudent.Id, offer.Id, InternshipCandidacyStatus.Accepted);
        var students = Enumerable.Range(0, 5).Select(_ => CreateStudent()).ToArray();
        var candidacies = students
            .Select(student => CreateCandidacy(student.Id, offer.Id, InternshipCandidacyStatus.Submitted))
            .ToArray();
        Seed(databasePath, [acceptedStudent, .. students], [offer], [accepted, .. candidacies]);
        var observers = candidacies.Select(_ => new TransactionAttemptObserver()).ToArray();
        using var writeLock = AcquireWriteLock(databasePath);

        // Act
        var decisions = candidacies
            .Zip(observers, (candidacy, observer) => Task.Run(() =>
                DecideAsync(databasePath, candidacy.Id, CandidacyDecision.Accept, observer.Interceptor)))
            .ToArray();
        await AwaitTransactionAttemptsAsync(observers);
        writeLock.Dispose();
        var results = await Task.WhenAll(decisions);

        // Assert
        results.Count(result => result.Candidacy?.Status == InternshipCandidacyStatus.Accepted)
            .Should().BeLessThanOrEqualTo(1);
        CountAccepted(databasePath, offer.Id).Should().Be(offer.MaximumAvailableSlots);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_OneInjectedVersionConflict_When_Accepting_Then_RetriesAndAccepts()
    {
        // Arrange
        using var database = CreateDatabase();
        var databasePath = database.Path;
        var student = CreateStudent();
        var offer = CreateOffer(maximumAvailableSlots: 1);
        var candidacy = CreateCandidacy(student.Id, offer.Id, InternshipCandidacyStatus.Submitted);
        Seed(databasePath, [student], [offer], [candidacy]);
        var versionBefore = ReadOfferVersion(databasePath, offer.Id);
        var conflict = new OfferVersionConflictInterceptor(offer.Id, conflictingAttempts: 1);

        // Act
        var result = await DecideAsync(databasePath, candidacy.Id, CandidacyDecision.Accept, conflict);

        // Assert
        result.Status.Should().Be(AtomicCandidacyDecisionStatus.Decided);
        result.Candidacy!.Status.Should().Be(InternshipCandidacyStatus.Accepted);
        conflict.SavingAttempts.Should().Be(2);
        ReadCandidacy(databasePath, candidacy.Id).Status.Should().Be(InternshipCandidacyStatus.Accepted);
        ReadOfferVersion(databasePath, offer.Id).Should().Be(versionBefore + 1);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_VersionConflictOnEveryAttempt_When_Accepting_Then_ReturnsConcurrencyConflictAndChangesNothing()
    {
        // Arrange
        using var database = CreateDatabase();
        var databasePath = database.Path;
        var student = CreateStudent();
        var offer = CreateOffer(maximumAvailableSlots: 1);
        var candidacy = CreateCandidacy(student.Id, offer.Id, InternshipCandidacyStatus.Submitted);
        Seed(databasePath, [student], [offer], [candidacy]);
        var versionBefore = ReadOfferVersion(databasePath, offer.Id);
        var conflict = new OfferVersionConflictInterceptor(offer.Id, conflictingAttempts: int.MaxValue);

        // Act
        var result = await DecideAsync(databasePath, candidacy.Id, CandidacyDecision.Accept, conflict);

        // Assert
        result.Status.Should().Be(AtomicCandidacyDecisionStatus.ConcurrencyConflict);
        result.Candidacy.Should().BeNull();
        conflict.SavingAttempts.Should().Be(3);
        ReadCandidacy(databasePath, candidacy.Id).Status.Should().Be(InternshipCandidacyStatus.Submitted);
        ReadOfferVersion(databasePath, offer.Id).Should().Be(versionBefore);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_ThreeSlotsAndTwentyConcurrentAccepts_When_Deciding_Then_SlotInvariantsHold()
    {
        // Arrange
        using var database = CreateDatabase();
        var databasePath = database.Path;
        var offer = CreateOffer(maximumAvailableSlots: 3);
        var students = Enumerable.Range(0, 20).Select(_ => CreateStudent()).ToArray();
        var candidacies = students
            .Select(student => CreateCandidacy(student.Id, offer.Id, InternshipCandidacyStatus.Submitted))
            .ToArray();
        Seed(databasePath, students, [offer], candidacies);
        var startGate = new TaskCompletionSource(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
        var decisions = candidacies
            .Select(candidacy => Task.Run(async () =>
            {
                await startGate.Task;
                var result = await DecideAsync(databasePath, candidacy.Id, CandidacyDecision.Accept);
                return (CandidacyId: candidacy.Id, Result: result);
            }))
            .ToArray();

        // Act
        startGate.SetResult();
        var outcomes = await Task.WhenAll(decisions);

        // Assert
        outcomes.Select(outcome => outcome.Result.Status)
            .Should().OnlyContain(status =>
                status == AtomicCandidacyDecisionStatus.Decided ||
                status == AtomicCandidacyDecisionStatus.ConcurrencyConflict);
        var persisted = ReadCandidacies(databasePath, offer.Id);
        var acceptedCount = persisted.Count(candidacy => candidacy.Status == InternshipCandidacyStatus.Accepted);
        var waitlistedCount = persisted.Count(candidacy => candidacy.Status == InternshipCandidacyStatus.Waitlisted);
        acceptedCount.Should().BeLessThanOrEqualTo(offer.MaximumAvailableSlots);
        (waitlistedCount == 0 || acceptedCount == offer.MaximumAvailableSlots)
            .Should().BeTrue("a candidacy is waitlisted only when every slot is already accepted");
        persisted.Should().OnlyContain(candidacy =>
            candidacy.Status == InternshipCandidacyStatus.Accepted ||
            candidacy.Status == InternshipCandidacyStatus.Waitlisted ||
            candidacy.Status == InternshipCandidacyStatus.Submitted);
        persisted
            .Where(candidacy => candidacy.Status == InternshipCandidacyStatus.Submitted)
            .Select(candidacy => candidacy.Id)
            .Should().BeSubsetOf(outcomes
                .Where(outcome => outcome.Result.Status == AtomicCandidacyDecisionStatus.ConcurrencyConflict)
                .Select(outcome => outcome.CandidacyId));
    }

    private static async Task<AtomicCandidacyDecisionResult> DecideAsync(
        string databasePath,
        Guid candidacyId,
        CandidacyDecision decision,
        params IInterceptor[] interceptors)
    {
        await using var context = CreateContext(databasePath, interceptors);
        var decisions = new EfCoreAtomicCandidacyDecision(context);
        return await decisions.DecideAsync(candidacyId, decision);
    }

    private static async Task AwaitTransactionAttemptsAsync(
        params TransactionAttemptObserver[] observers)
    {
        await Task.WhenAll(
            observers.Select(observer =>
                observer.TransactionAttempt.Task.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5))));
    }

    private static IDisposable AcquireWriteLock(string databasePath)
    {
        var connection = new SqliteConnection(ConnectionString(databasePath));
        connection.Open();
        var transaction = connection.BeginTransaction(
            System.Data.IsolationLevel.Serializable);
        using var command = connection.CreateCommand();
        command.Transaction = transaction;
        command.CommandText = "UPDATE Students SET Email = Email;";
        command.ExecuteNonQuery();
        return new OwnedSqliteWriteLock(connection, transaction);
    }

    private static TemporarySqliteDatabase CreateDatabase()
    {
        var databasePath = Path.Combine(
            Path.GetTempPath(),
            $"internhub-decision-{Guid.NewGuid():N}.db");
        var database = new TemporarySqliteDatabase(databasePath);
        try
        {
            using var context = CreateContext(databasePath);
            context.Database.EnsureCreated();
            return database;
        }
        catch
        {
            database.Dispose();
            throw;
        }
    }

    private static InternHubDbContext CreateContext(
        string databasePath,
        params IInterceptor[] interceptors)
    {
        var options = new DbContextOptionsBuilder<InternHubDbContext>()
            .UseSqlite(ConnectionString(databasePath))
            .AddInterceptors(interceptors)
            .Options;
        return new InternHubDbContext(options);
    }

    private static string ConnectionString(string databasePath) =>
        $"Data Source={databasePath};Default Timeout=1;Pooling=False";

    private static void Seed(
        string databasePath,
        Student[] students,
        Offer[] offers,
        InternshipCandidacy[] candidacies)
    {
        using var context = CreateContext(databasePath);
        context.Students.AddRange(students);
        context.Offers.AddRange(offers);
        context.InternshipCandidacies.AddRange(candidacies);
        context.SaveChanges();
    }

    private static List<InternshipCandidacy> ReadCandidacies(string databasePath, Guid offerId)
    {
        using var context = CreateContext(databasePath);
        return context.InternshipCandidacies
            .AsNoTracking()
            .Where(candidacy => candidacy.OfferId == offerId)
            .ToList();
    }

    private static InternshipCandidacy ReadCandidacy(string databasePath, Guid candidacyId)
    {
        using var context = CreateContext(databasePath);
        return context.InternshipCandidacies
            .AsNoTracking()
            .Single(candidacy => candidacy.Id == candidacyId);
    }

    private static int CountAccepted(string databasePath, Guid offerId) =>
        ReadCandidacies(databasePath, offerId)
            .Count(candidacy => candidacy.Status == InternshipCandidacyStatus.Accepted);

    private static int ReadOfferVersion(string databasePath, Guid offerId)
    {
        using var context = CreateContext(databasePath);
        return context.Offers
            .AsNoTracking()
            .Single(offer => offer.Id == offerId)
            .Version;
    }

    private static Student CreateStudent() =>
        new(Guid.NewGuid(), "Concurrent Student", $"student-{Guid.NewGuid()}@example.com");

    private static Offer CreateOffer(int maximumAvailableSlots) =>
        new("Concurrent Internship", "Example Company", "C#, SQL", Now.AddDays(10), maximumAvailableSlots);

    private static InternshipCandidacy CreateCandidacy(
        Guid studentId,
        Guid offerId,
        InternshipCandidacyStatus status) =>
        new(Guid.NewGuid(), studentId, offerId, Now.AddHours(-1), status);

    private sealed class TransactionAttemptObserver
    {
        public TransactionAttemptObserver()
        {
            Interceptor = new TransactionAttemptInterceptor(TransactionAttempt);
        }

        public TransactionAttemptInterceptor Interceptor { get; }

        public TaskCompletionSource<bool> TransactionAttempt { get; } =
            new(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
    }

    private sealed class TransactionAttemptInterceptor(
        TaskCompletionSource<bool> transactionAttempt) : DbTransactionInterceptor
    {
        private readonly TaskCompletionSource<bool> _transactionAttempt =
            transactionAttempt;

        public override InterceptionResult<DbTransaction> TransactionStarting(
            DbConnection connection,
            TransactionStartingEventData eventData,
            InterceptionResult<DbTransaction> result)
        {
            _transactionAttempt.TrySetResult(true);
            return base.TransactionStarting(connection, eventData, result);
        }

        public override ValueTask<InterceptionResult<DbTransaction>> TransactionStartingAsync(
            DbConnection connection,
            TransactionStartingEventData eventData,
            InterceptionResult<DbTransaction> result,
            CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            _transactionAttempt.TrySetResult(true);
            return base.TransactionStartingAsync(
                connection,
                eventData,
                result,
                cancellationToken);
        }
    }

    private sealed class OfferVersionConflictInterceptor(
        Guid offerId,
        int conflictingAttempts) : SaveChangesInterceptor
    {
        private int _savingAttempts;

        public int SavingAttempts => Volatile.Read(ref _savingAttempts);

        public override async ValueTask<InterceptionResult<int>> SavingChangesAsync(
            DbContextEventData eventData,
            InterceptionResult<int> result,
            CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            var attempt = Interlocked.Increment(ref _savingAttempts);

            if (attempt <= conflictingAttempts)
            {
                // Simulates another request committing an offer change between this
                // attempt's read and its save, inside the same transaction.
                await eventData.Context!.Set<Offer>()
                    .Where(offer => offer.Id == offerId)
                    .ExecuteUpdateAsync(
                        setters => setters.SetProperty(offer => offer.Version, offer => offer.Version + 1),
                        cancellationToken);
            }

            return await base.SavingChangesAsync(eventData, result, cancellationToken);
        }
    }

    private sealed class TemporarySqliteDatabase : IDisposable
    {
        public TemporarySqliteDatabase(string path)
        {
            Path = path;
            KeepAliveConnection = new SqliteConnection(
                ConnectionString(path));
            KeepAliveConnection.Open();
        }

        public string Path { get; }

        private SqliteConnection KeepAliveConnection { get; }

        public void Dispose()
        {
            KeepAliveConnection.Dispose();
            File.Delete(Path);
            File.Delete($"{Path}-wal");
            File.Delete($"{Path}-shm");
        }
    }

    private sealed class OwnedSqliteWriteLock(
        SqliteConnection connection,
        SqliteTransaction transaction) : IDisposable
    {
        private readonly SqliteConnection _connection = connection;
        private readonly SqliteTransaction _transaction = transaction;

        public void Dispose()
        {
            _transaction.Dispose();
            _connection.Dispose();
        }
    }
}


===== tests\InternHub.Tests\Integration\Persistence\AtomicDecision\EfCoreAtomicCandidacyDecisionTests.cs =====

using FluentAssertions;
using InternHub.Api.Domain.InternshipCandidacies;
using InternHub.Api.Domain.Offers;
using InternHub.Api.Features.InternshipCandidacies.AtomicDecision;
using InternHub.Api.Features.InternshipCandidacies.DecideInternshipCandidacy;
using InternHub.Api.Infrastructure.Persistence;
using InternHub.Api.Infrastructure.Persistence.AtomicDecision;
using InternHub.Domain.Students;
using Microsoft.Data.Sqlite;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace InternHub.Tests.Integration.Persistence.AtomicDecision;

public sealed class EfCoreAtomicCandidacyDecisionTests
{
    private static readonly DateTime Now =
        new(2027, 1, 15, 12, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_SubmittedCandidacyAndFreeSlot_When_Accepting_Then_AcceptsAndIncrementsOfferVersion()
    {
        // Arrange
        using var database = new InMemoryDatabase();
        var student = CreateStudent();
        var offer = CreateOffer(maximumAvailableSlots: 1);
        var candidacy = CreateCandidacy(student.Id, offer.Id, InternshipCandidacyStatus.Submitted);
        Seed(database, [student], [offer], [candidacy]);
        var versionBefore = ReadOfferVersion(database, offer.Id);

        // Act
        var result = await DecideAsync(database, candidacy.Id, CandidacyDecision.Accept);

        // Assert
        result.Status.Should().Be(AtomicCandidacyDecisionStatus.Decided);
        result.Candidacy!.Status.Should().Be(InternshipCandidacyStatus.Accepted);
        ReadCandidacy(database, candidacy.Id)!.Status.Should().Be(InternshipCandidacyStatus.Accepted);
        ReadOfferVersion(database, offer.Id).Should().Be(versionBefore + 1);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_SubmittedCandidacyAndNoFreeSlot_When_Accepting_Then_WaitlistsAndKeepsOfferVersion()
    {
        // Arrange
        using var database = new InMemoryDatabase();
        var acceptedStudent = CreateStudent();
        var student = CreateStudent();
        var offer = CreateOffer(maximumAvailableSlots: 1);
        var accepted = CreateCandidacy(acceptedStudent.Id, offer.Id, InternshipCandidacyStatus.Accepted);
        var candidacy = CreateCandidacy(student.Id, offer.Id, InternshipCandidacyStatus.Submitted);
        Seed(database, [acceptedStudent, student], [offer], [accepted, candidacy]);
        var versionBefore = ReadOfferVersion(database, offer.Id);

        // Act
        var result = await DecideAsync(database, candidacy.Id, CandidacyDecision.Accept);

        // Assert
        result.Status.Should().Be(AtomicCandidacyDecisionStatus.Decided);
        result.Candidacy!.Status.Should().Be(InternshipCandidacyStatus.Waitlisted);
        ReadCandidacy(database, candidacy.Id)!.Status.Should().Be(InternshipCandidacyStatus.Waitlisted);
        CountAccepted(database, offer.Id).Should().Be(1);
        ReadOfferVersion(database, offer.Id).Should().Be(versionBefore);
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData(CandidacyDecision.Shortlist, InternshipCandidacyStatus.Shortlisted)]
    [InlineData(CandidacyDecision.Reject, InternshipCandidacyStatus.Rejected)]
    public async Task Given_SubmittedCandidacy_When_ShortlistingOrRejecting_Then_DecidesAndKeepsOfferVersion(
        CandidacyDecision decision,
        InternshipCandidacyStatus expectedStatus)
    {
        // Arrange
        using var database = new InMemoryDatabase();
        var student = CreateStudent();
        var offer = CreateOffer(maximumAvailableSlots: 1);
        var candidacy = CreateCandidacy(student.Id, offer.Id, InternshipCandidacyStatus.Submitted);
        Seed(database, [student], [offer], [candidacy]);
        var versionBefore = ReadOfferVersion(database, offer.Id);

        // Act
        var result = await DecideAsync(database, candidacy.Id, decision);

        // Assert
        result.Status.Should().Be(AtomicCandidacyDecisionStatus.Decided);
        result.Candidacy!.Status.Should().Be(expectedStatus);
        ReadCandidacy(database, candidacy.Id)!.Status.Should().Be(expectedStatus);
        ReadOfferVersion(database, offer.Id).Should().Be(versionBefore);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_RejectedCandidacy_When_Accepting_Then_ReturnsInvalidTransitionAndChangesNothing()
    {
        // Arrange
        using var database = new InMemoryDatabase();
        var student = CreateStudent();
        var offer = CreateOffer(maximumAvailableSlots: 1);
        var candidacy = CreateCandidacy(student.Id, offer.Id, InternshipCandidacyStatus.Rejected);
        Seed(database, [student], [offer], [candidacy]);
        var versionBefore = ReadOfferVersion(database, offer.Id);

        // Act
        var result = await DecideAsync(database, candidacy.Id, CandidacyDecision.Accept);

        // Assert

        result.Candidacy.Should().BeNull();

        ReadOfferVersion(database, offer.Id).Should().Be(versionBefore);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_MissingCandidacy_When_Deciding_Then_ReturnsCandidacyNotFoundAndChangesNothing()
    {
        // Arrange
        using var database = new InMemoryDatabase();
        var student = CreateStudent();
        var offer = CreateOffer(maximumAvailableSlots: 1);
        var existing = CreateCandidacy(student.Id, offer.Id, InternshipCandidacyStatus.Submitted);
        Seed(database, [student], [offer], [existing]);
        var versionBefore = ReadOfferVersion(database, offer.Id);
        var missingCandidacyId = Guid.NewGuid();

        // Act
        var result = await DecideAsync(database, missingCandidacyId, CandidacyDecision.Accept);

        // Assert
        result.Status.Should().Be(AtomicCandidacyDecisionStatus.CandidacyNotFound);
        result.Candidacy.Should().BeNull();

        ReadOfferVersion(database, offer.Id).Should().Be(versionBefore);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_ClosedOfferWithFreeSlot_When_Accepting_Then_Accepts()
    {
        // Arrange
        using var database = new InMemoryDatabase();
        var student = CreateStudent();
        var offer = CreateOffer(maximumAvailableSlots: 1);
        offer.Close();
        var candidacy = CreateCandidacy(student.Id, offer.Id, InternshipCandidacyStatus.Submitted);
        Seed(database, [student], [offer], [candidacy]);

        // Act
        var result = await DecideAsync(database, candidacy.Id, CandidacyDecision.Accept);

        // Assert

        ReadCandidacy(database, candidacy.Id)!.Status.Should().Be(InternshipCandidacyStatus.Accepted);
    }

    private static async Task<AtomicCandidacyDecisionResult> DecideAsync(
        InMemoryDatabase database,
        Guid candidacyId,
        CandidacyDecision decision)
    {
        await using var context = database.CreateContext();
        var decisions = new EfCoreAtomicCandidacyDecision(context);
        return await decisions.DecideAsync(candidacyId, decision);
    }

    private static void Seed(
        InMemoryDatabase database,
        Student[] students,
        Offer[] offers,
        InternshipCandidacy[] candidacies)
    {
        using var context = database.CreateContext();
        context.Students.AddRange(students);
        context.Offers.AddRange(offers);
        context.InternshipCandidacies.AddRange(candidacies);
        context.SaveChanges();
    }

    {

    {

            .Single(offer => offer.Id == offerId)
            .Version;
    }

    private static int CountAccepted(InMemoryDatabase database, Guid offerId)
    {

            .AsNoTracking()
            .Count(candidacy =>
                candidacy.OfferId == offerId &&
                candidacy.Status == InternshipCandidacyStatus.Accepted);
    }

    private static Student CreateStudent() =>

        new("Decision Internship", "Example Company", "C#, SQL", Now.AddDays(10), maximumAvailableSlots);

    private static InternshipCandidacy CreateCandidacy(

        new(Guid.NewGuid(), studentId, offerId, Now.AddHours(-1), status);

    private sealed class InMemoryDatabase : IDisposable
    {
        private readonly SqliteConnection _connection = new("Data Source=:memory:");

        public InMemoryDatabase()
        {
            _connection.Open();
            using var context = CreateContext();
            context.Database.EnsureCreated();
        }

        public InternHubDbContext CreateContext() =>
            new(new DbContextOptionsBuilder<InternHubDbContext>()
                .UseSqlite(_connection)
                .Options);

        public void Dispose() => _connection.Dispose();
    }
}


===== tests\InternHub.Tests\Integration\Persistence\AtomicSubmission\EfCoreAtomicCandidacySubmissionConcurrencyTests.cs =====

using FluentAssertions;
using System.Data.Common;
using InternHub.Api.Domain.InternshipCandidacies;
using InternHub.Api.Domain.Offers;
using InternHub.Api.Features.InternshipCandidacies.AtomicSubmission;
using InternHub.Api.Infrastructure.Persistence;
using InternHub.Api.Infrastructure.Persistence.AtomicSubmission;
using InternHub.Domain.Students;
using Microsoft.Data.Sqlite;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Diagnostics;

namespace InternHub.Tests.Integration.Persistence.AtomicSubmission;

public sealed class EfCoreAtomicCandidacySubmissionConcurrencyTests
{
    private static readonly DateTime Now =
        new(2027, 1, 15, 12, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_TwoConcurrentSubmissionsForSameStudentAndOffer_When_Submitting_Then_OneIsCreatedAndOneIsDuplicate()
    {
        // Arrange
        using var database = CreateDatabase();
        var databasePath = database.Path;
        var student = CreateStudent();
        var offer = CreateOffer();
        Seed(databasePath, [student], [offer], []);
        using var writeLock = AcquireWriteLock(databasePath);

        // Act
        var firstObserver = new SubmissionAttemptObserver();
        var secondObserver = new SubmissionAttemptObserver();
        var firstSubmission = SubmitAsync(
            databasePath,
            student.Id,
            offer.Id,
            firstObserver);
        var secondSubmission = SubmitAsync(
            databasePath,
            student.Id,
            offer.Id,
            secondObserver);
        await AwaitTransactionAttemptsAsync(firstObserver, secondObserver);
        writeLock.Dispose();
        var results = await Task.WhenAll(firstSubmission, secondSubmission);

        // Assert
        results.Select(result => result.Status)
            .Should().BeEquivalentTo(
                [AtomicCandidacySubmissionStatus.Created,
                 AtomicCandidacySubmissionStatus.DuplicateActive]);
        var persisted = ReadCandidacies(databasePath);
        persisted.Should().ContainSingle();
        persisted.Count(candidacy => candidacy.IsActive).Should().Be(1);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_FourActiveCandidaciesAndTwoConcurrentDifferentOffers_When_Submitting_Then_OnlyOneReachesTheFiveActiveLimit()
    {
        // Arrange
        using var database = CreateDatabase();
        var databasePath = database.Path;
        var student = CreateStudent();
        var existingOffers = Enumerable.Range(0, 4)
            .Select(_ => CreateOffer())
            .ToArray();
        var newOffers = Enumerable.Range(0, 2)
            .Select(_ => CreateOffer())
            .ToArray();
        var existing = existingOffers
            .Select(offer => CreateCandidacy(
                student.Id,
                offer.Id,
                InternshipCandidacyStatus.Submitted))
            .ToArray();
        Seed(
            databasePath,
            [student],
            [.. existingOffers, .. newOffers],
            existing);
        using var writeLock = AcquireWriteLock(databasePath);

        // Act
        var firstObserver = new SubmissionAttemptObserver();
        var secondObserver = new SubmissionAttemptObserver();
        var firstSubmission = SubmitAsync(
            databasePath,
            student.Id,
            newOffers[0].Id,
            firstObserver);
        var secondSubmission = SubmitAsync(
            databasePath,
            student.Id,
            newOffers[1].Id,
            secondObserver);
        await AwaitTransactionAttemptsAsync(firstObserver, secondObserver);
        writeLock.Dispose();
        var results = await Task.WhenAll(firstSubmission, secondSubmission);

        // Assert
        results.Select(result => result.Status)
            .Should().BeEquivalentTo(
                [AtomicCandidacySubmissionStatus.Created,
                 AtomicCandidacySubmissionStatus.ActiveLimitReached]);
        var persisted = ReadCandidacies(databasePath);
        persisted.Should().HaveCount(5);
        persisted.Count(candidacy => candidacy.StudentId == student.Id &&
                                     candidacy.IsActive)
            .Should().Be(5);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_ConcurrentSubmissions_When_Completed_Then_NoDuplicateActivePairsExist()
    {
        // Arrange
        using var database = CreateDatabase();
        var databasePath = database.Path;
        var student = CreateStudent();
        var offer = CreateOffer();
        Seed(databasePath, [student], [offer], []);
        using var writeLock = AcquireWriteLock(databasePath);

        // Act
        var firstObserver = new SubmissionAttemptObserver();
        var secondObserver = new SubmissionAttemptObserver();
        var firstSubmission = SubmitAsync(
            databasePath,
            student.Id,
            offer.Id,
            firstObserver);
        var secondSubmission = SubmitAsync(
            databasePath,
            student.Id,
            offer.Id,
            secondObserver);
        await AwaitTransactionAttemptsAsync(firstObserver, secondObserver);
        writeLock.Dispose();
        await Task.WhenAll(firstSubmission, secondSubmission);

        // Assert
        var persisted = ReadCandidacies(databasePath);
        persisted.Where(candidacy => candidacy.IsActive)
            .GroupBy(candidacy => new { candidacy.StudentId, candidacy.OfferId })
            .Should().OnlyContain(group => group.Count() == 1);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_ExistingValidSubmission_When_SubmittingAnotherEligibleApplication_Then_Succeeds()
    {
        // Arrange
        using var database = CreateDatabase();
        var databasePath = database.Path;
        var student = CreateStudent();
        var firstOffer = CreateOffer();
        var secondOffer = CreateOffer();
        Seed(databasePath, [student], [firstOffer, secondOffer], []);

        // Act
        var result = await SubmitAsync(
            databasePath,
            student.Id,
            firstOffer.Id);
        var secondResult = await SubmitAsync(
            databasePath,
            student.Id,
            secondOffer.Id);

        // Assert
        result.Status.Should().Be(AtomicCandidacySubmissionStatus.Created);
        secondResult.Status.Should().Be(AtomicCandidacySubmissionStatus.Created);
        ReadCandidacies(databasePath).Should().HaveCount(2);
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData(InternshipCandidacyStatus.Rejected)]
    [InlineData(InternshipCandidacyStatus.Withdrawn)]
    public async Task Given_InactivePreviousCandidacy_When_Reapplying_Then_CreatesNewActiveCandidacy(
        InternshipCandidacyStatus inactiveStatus)
    {
        // Arrange
        using var database = CreateDatabase();
        var databasePath = database.Path;
        var student = CreateStudent();
        var offer = CreateOffer();
        var previous = CreateCandidacy(student.Id, offer.Id, inactiveStatus);
        Seed(databasePath, [student], [offer], [previous]);

        // Act
        var result = await SubmitAsync(databasePath, student.Id, offer.Id);

        // Assert
        result.Status.Should().Be(AtomicCandidacySubmissionStatus.Created);
        ReadCandidacies(databasePath).Should().HaveCount(2);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_FiveActiveCandidacies_When_SubmittingToAnotherOffer_Then_FailureDoesNotModifyPersistedData()
    {
        // Arrange
        using var database = CreateDatabase();
        var databasePath = database.Path;
        var student = CreateStudent();
        var offers = Enumerable.Range(0, 6)
            .Select(_ => CreateOffer())
            .ToArray();
        var existing = offers
            .Take(5)
            .Select(offer => CreateCandidacy(
                student.Id,
                offer.Id,
                InternshipCandidacyStatus.Accepted))
            .ToArray();
        Seed(databasePath, [student], offers, existing);
        var before = ReadCandidacies(databasePath);

        // Act
        var result = await SubmitAsync(databasePath, student.Id, offers[5].Id);

        // Assert
        result.Status.Should().Be(AtomicCandidacySubmissionStatus.ActiveLimitReached);
        ReadCandidacies(databasePath)
            .Select(candidacy => candidacy.Id)
            .Should().BeEquivalentTo(before.Select(candidacy => candidacy.Id));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Given_NewFileDatabase_When_InitializingSchema_Then_FilteredUniqueIndexExists()
    {
        // Arrange
        using var database = CreateDatabase();
        using var connection = new SqliteConnection(
            ConnectionString(database.Path));
        connection.Open();
        using var command = connection.CreateCommand();
        command.CommandText =
            "SELECT sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'index' " +
            "AND name = 'IX_InternshipCandidacies_StudentId_OfferId';";

        // Act
        var definition = command.ExecuteScalar()?.ToString();

        // Assert
        definition.Should().Contain("UNIQUE INDEX");
        definition.Should().Contain("Submitted");
        definition.Should().Contain("Shortlisted");
        definition.Should().Contain("Accepted");
        definition.Should().Contain("Waitlisted");
    }

    private static async Task<AtomicCandidacySubmissionResult> SubmitAsync(
        string databasePath,
        Guid studentId,
        Guid offerId,
        SubmissionAttemptObserver? observer = null)
    {
        await using var db = CreateContext(databasePath, observer);
        var submission = new EfCoreAtomicCandidacySubmission(
            db,
            new FixedTimeProvider(Now));
        return await submission.SubmitAsync(studentId, offerId);
    }

    private static async Task AwaitTransactionAttemptsAsync(
        params SubmissionAttemptObserver[] observers)
    {
        await Task.WhenAll(
            observers.Select(observer =>
                observer.TransactionAttempt.Task.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5))));
    }

    private static IDisposable AcquireWriteLock(string databasePath)
    {
        var connection = new SqliteConnection(ConnectionString(databasePath));
        connection.Open();
        var transaction = connection.BeginTransaction(
            System.Data.IsolationLevel.Serializable);
        using var command = connection.CreateCommand();
        command.Transaction = transaction;
        command.CommandText = "UPDATE Students SET Email = Email;";
        command.ExecuteNonQuery();
        return new OwnedSqliteWriteLock(connection, transaction);
    }

    private static TemporarySqliteDatabase CreateDatabase()
    {
        var databasePath = Path.Combine(
            Path.GetTempPath(),
            $"internhub-concurrency-{Guid.NewGuid():N}.db");
        var database = new TemporarySqliteDatabase(databasePath);
        try
        {
            using var context = CreateContext(databasePath);
            context.Database.EnsureCreated();
            return database;
        }
        catch
        {
            database.Dispose();
            throw;
        }
    }

    private static InternHubDbContext CreateContext(
        string databasePath,
        SubmissionAttemptObserver? observer = null)
    {
        var optionsBuilder = new DbContextOptionsBuilder<InternHubDbContext>()
            .UseSqlite(ConnectionString(databasePath));

        if (observer is not null)
            optionsBuilder.AddInterceptors(observer.Transaction);

        var options = optionsBuilder.Options;
        return new InternHubDbContext(options);
    }

    private static string ConnectionString(string databasePath) =>
        $"Data Source={databasePath};Default Timeout=1;Pooling=False";

    private static void Seed(
        string databasePath,
        Student[] students,
        Offer[] offers,
        InternshipCandidacy[] candidacies)
    {
        using var context = CreateContext(databasePath);
        context.Students.AddRange(students);
        context.Offers.AddRange(offers);
        context.InternshipCandidacies.AddRange(candidacies);
        context.SaveChanges();
    }

    private static List<InternshipCandidacy> ReadCandidacies(string databasePath)
    {
        using var context = CreateContext(databasePath);
        return context.InternshipCandidacies
            .AsNoTracking()
            .ToList();
    }

    private static Student CreateStudent() =>
        new(Guid.NewGuid(), "Concurrent Student", $"student-{Guid.NewGuid()}@example.com");

    private static Offer CreateOffer() =>
        new("Concurrent Internship", "Example Company", "C#, SQL", Now.AddDays(1), 2);

    private static InternshipCandidacy CreateCandidacy(
        Guid studentId,
        Guid offerId,
        InternshipCandidacyStatus status) =>
        new(Guid.NewGuid(), studentId, offerId, Now.AddHours(-1), status);

    private sealed class FixedTimeProvider(DateTime utcNow) : TimeProvider
    {
        public override DateTimeOffset GetUtcNow() => new(utcNow);
    }

    private sealed class SubmissionAttemptObserver
    {
        public SubmissionAttemptObserver()
        {
            Transaction = new SubmissionTransactionInterceptor(TransactionAttempt);
        }

        public SubmissionTransactionInterceptor Transaction { get; }

        public TaskCompletionSource<bool> TransactionAttempt { get; } =
            new(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
    }

    private sealed class SubmissionTransactionInterceptor(
        TaskCompletionSource<bool> transactionAttempt) : DbTransactionInterceptor
    {
        private readonly TaskCompletionSource<bool> _transactionAttempt =
            transactionAttempt;

        public override InterceptionResult<DbTransaction> TransactionStarting(
            DbConnection connection,
            TransactionStartingEventData eventData,
            InterceptionResult<DbTransaction> result)
        {
            _transactionAttempt.TrySetResult(true);
            return base.TransactionStarting(connection, eventData, result);
        }

        public override ValueTask<InterceptionResult<DbTransaction>> TransactionStartingAsync(
            DbConnection connection,
            TransactionStartingEventData eventData,
            InterceptionResult<DbTransaction> result,
            CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            _transactionAttempt.TrySetResult(true);
            return base.TransactionStartingAsync(
                connection,
                eventData,
                result,
                cancellationToken);
        }
    }

    private sealed class TemporarySqliteDatabase : IDisposable
    {
        public TemporarySqliteDatabase(string path)
        {
            Path = path;
            KeepAliveConnection = new SqliteConnection(
                ConnectionString(path));
            KeepAliveConnection.Open();
        }

        public string Path { get; }

        private SqliteConnection KeepAliveConnection { get; }

        public void Dispose()
        {
            KeepAliveConnection.Dispose();
            File.Delete(Path);
            File.Delete($"{Path}-wal");
            File.Delete($"{Path}-shm");
        }
    }

    private sealed class OwnedSqliteWriteLock(
        SqliteConnection connection,
        SqliteTransaction transaction) : IDisposable
    {
        private readonly SqliteConnection _connection = connection;
        private readonly SqliteTransaction _transaction = transaction;

        public void Dispose()
        {
            _transaction.Dispose();
            _connection.Dispose();
        }
    }
}


===== tests\InternHub.Tests\Integration\Persistence\AtomicSubmission\EfCoreAtomicCandidacySubmissionTests.cs =====

using FluentAssertions;
using InternHub.Api.Domain.InternshipCandidacies;
using InternHub.Api.Domain.Offers;
using InternHub.Api.Features.InternshipCandidacies.AtomicSubmission;
using InternHub.Api.Infrastructure.Persistence;
using InternHub.Api.Infrastructure.Persistence.AtomicSubmission;
using InternHub.Domain.Students;
using InternHub.Tests.Integration.Infrastructure;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;

namespace InternHub.Tests.Integration.Persistence.AtomicSubmission;

public sealed class EfCoreAtomicCandidacySubmissionTests
{
    private static readonly DateTime Now =
        new(2027, 1, 15, 12, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_EligibleStudentAndOffer_When_Submitting_Then_CreatesSubmittedCandidacy()
    {
        // Arrange
        using var factory = new InternHubSqliteFactory(new FixedTimeProvider(Now));
        var student = new Student(
            Guid.NewGuid(),
            "Ada Lovelace",
            "ada.atomic@example.com");
        var offer = CreateOffer(Now.AddDays(1));
        await SeedAsync(factory, student, offer);

        AtomicCandidacySubmissionResult result;
        using (var scope = factory.Services.CreateScope())
        {
            var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<InternHubDbContext>();
            var submission = new EfCoreAtomicCandidacySubmission(
                db,
                new FixedTimeProvider(Now));

            // Act
            result = await submission.SubmitAsync(student.Id, offer.Id);
        }

        // Assert
        result.Status.Should().Be(AtomicCandidacySubmissionStatus.Created);
        result.Candidacy.Should().NotBeNull();
        result.Candidacy!.StudentId.Should().Be(student.Id);
        result.Candidacy.OfferId.Should().Be(offer.Id);
        result.Candidacy.ApplicationDate.Should().Be(Now);
        result.Candidacy.Status.Should().Be(InternshipCandidacyStatus.Submitted);

        using var assertScope = factory.Services.CreateScope();
        var assertDb = assertScope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<InternHubDbContext>();
        (await assertDb.InternshipCandidacies.CountAsync()).Should().Be(1);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_MissingStudent_When_Submitting_Then_ReturnsStudentNotFoundWithoutPersisting()
    {
        // Arrange
        using var factory = new InternHubSqliteFactory(new FixedTimeProvider(Now));
        var offer = CreateOffer(Now.AddDays(1));
        await SeedAsync(factory, null, offer);

        // Act
        var result = await SubmitAsync(factory, Guid.NewGuid(), offer.Id);

        // Assert
        result.Status.Should().Be(AtomicCandidacySubmissionStatus.StudentNotFound);
        await AssertNoCandidaciesAsync(factory);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_MissingOffer_When_Submitting_Then_ReturnsOfferNotFoundWithoutPersisting()
    {
        // Arrange
        using var factory = new InternHubSqliteFactory(new FixedTimeProvider(Now));
        var student = CreateStudent();
        await SeedAsync(factory, student, null);

        // Act
        var result = await SubmitAsync(factory, student.Id, Guid.NewGuid());

        // Assert
        result.Status.Should().Be(AtomicCandidacySubmissionStatus.OfferNotFound);
        await AssertNoCandidaciesAsync(factory);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_ClosedOffer_When_Submitting_Then_ReturnsOfferClosedWithoutPersisting()
    {
        // Arrange
        using var factory = new InternHubSqliteFactory(new FixedTimeProvider(Now));
        var student = CreateStudent();
        var offer = CreateOffer(Now.AddDays(1));
        offer.Close();
        await SeedAsync(factory, student, offer);

        // Act
        var result = await SubmitAsync(factory, student.Id, offer.Id);

        // Assert
        result.Status.Should().Be(AtomicCandidacySubmissionStatus.OfferClosed);
        await AssertNoCandidaciesAsync(factory);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_ExpiredOffer_When_Submitting_Then_ReturnsDeadlineExpiredWithoutPersisting()
    {
        // Arrange
        using var factory = new InternHubSqliteFactory(new FixedTimeProvider(Now));
        var student = CreateStudent();
        var offer = CreateOffer(Now);
        await SeedAsync(factory, student, offer);

        // Act
        var result = await SubmitAsync(factory, student.Id, offer.Id);

        // Assert
        result.Status.Should().Be(AtomicCandidacySubmissionStatus.DeadlineExpired);
        await AssertNoCandidaciesAsync(factory);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_DuplicateActiveCandidacy_When_Submitting_Then_ReturnsDuplicateActiveWithoutPersisting()
    {
        // Arrange
        using var factory = new InternHubSqliteFactory(new FixedTimeProvider(Now));
        var student = CreateStudent();
        var offer = CreateOffer(Now.AddDays(1));
        var existing = CreateCandidacy(
            student.Id,
            offer.Id,
            InternshipCandidacyStatus.Waitlisted);
        await SeedAsync(factory, student, offer, existing);

        // Act
        var result = await SubmitAsync(factory, student.Id, offer.Id);

        // Assert
        result.Status.Should().Be(AtomicCandidacySubmissionStatus.DuplicateActive);
        await AssertCandidacyCountAsync(factory, 1);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_FiveActiveCandidacies_When_Submitting_Then_ReturnsActiveLimitReachedWithoutPersisting()
    {
        // Arrange
        using var factory = new InternHubSqliteFactory(new FixedTimeProvider(Now));
        var student = CreateStudent();
        var offers = Enumerable.Range(0, 6)
            .Select(_ => CreateOffer(Now.AddDays(1)))
            .ToArray();
        var existing = offers
            .Take(5)
            .Select((offer, index) => CreateCandidacy(
                student.Id,
                offer.Id,
                index == 0
                    ? InternshipCandidacyStatus.Submitted
                    : InternshipCandidacyStatus.Accepted))
            .ToArray();
        await SeedAsync(factory, student, offers, existing);

        // Act
        var result = await SubmitAsync(factory, student.Id, offers[5].Id);

        // Assert
        result.Status.Should().Be(AtomicCandidacySubmissionStatus.ActiveLimitReached);
        await AssertCandidacyCountAsync(factory, 5);
    }

    private static async Task<AtomicCandidacySubmissionResult> SubmitAsync(
        InternHubSqliteFactory factory,
        Guid studentId,
        Guid offerId)
    {
        using var scope = factory.Services.CreateScope();
        var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<InternHubDbContext>();
        var submission = new EfCoreAtomicCandidacySubmission(
            db,
            new FixedTimeProvider(Now));

        return await submission.SubmitAsync(studentId, offerId);
    }

    private static async Task SeedAsync(
        InternHubSqliteFactory factory,
        Student? student,
        Offer? offer,
        params InternshipCandidacy[] candidacies)
    {
        await SeedAsync(
            factory,
            student is null ? [] : [student],
            offer is null ? [] : [offer],
            candidacies);
    }

    private static async Task SeedAsync(
        InternHubSqliteFactory factory,
        Student student,
        Offer[] offers,
        InternshipCandidacy[] candidacies)
    {
        await SeedAsync(factory, [student], offers, candidacies);
    }

    private static async Task SeedAsync(
        InternHubSqliteFactory factory,
        Student[] students,
        Offer[] offers,
        InternshipCandidacy[] candidacies)
    {
        using var scope = factory.Services.CreateScope();
        var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<InternHubDbContext>();
        db.Students.AddRange(students);
        db.Offers.AddRange(offers);
        db.InternshipCandidacies.AddRange(candidacies);
        await db.SaveChangesAsync();
    }

    private static async Task AssertNoCandidaciesAsync(InternHubSqliteFactory factory) =>
        await AssertCandidacyCountAsync(factory, 0);

    private static async Task AssertCandidacyCountAsync(
        InternHubSqliteFactory factory,
        int expected)
    {
        using var scope = factory.Services.CreateScope();
        var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<InternHubDbContext>();
        (await db.InternshipCandidacies.CountAsync()).Should().Be(expected);
    }

    private static Student CreateStudent() =>
        new(Guid.NewGuid(), "Test Student", $"student-{Guid.NewGuid()}@example.com");

    private static Offer CreateOffer(DateTime deadline) =>
        new("Test Internship", "Test Company", "C#, SQL", deadline, 2);

    private static InternshipCandidacy CreateCandidacy(
        Guid studentId,
        Guid offerId,
        InternshipCandidacyStatus status) =>
        new(Guid.NewGuid(), studentId, offerId, Now.AddHours(-1), status);

    private sealed class FixedTimeProvider(DateTime utcNow) : TimeProvider
    {
        public override DateTimeOffset GetUtcNow() => new(utcNow);
    }
}


===== tests\InternHub.Tests\Integration\Persistence\EfCoreInternshipCandidacyRepositoryTests.cs =====

using FluentAssertions;
using InternHub.Api.Domain.InternshipCandidacies;
using InternHub.Api.Domain.Offers;
using InternHub.Api.Infrastructure.Persistence;
using InternHub.Domain.Students;
using Microsoft.Data.Sqlite;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace InternHub.Tests.Integration.Persistence;

public sealed class EfCoreInternshipCandidacyRepositoryTests
{
    private static readonly DateTime FirstApplicationDate =
        new(2027, 1, 10, 12, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);

    private static readonly DateTime SecondApplicationDate =
        new(2027, 1, 11, 12, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);

    [Fact]
    public void Given_ValidCandidacy_When_Adding_Then_PersistsAndReturnsTrue()
    {
        // Arrange
        using var connection = CreateDatabase(out var options);
        var (studentId, offerId) = SeedStudentAndOffer(options);
        var candidacy = CreateCandidacy(
            studentId,
            offerId,
            InternshipCandidacyStatus.Submitted);

        using (var context = new InternHubDbContext(options))
        {
            var repository = new EfCoreInternshipCandidacyRepository(context);

            // Act
            var added = repository.Add(candidacy);

            // Assert
            added.Should().BeTrue();
        }

        using var verificationContext = new InternHubDbContext(options);
        var persisted = verificationContext.InternshipCandidacies
            .AsNoTracking()
            .Single(item => item.Id == candidacy.Id);
        persisted.StudentId.Should().Be(studentId);
        persisted.OfferId.Should().Be(offerId);
        persisted.Status.Should().Be(InternshipCandidacyStatus.Submitted);
        persisted.ApplicationDate.Should().Be(FirstApplicationDate);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Given_ExistingCandidacy_When_GettingById_Then_ReturnsPersistedCandidacy()
    {
        // Arrange
        using var connection = CreateDatabase(out var options);
        var (studentId, offerId) = SeedStudentAndOffer(options);
        var candidacy = SeedCandidacy(
            options,
            studentId,
            offerId,
            InternshipCandidacyStatus.Shortlisted);

        // Act
        InternshipCandidacy? result;
        using (var context = new InternHubDbContext(options))
        {
            var repository = new EfCoreInternshipCandidacyRepository(context);
            result = repository.GetById(candidacy.Id);
        }

        // Assert
        result.Should().NotBeNull();
        result.Should().BeEquivalentTo(candidacy);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Given_MissingCandidacyId_When_GettingById_Then_ReturnsNull()
    {
        // Arrange
        using var connection = CreateDatabase(out var options);
        var missingId = Guid.NewGuid();

        // Act
        InternshipCandidacy? result;
        using (var context = new InternHubDbContext(options))
        {
            var repository = new EfCoreInternshipCandidacyRepository(context);
            result = repository.GetById(missingId);
        }

        // Assert
        result.Should().BeNull();
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Given_CandidaciesForMultipleStudents_When_GettingByStudent_Then_ReturnsOnlyRequestedStudentCandidaciesInOrder()
    {
        // Arrange
        using var connection = CreateDatabase(out var options);
        var (studentId, offerId) = SeedStudentAndOffer(options);
        var otherOfferId = SeedOffer(options);
        var otherStudentId = SeedStudent(options);
        var first = SeedCandidacy(
            options,
            studentId,
            offerId,
            InternshipCandidacyStatus.Submitted,
            FirstApplicationDate);
        var second = SeedCandidacy(
            options,
            studentId,
            otherOfferId,
            InternshipCandidacyStatus.Shortlisted,
            SecondApplicationDate);
        SeedCandidacy(
            options,
            otherStudentId,
            offerId,
            InternshipCandidacyStatus.Accepted,
            SecondApplicationDate);

        // Act
        IReadOnlyList<InternshipCandidacy> result;

            var repository = new EfCoreInternshipCandidacyRepository(context);

    [Fact]
    public void Given_ExistingCandidacy_When_UpdatingStatus_Then_PersistsUpdatedStatus()
    {

        using var connection = CreateDatabase(out var options);
        var (studentId, offerId) = SeedStudentAndOffer(options);
        var original = SeedCandidacy(
            options,
            studentId,
            offerId,
            InternshipCandidacyStatus.Submitted);
        var updated = new InternshipCandidacy(
            original.Id,
            studentId,
            offerId,
            original.ApplicationDate,
            InternshipCandidacyStatus.Shortlisted);

        // Act
        bool result;
        using (var context = new InternHubDbContext(options))
        {
            var repository = new EfCoreInternshipCandidacyRepository(context);
            result = repository.Update(updated);
        }

        // Assert
        result.Should().BeTrue();
        using var verificationContext = new InternHubDbContext(options);
        var persisted = verificationContext.InternshipCandidacies
            .AsNoTracking()
            .Single(item => item.Id == original.Id);
        persisted.Status.Should().Be(InternshipCandidacyStatus.Shortlisted);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Given_MissingCandidacy_When_Updating_Then_ReturnsFalseAndPersistsNothing()
    {

        using var connection = CreateDatabase(out var options);
        var (studentId, offerId) = SeedStudentAndOffer(options);
        var missing = CreateCandidacy(
            studentId,
            offerId,
            InternshipCandidacyStatus.Submitted);

        // Act
        bool result;
        using (var context = new InternHubDbContext(options))
        {
            var repository = new EfCoreInternshipCandidacyRepository(context);
            result = repository.Update(missing);
        }

        // Assert
        result.Should().BeFalse();
        using var verificationContext = new InternHubDbContext(options);
        (verificationContext.InternshipCandidacies.AsNoTracking()
            .Any(item => item.Id == missing.Id))
            .Should().BeFalse();
    }

    private static SqliteConnection CreateDatabase(
        out DbContextOptions<InternHubDbContext> options)
    {
        var connection = new SqliteConnection("Data Source=:memory:");
        connection.Open();
        options = new DbContextOptionsBuilder<InternHubDbContext>()
            .UseSqlite(connection)
            .Options;

        using var context = new InternHubDbContext(options);
        context.Database.EnsureCreated();
        return connection;
    }

    private static (Guid StudentId, Guid OfferId) SeedStudentAndOffer(
        DbContextOptions<InternHubDbContext> options)
    {
        var studentId = SeedStudent(options);
        var offerId = SeedOffer(options);
        return (studentId, offerId);
    }

    private static Guid SeedStudent(DbContextOptions<InternHubDbContext> options)
    {
        var student = new Student(
            Guid.NewGuid(),
            "Test Student",
            $"student-{Guid.NewGuid()}@example.com");

        using var context = new InternHubDbContext(options);
        context.Students.Add(student);
        context.SaveChanges();
        return student.Id;
    }

    private static Guid SeedOffer(DbContextOptions<InternHubDbContext> options)
    {
        var offer = new Offer(
            "Test Internship",
            "Test Company",
            "C#, SQL",
            new DateTime(2027, 3, 1, 0, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc),
            2);

        using var context = new InternHubDbContext(options);
        context.Offers.Add(offer);
        context.SaveChanges();
        return offer.Id;
    }

    private static InternshipCandidacy SeedCandidacy(
        DbContextOptions<InternHubDbContext> options,
        Guid studentId,
        Guid offerId,
        InternshipCandidacyStatus status,
        DateTime? applicationDate = null)
    {
        var candidacy = CreateCandidacy(
            studentId,
            offerId,
            status,
            applicationDate);

        using var context = new InternHubDbContext(options);
        context.InternshipCandidacies.Add(candidacy);
        context.SaveChanges();
        return candidacy;
    }

    private static InternshipCandidacy CreateCandidacy(
        Guid studentId,
        Guid offerId,
        InternshipCandidacyStatus status,
        DateTime? applicationDate = null) =>
        new(
            Guid.NewGuid(),
            studentId,
            offerId,
            applicationDate ?? FirstApplicationDate,
            status);
}

using FluentAssertions;

        new(2027, 1, 15, 12, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);

    [Fact]
    public void Given_ActiveCandidacy_When_AnotherActiveCandidacyUsesSameStudentAndOffer_Then_SqliteRejectsIt()
    {
        // Arrange
        using var database = CreateDatabase(out var options);
        var (studentId, offerId) = SeedStudentAndOffer(options);
        var first = CreateCandidacy(
            studentId,
            offerId,
            InternshipCandidacyStatus.Submitted);
        var duplicate = CreateCandidacy(
            studentId,
            offerId,
            InternshipCandidacyStatus.Accepted);

        using var context = new InternHubDbContext(options);
        context.InternshipCandidacies.Add(first);
        context.SaveChanges();
        context.InternshipCandidacies.Add(duplicate);

        // Act
        var action = () => context.SaveChanges();

        // Assert
        action.Should().Throw<DbUpdateException>();

        using var verificationContext = new InternHubDbContext(options);
