===== tests\InternHub.Tests\Integration\Persistence\PersistenceExtensionsTests.cs =====

using FluentAssertions;
using InternHub.Api.Features.InternshipCandidacies.AtomicSubmission;
using InternHub.Api.Infrastructure.Persistence;
using InternHub.Api.Infrastructure.Persistence.AtomicSubmission;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;

namespace InternHub.Tests.Integration.Persistence;

public sealed class PersistenceExtensionsTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void Given_PersistenceServices_When_ResolvingAtomicSubmission_Then_UsesScopedDependencies()
    {
        // Arrange
        var services = new ServiceCollection();
        var timeProvider = TimeProvider.System;
        var configuration = new ConfigurationBuilder().Build();

        services.AddPersistence(configuration);
        services.AddSingleton(timeProvider);

        using var provider = services.BuildServiceProvider(
            new ServiceProviderOptions { ValidateScopes = true });

        // Act
        using var firstScope = provider.CreateScope();
        var submission = firstScope.ServiceProvider
            .GetRequiredService<IAtomicCandidacySubmission>();
        var db = firstScope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<InternHubDbContext>();
        var resolvedTimeProvider = firstScope.ServiceProvider
            .GetRequiredService<TimeProvider>();

        using var secondScope = provider.CreateScope();
        var secondSubmission = secondScope.ServiceProvider
            .GetRequiredService<IAtomicCandidacySubmission>();
        // Assert
        // Assert
        submission.Should().BeOfType<EfCoreAtomicCandidacySubmission>();
        secondSubmission.Should().NotBeSameAs(submission);
        firstScope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<InternHubDbContext>()
            .Should().BeSameAs(db);
        resolvedTimeProvider.Should().BeSameAs(timeProvider);
    }
}


===== tests\InternHub.Tests\Integration\Persistence\StudentInternshipCandidacyPersistenceTests.cs =====

using FluentAssertions;
using InternHub.Api.Domain.InternshipCandidacies;
using InternHub.Api.Domain.Offers;
using InternHub.Api.Infrastructure.Persistence;
using InternHub.Domain.Students;
using InternHub.Tests.Integration.Infrastructure;
using Microsoft.Data.Sqlite;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;

namespace InternHub.Tests.Integration.Persistence;

public sealed class StudentInternshipCandidacyPersistenceTests
{
    private static readonly DateTime ApplicationDate =
        new(2026, 10, 28, 12, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);

    private static readonly DateTime Deadline =
        new(2027, 1, 15, 0, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);

    [Fact]
    public void Given_ValidStudentOfferAndCandidacy_When_Persisting_Then_ReloadsAllRelationshipData()
    {
        // Arrange
        using var factory = new InternHubSqliteFactory();
        var studentId = Guid.NewGuid();
        var offer = new Offer(
            "Backend Intern",
            "Example Company",
            "C#, Git",
            Deadline,
            2);
        var candidacyId = Guid.NewGuid();
        var candidacy = new InternshipCandidacy(
            candidacyId,
            studentId,
            offer.Id,
            ApplicationDate,
            InternshipCandidacyStatus.Submitted);

        using (var scope = factory.Services.CreateScope())
        {
            var studentRepository = scope.ServiceProvider
                .GetRequiredService<IStudentRepository>();
            var offerRepository = scope.ServiceProvider
                .GetRequiredService<IOfferRepository>();
            var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<InternHubDbContext>();

            studentRepository.Add(new Student(
                studentId,
                "Ada Lovelace",
                "ada@example.com")).Should().BeTrue();
            offerRepository.Add(offer).Should().BeTrue();
            db.InternshipCandidacies.Add(candidacy);
            db.SaveChanges();
        }

        // Act
        using var reloadScope = factory.Services.CreateScope();
        var reloadedStudentRepository = reloadScope.ServiceProvider
            .GetRequiredService<IStudentRepository>();
        var reloadedOfferRepository = reloadScope.ServiceProvider
            .GetRequiredService<IOfferRepository>();
        var reloadedDb = reloadScope.ServiceProvider
            .GetRequiredService<InternHubDbContext>();
        var reloadedStudent = reloadedStudentRepository.GetById(studentId);
        var reloadedOffer = reloadedOfferRepository.GetById(offer.Id);
        var reloadedCandidacy = reloadedDb.InternshipCandidacies
            .AsNoTracking()
            .Single(item => item.Id == candidacyId);

        // Assert
        reloadedStudent.Should().NotBeNull();
        reloadedStudent!.FullName.Should().Be("Ada Lovelace");
        reloadedStudent.Email.Should().Be("ada@example.com");
        reloadedStudent.InternshipCandidacies.Should().ContainSingle(item =>
            item.Id == candidacyId &&
            item.StudentId == studentId &&
            item.OfferId == offer.Id);
        reloadedOffer.Should().NotBeNull();
        reloadedOffer!.Title.Should().Be("Backend Intern");
        reloadedOffer.InternshipCandidacies.Should().ContainSingle(item =>
            item.Id == candidacyId &&
            item.StudentId == studentId &&
            item.OfferId == offer.Id);
        reloadedCandidacy.ApplicationDate.Should().Be(ApplicationDate);
        reloadedCandidacy.Status.Should().Be(InternshipCandidacyStatus.Submitted);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_StudentWithCandidacy_When_DeletingStudent_Then_CandidacyIsCascadedAndOfferRemains()
    {
        // Arrange
        using var factory = new InternHubSqliteFactory();
        var studentId = Guid.NewGuid();
        var offer = new Offer(
            "Frontend Intern",
            "Example Company",
            "TypeScript, CSS",
            Deadline,
            1);
        var candidacyId = Guid.NewGuid();

        using (var scope = factory.Services.CreateScope())
        {
            var studentRepository = scope.ServiceProvider
                .GetRequiredService<IStudentRepository>();
            var offerRepository = scope.ServiceProvider
                .GetRequiredService<IOfferRepository>();
            var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<InternHubDbContext>();

            studentRepository.Add(new Student(
                studentId,
                "Grace Hopper",
                "grace@example.com")).Should().BeTrue();
            offerRepository.Add(offer).Should().BeTrue();
            db.InternshipCandidacies.Add(new InternshipCandidacy(
                candidacyId,
                studentId,
                offer.Id,
                ApplicationDate,
                InternshipCandidacyStatus.Shortlisted));
            db.SaveChanges();
        }

        // Act
        using (var deleteScope = factory.Services.CreateScope())
        {
            var studentRepository = deleteScope.ServiceProvider
                .GetRequiredService<IStudentRepository>();

            studentRepository.Delete(studentId).Should().BeTrue();
        }

        // Assert
        using var assertScope = factory.Services.CreateScope();
        var assertDb = assertScope.ServiceProvider
            .GetRequiredService<InternHubDbContext>();
        (await assertDb.Students.AsNoTracking()
            .AnyAsync(item => item.Id == studentId))
            .Should().BeFalse();
        (await assertDb.InternshipCandidacies.AsNoTracking()
            .AnyAsync(item => item.Id == candidacyId))
            .Should().BeFalse();
        var remainingOffer = assertDb.Offers
            .Include(item => item.InternshipCandidacies)
            .AsNoTracking()
            .SingleOrDefault(item => item.Id == offer.Id);
        remainingOffer.Should().NotBeNull();
        remainingOffer!.InternshipCandidacies.Should().BeEmpty();
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_MissingStudentReference_When_PersistingCandidacy_Then_SqliteRejectsForeignKey()
    {
        // Arrange
        using var factory = new InternHubSqliteFactory();
        var missingStudentId = Guid.NewGuid();
        var offer = new Offer(
            "Data Intern",
            "Example Company",
            "SQL, Python",
            Deadline,
            1);
        var candidacy = new InternshipCandidacy(
            Guid.NewGuid(),
            missingStudentId,
            offer.Id,
            ApplicationDate,
            InternshipCandidacyStatus.Submitted);

        using (var setupScope = factory.Services.CreateScope())
        {
            var offerRepository = setupScope.ServiceProvider
                .GetRequiredService<IOfferRepository>();

            offerRepository.Add(offer).Should().BeTrue();
        }

        // Act
        DbUpdateException exception;
        using (var scope = factory.Services.CreateScope())
        {
            var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<InternHubDbContext>();
            db.InternshipCandidacies.Add(candidacy);
            exception = FluentActions.Invoking(() => db.SaveChanges())
                .Should().Throw<DbUpdateException>().Which;
        }

        // Assert
        exception.InnerException.Should().BeOfType<SqliteException>()
            .Which.SqliteErrorCode.Should().Be(19);
        using var assertScope = factory.Services.CreateScope();
        var assertDb = assertScope.ServiceProvider
            .GetRequiredService<InternHubDbContext>();
        (await assertDb.InternshipCandidacies.AsNoTracking()
            .AnyAsync(item => item.Id == candidacy.Id))
            .Should().BeFalse();
    }
}


===== tests\InternHub.Tests\Integration\Students\CreateStudent\CreateStudentEndpointTests.cs =====

using System.Net;
using System.Net.Http.Json;
using FluentAssertions;
using InternHub.Api.Features.Students.CreateStudent;
using InternHub.Api.Infrastructure.Persistence;
using InternHub.Tests.Integration.Infrastructure;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;

namespace InternHub.Tests.Integration.Students.CreateStudent;

public sealed class CreateStudentEndpointTests
{
    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_ValidStudent_When_CreatingStudent_Then_ReturnsCreatedStudentAndPersistsIt()
    {
        // Arrange
        using var factory = new InternHubSqliteFactory();
        using var client = factory.CreateClient();
        var email = $"create-{Guid.NewGuid()}@mail.com";
        var request = new CreateStudentRequest("Ana Pop", email);

        // Act
        using var response = await client.PostAsJsonAsync("/api/v1/students", request);
        var created = await response.Content.ReadFromJsonAsync<CreateStudentResponse>();

        // Assert
        response.StatusCode.Should().Be(HttpStatusCode.Created);
        response.Headers.Location.Should().NotBeNull();
        response.Headers.Location!.ToString().Should().MatchRegex(
            @"^/api/v1/students/[0-9a-fA-F-]{36}$");
        created.Should().NotBeNull();
        created!.Id.Should().NotBe(Guid.Empty);
        created.FullName.Should().Be("Ana Pop");
        created.Email.Should().Be(email);
        response.Headers.Location!.ToString().Should().EndWith(created.Id.ToString());

        using var scope = factory.Services.CreateScope();
        var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<InternHubDbContext>();
        var persisted = await db.Students.AsNoTracking()
            .SingleAsync(student => student.Id == created.Id);
        persisted.FullName.Should().Be("Ana Pop");
        persisted.Email.Should().Be(email);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_InvalidStudent_When_CreatingStudent_Then_ReturnsBadRequestAndDoesNotPersist()
    {
        // Arrange
        using var factory = new InternHubSqliteFactory();
        using var client = factory.CreateClient();
        var request = new CreateStudentRequest("", "invalid-email");

        // Act
        using var response = await client.PostAsJsonAsync("/api/v1/students", request);
        var error = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();

        // Assert
        response.StatusCode.Should().Be(HttpStatusCode.BadRequest);
        error.Should().Contain("Full name is required.");

        using var scope = factory.Services.CreateScope();
        var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<InternHubDbContext>();
        (await db.Students.AsNoTracking().CountAsync()).Should().Be(0);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_ExistingStudentEmail_When_CreatingDuplicateStudent_Then_ReturnsConflictAndPreservesOriginalStudent()
    {
        // Arrange
        using var factory = new InternHubSqliteFactory();
        using var client = factory.CreateClient();
        var email = $"duplicate-{Guid.NewGuid()}@mail.com";
        var request = new CreateStudentRequest("Ana Pop", email);
        var firstResponse = await client.PostAsJsonAsync("/api/v1/students", request);
        firstResponse.StatusCode.Should().Be(HttpStatusCode.Created);

        // Act
        using var secondResponse = await client.PostAsJsonAsync(
            "/api/v1/students",
            new CreateStudentRequest("Ion Pop", email));
        var error = await secondResponse.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();

        // Assert
        secondResponse.StatusCode.Should().Be(HttpStatusCode.Conflict);
        error.Should().Contain("already exists");

        using var scope = factory.Services.CreateScope();
        var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<InternHubDbContext>();
        (await db.Students.AsNoTracking().CountAsync()).Should().Be(1);
        var original = await db.Students.AsNoTracking().SingleAsync();
        original.FullName.Should().Be("Ana Pop");
        original.Email.Should().Be(email);
    }
}

===== tests\InternHub.Tests\Integration\Students\GetStudents\GetStudentsEndpointTests.cs =====

using System.Net;
using System.Net.Http.Json;
using FluentAssertions;
using InternHub.Api.Features.Students.CreateStudent;
using InternHub.Api.Infrastructure.Persistence;
using InternHub.Features.Students.GetStudents;
using InternHub.Tests.Integration.Infrastructure;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;

namespace InternHub.Tests.Integration.Students.GetStudents;

public sealed class GetStudentsEndpointTests
{
    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_EmptyDatabase_When_GettingStudents_Then_ReturnsOkAndEmptyArray()
    {
        // Arrange
        using var factory = new InternHubSqliteFactory();
        using var client = factory.CreateClient();

        // Act
        using var response = await client.GetAsync("/api/v1/students");
        var students = await response.Content.ReadFromJsonAsync<List<GetStudentsResponse>>();

        // Assert
        response.StatusCode.Should().Be(HttpStatusCode.OK);
        students.Should().NotBeNull();
        students.Should().BeEmpty();

        using var scope = factory.Services.CreateScope();
        var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<InternHubDbContext>();
        (await db.Students.AsNoTracking().CountAsync()).Should().Be(0);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_ExistingStudents_When_GettingStudents_Then_ReturnsAllStudentFields()
    {
        // Arrange
        using var factory = new InternHubSqliteFactory();
        using var client = factory.CreateClient();
        var firstEmail = $"first-{Guid.NewGuid()}@mail.com";
        var secondEmail = $"second-{Guid.NewGuid()}@mail.com";
        var firstResponse = await client.PostAsJsonAsync(
            "/api/v1/students",
            new CreateStudentRequest("Ana Pop", firstEmail));
        var secondResponse = await client.PostAsJsonAsync(
            "/api/v1/students",
            new CreateStudentRequest("Ion Pop", secondEmail));
        var first = await firstResponse.Content.ReadFromJsonAsync<CreateStudentResponse>();
        var second = await secondResponse.Content.ReadFromJsonAsync<CreateStudentResponse>();
        first.Should().NotBeNull();
        second.Should().NotBeNull();

        // Act
        using var response = await client.GetAsync("/api/v1/students");
        var students = await response.Content.ReadFromJsonAsync<List<GetStudentsResponse>>();

        // Assert
        response.StatusCode.Should().Be(HttpStatusCode.OK);
        students.Should().BeEquivalentTo(
            new[]
            {
                new GetStudentsResponse(first!.Id, "Ana Pop", firstEmail),
                new GetStudentsResponse(second!.Id, "Ion Pop", secondEmail)
            },
            options => options.WithoutStrictOrdering());

        using var scope = factory.Services.CreateScope();
        var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<InternHubDbContext>();
        var persisted = await db.Students.AsNoTracking().ToListAsync();
        persisted.Should().HaveCount(2);
        persisted.Select(student => student.Email)
            .Should().BeEquivalentTo(new[] { firstEmail, secondEmail });
    }
}


===== tests\InternHub.Tests\Integration\Students\UpdateStudent\UpdateStudentEndpointTests.cs =====

using System.Net;
using System.Net.Http.Json;
using FluentAssertions;
using InternHub.Api.Features.Students.CreateStudent;
using InternHub.Api.Features.Students.UpdateStudent;
using InternHub.Api.Infrastructure.Persistence;
using InternHub.Tests.Integration.Infrastructure;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;

namespace InternHub.Tests.Integration.Students.UpdateStudent;

public sealed class UpdateStudentEndpointTests
{
    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_ExistingStudent_When_UpdatingStudent_Then_ReturnsNoContentAndPersistsUpdatedFields()
    {
        // Arrange
        using var factory = new InternHubSqliteFactory();
        using var client = factory.CreateClient();
        var originalEmail = $"before-{Guid.NewGuid()}@mail.com";
        var updatedEmail = $"after-{Guid.NewGuid()}@mail.com";
        using var createResponse = await client.PostAsJsonAsync(
            "/api/v1/students",
            new CreateStudentRequest("Ana Pop", originalEmail));
        var created = await createResponse.Content.ReadFromJsonAsync<CreateStudentResponse>();
        created.Should().NotBeNull();

        // Act
        using var response = await client.PutAsJsonAsync(
            $"/api/v1/students/{created!.Id}",
            new UpdateStudentRequest("Ana Popescu", updatedEmail));

        // Assert
        response.StatusCode.Should().Be(HttpStatusCode.NoContent);
        response.Content.Headers.ContentLength.Should().Be(0);

        using var scope = factory.Services.CreateScope();
        var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<InternHubDbContext>();
        var persisted = await db.Students.AsNoTracking().SingleAsync(s => s.Id == created.Id);
        persisted.FullName.Should().Be("Ana Popescu");
        persisted.Email.Should().Be(updatedEmail);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_InvalidUpdateData_When_UpdatingStudent_Then_ReturnsBadRequestAndPreservesOriginalFields()
    {
        // Arrange
        using var factory = new InternHubSqliteFactory();
        using var client = factory.CreateClient();
        var originalEmail = $"preserve-{Guid.NewGuid()}@mail.com";
        using var createResponse = await client.PostAsJsonAsync(
            "/api/v1/students",
            new CreateStudentRequest("Ana Pop", originalEmail));
        var created = await createResponse.Content.ReadFromJsonAsync<CreateStudentResponse>();
        created.Should().NotBeNull();

        // Act
        using var response = await client.PutAsJsonAsync(
            $"/api/v1/students/{created!.Id}",
            new UpdateStudentRequest("", "invalid-email"));
        var error = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();

        // Assert
        response.StatusCode.Should().Be(HttpStatusCode.BadRequest);
        error.Should().Contain("Full name is required.");

        using var scope = factory.Services.CreateScope();
        var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<InternHubDbContext>();
        var persisted = await db.Students.AsNoTracking().SingleAsync(s => s.Id == created.Id);
        persisted.FullName.Should().Be("Ana Pop");
        persisted.Email.Should().Be(originalEmail);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_MissingStudent_When_UpdatingStudent_Then_ReturnsNotFound()
    {
        // Arrange
        using var factory = new InternHubSqliteFactory();
        using var client = factory.CreateClient();
        var studentId = Guid.NewGuid();

        // Act
        using var response = await client.PutAsJsonAsync(
            $"/api/v1/students/{studentId}",
            new UpdateStudentRequest("Ana Pop", $"missing-{Guid.NewGuid()}@mail.com"));
        var error = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();

        // Assert
        response.StatusCode.Should().Be(HttpStatusCode.NotFound);
        error.Should().Contain(studentId.ToString());

        using var scope = factory.Services.CreateScope();
        var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<InternHubDbContext>();
        (await db.Students.AsNoTracking().CountAsync()).Should().Be(0);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_EmailUsedByAnotherStudent_When_UpdatingStudent_Then_ReturnsConflictAndPreservesBothStudents()
    {
        // Arrange
        using var factory = new InternHubSqliteFactory();
        using var client = factory.CreateClient();
        var firstEmail = $"first-{Guid.NewGuid()}@mail.com";
        var secondEmail = $"second-{Guid.NewGuid()}@mail.com";
        var firstResponse = await client.PostAsJsonAsync(
            "/api/v1/students",
            new CreateStudentRequest("Ana Pop", firstEmail));
        var secondResponse = await client.PostAsJsonAsync(
            "/api/v1/students",
            new CreateStudentRequest("Ion Pop", secondEmail));
        var first = await firstResponse.Content.ReadFromJsonAsync<CreateStudentResponse>();
        var second = await secondResponse.Content.ReadFromJsonAsync<CreateStudentResponse>();
        first.Should().NotBeNull();
        second.Should().NotBeNull();

        // Act
        using var response = await client.PutAsJsonAsync(
            $"/api/v1/students/{second!.Id}",
            new UpdateStudentRequest("Ion Pop", firstEmail));

        // Assert
        response.StatusCode.Should().Be(HttpStatusCode.Conflict);
        (await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync()).Should().Contain("already exists");

        using var scope = factory.Services.CreateScope();
        var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<InternHubDbContext>();
        var persisted = await db.Students.AsNoTracking().OrderBy(s => s.FullName).ToListAsync();
        persisted.Should().HaveCount(2);
        persisted.Should().ContainSingle(s => s.FullName == "Ana Pop" && s.Email == firstEmail);
        persisted.Should().ContainSingle(s => s.FullName == "Ion Pop" && s.Email == secondEmail);
    }
}

using System.Net;

namespace InternHub.Tests.Integration.Students;

[Collection("Integration")]
public class StudentEndpointsTests(WebApplicationFactory<Program> factory)
    : IClassFixture<WebApplicationFactory<Program>>

    {
        var res = await _client.PostAsJsonAsync(

                "Ana Pop",

        Assert.NotNull(res.Headers.Location);
    }

            await _client.GetAsync($"/api/v1/students/{createdStudent.Id}");

            await _client.DeleteAsync($"/api/v1/students/{Guid.NewGuid()}");

===== tests\InternHub.Tests\Unit\AI\Baseline\KeywordRecruiterEvaluationServiceTests.cs =====

using FluentAssertions;
using InternHub.Api.Infrastructure.AI.Baseline;

namespace InternHub.Tests.Unit.AI.Baseline;

public sealed class KeywordRecruiterEvaluationServiceTests
{
    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_CVWithSomeRequiredSkills_When_Analyzing_Then_ReturnsMatchedAndMissingSkills()
    {
        // Arrange
        var service = new KeywordRecruiterEvaluationService();

        // Act
        var result = await service.AnalyzeAsync("I know Python and SQL.", "Python, SQL, Docker");

        // Assert
        result.MatchedSkills.Should().Equal("Python", "SQL");
        result.MissingSkills.Should().Equal("Docker");
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_JavaAndJavaScript_When_Analyzing_Then_DistinguishesTheSkills()
    {
        // Arrange
        var service = new KeywordRecruiterEvaluationService();

        // Act
        var result = await service.AnalyzeAsync("I know JavaScript.", "Java, JavaScript");

        // Assert
        result.MatchedSkills.Should().Equal("JavaScript");
        result.MissingSkills.Should().Equal("Java");
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_Java_When_AnalyzingJavaScriptRequirement_Then_DoesNotMatchJavaScript()
    {
        // Arrange
        var service = new KeywordRecruiterEvaluationService();

        // Act
        var result = await service.AnalyzeAsync("I know Java.", "JavaScript");

        // Assert
        result.MatchedSkills.Should().BeEmpty();
        result.MissingSkills.Should().Equal("JavaScript");
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_CSharpAndCpp_When_Analyzing_Then_DistinguishesSpecialCharacterSkills()
    {
        // Arrange
        var service = new KeywordRecruiterEvaluationService();

        // Act
        var result = await service.AnalyzeAsync("I know C#.", "C#, C++");

        // Assert
        result.MatchedSkills.Should().Equal("C#");
        result.MissingSkills.Should().Equal("C++");
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_DotNetAndJavaScriptRequirements_When_Analyzing_Then_MatchesRecognizedSkillsExactly()
    {
        // Arrange
        var service = new KeywordRecruiterEvaluationService();

        // Act
        var result = await service.AnalyzeAsync(
            "I developed web applications with .NET and JavaScript.",
            "Experience with .NET and JavaScript is required.");

        // Assert
        result.MatchedSkills.Should().Equal("JavaScript", ".NET");
        result.MissingSkills.Should().BeEmpty();
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData("Python")]
    [InlineData("PYTHON")]
    [InlineData("python")]
    public async Task Given_PythonInDifferentCasing_When_Analyzing_Then_RecognizesTheSkill(string cvSkill)
    {
        // Arrange
        var service = new KeywordRecruiterEvaluationService();

        // Act
        var result = await service.AnalyzeAsync(cvSkill, "Python");

        // Assert
        result.MatchedSkills.Should().Equal("Python");
        result.MissingSkills.Should().BeEmpty();
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_DuplicateSkillMentions_When_Analyzing_Then_ReturnsEachSkillOnce()
    {
        // Arrange
        var service = new KeywordRecruiterEvaluationService();

        // Act
        var result = await service.AnalyzeAsync(
            "Python, python and PYTHON are skills I use.",
            "Python, Python, python");

        // Assert
        result.MatchedSkills.Should().Equal("Python");
        result.MissingSkills.Should().BeEmpty();
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_EmptyCV_When_Analyzing_Then_ReportsRecognizedRequirementsAsMissing()
    {
        // Arrange
        var service = new KeywordRecruiterEvaluationService();

        // Act
        var result = await service.AnalyzeAsync(string.Empty, "Python, SQL, Docker");

        // Assert
        result.MatchedSkills.Should().BeEmpty();
        result.MissingSkills.Should().Equal("Python", "SQL", "Docker");
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_EmptyRequirements_When_Analyzing_Then_ReturnsEmptySkillListsAndInformativeSummary()
    {
        // Arrange
        var service = new KeywordRecruiterEvaluationService();

        // Act
        var result = await service.AnalyzeAsync("Python and SQL", string.Empty);

        // Assert
        result.MatchedSkills.Should().BeEmpty();
        result.MissingSkills.Should().BeEmpty();
        result.Summary.Should().Contain("No recognized skills");
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_NullCvContent_When_Analyzing_Then_ThrowsArgumentNullException()
    {
        // Arrange
        var service = new KeywordRecruiterEvaluationService();

        // Act
        var action = () => service.AnalyzeAsync(null!, "Python");

        // Assert
        await action.Should().ThrowAsync<ArgumentNullException>()
            .WithParameterName("cvContent");
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_NullOfferRequirements_When_Analyzing_Then_ThrowsArgumentNullException()
    {
        // Arrange
        var service = new KeywordRecruiterEvaluationService();

        // Act
        var action = () => service.AnalyzeAsync("Python", null!);

        // Assert
        await action.Should().ThrowAsync<ArgumentNullException>()
            .WithParameterName("offerRequirements");
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_SameInputTwice_When_Analyzing_Then_ReturnsIdenticalResults()
    {
        // Arrange
        var service = new KeywordRecruiterEvaluationService();
        const string cvContent = "Python, SQL and Docker";
        const string offerRequirements = "Python, SQL, Docker, React";

        // Act
        var firstResult = await service.AnalyzeAsync(cvContent, offerRequirements);
        var secondResult = await service.AnalyzeAsync(cvContent, offerRequirements);

        // Assert
        secondResult.Should().BeEquivalentTo(firstResult);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_MissingSkills_When_Analyzing_Then_ReturnsCoherentSuggestionsAndSummary()
    {
        // Arrange
        var service = new KeywordRecruiterEvaluationService();

        // Act
        var result = await service.AnalyzeAsync("Python", "Python, Docker, React");

        // Assert
        result.Suggestions.Should().HaveCount(result.MissingSkills.Count);
        result.Suggestions.Should().Contain(suggestion => suggestion.Contains("Docker"));
        result.Suggestions.Should().Contain(suggestion => suggestion.Contains("React"));
        result.Summary.Should().Contain("Matched 1 of 3");
        result.Summary.Should().Contain("2 skill(s) are missing");
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_AlreadyCanceledToken_When_Analyzing_Then_ThrowsOperationCanceledException()
    {
        // Arrange
        var service = new KeywordRecruiterEvaluationService();
        using var cancellationSource = new CancellationTokenSource();
        cancellationSource.Cancel();

        // Act
        var action = () => service.AnalyzeAsync("Python", "Python", cancellationSource.Token);

        // Assert
        await action.Should().ThrowAsync<OperationCanceledException>();
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_SqlInsideLongerWord_When_Analyzing_Then_DoesNotMatchSql()
    {
        // Arrange
        var service = new KeywordRecruiterEvaluationService();

        // Act
        var result = await service.AnalyzeAsync("I worked with SQLServer.", "SQL");

        // Assert
        result.MatchedSkills.Should().BeEmpty();
        result.MissingSkills.Should().Equal("SQL");
    }

===== tests\InternHub.Tests\Unit\AI\Evaluation\Dataset\EvaluationDatasetLoaderTests.cs =====

using System.Text.Json;
using FluentAssertions;
using InternHub.Tests.AI.Evaluation.Dataset;

namespace InternHub.Tests.Unit.AI.Evaluation.Dataset;

/// <summary>Unit tests for EvaluationDatasetLoader.</summary>
public sealed class EvaluationDatasetLoaderTests
{
    private const string ValidJson = """
        {
          "datasetVersion": "test-1",
          "synthetic": true,
          "aliases": { "csharp": "c#" },
          "cases": [
            {
              "id": "negation-01",
              "category": "Negation",
              "cvText": "Fictional CV text.",
              "requirementsText": "We need C# and Docker.",
              "requiredSkills": ["c#", "docker"],
              "expectedMatched": ["c#"],
              "expectedMissing": ["docker"],
              "rationale": "Docker is named only to state it is missing."
            }
          ]
        }
        """;

    [Fact]
    public void Given_ValidJson_When_Parsing_Then_ReturnsDatasetWithAllFields()
    {
        // Arrange
        var json = ValidJson;

        // Act
        var dataset = EvaluationDatasetLoader.Parse(json);

        // Assert
        dataset.DatasetVersion.Should().Be("test-1");
        dataset.Synthetic.Should().BeTrue();
        dataset.Aliases.Should().Equal(new Dictionary<string, string> { ["csharp"] = "c#" });
        dataset.Cases.Should().ContainSingle()
            .Which.Should().BeEquivalentTo(new EvaluationCase(
                "negation-01",
                EvaluationCategory.Negation,
                "Fictional CV text.",
                "We need C# and Docker.",
                ["c#", "docker"],
                ["c#"],
                ["docker"],
                "Docker is named only to state it is missing."));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Given_MalformedJson_When_Parsing_Then_ThrowsInvalidOperationException()
    {
        // Arrange
        var json = "{ \"datasetVersion\": ";

        // Act
        var parse = () => EvaluationDatasetLoader.Parse(json);

        // Assert
        parse.Should().Throw<InvalidOperationException>()
            .WithMessage("Evaluation dataset JSON is malformed*")
            .WithInnerException<JsonException>();
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Given_UnknownCategory_When_Parsing_Then_ThrowsInvalidOperationExceptionNamingCategoryPath()
    {
        // Arrange
        var json = ValidJson.Replace("\"Negation\"", "\"Sarcasm\"");

        // Act
        var parse = () => EvaluationDatasetLoader.Parse(json);

        // Assert
        parse.Should().Throw<InvalidOperationException>()
            .WithMessage("*$.cases[0].category*");
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Given_EmptyCaseList_When_Parsing_Then_ThrowsInvalidOperationException()
    {
        // Arrange
        var json = """{ "datasetVersion": "test-1", "synthetic": true, "aliases": {}, "cases": [] }""";

        // Act
        var parse = () => EvaluationDatasetLoader.Parse(json);

        // Assert
        parse.Should().Throw<InvalidOperationException>()
            .WithMessage("Evaluation dataset contains no cases.");
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Given_MissingCaseList_When_Parsing_Then_ThrowsInvalidOperationException()
    {
        // Arrange
        var json = """{ "datasetVersion": "test-1", "synthetic": true, "aliases": {} }""";

        // Act
        var parse = () => EvaluationDatasetLoader.Parse(json);

        // Assert
        parse.Should().Throw<InvalidOperationException>()
            .WithMessage("Evaluation dataset contains no cases.");
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Given_NonExistentPath_When_Loading_Then_ThrowsFileNotFoundExceptionNamingPath()
    {
        // Arrange
        var path = Path.Combine(AppContext.BaseDirectory, $"missing-dataset-{Guid.NewGuid():N}.json");

        // Act
        var load = () => EvaluationDatasetLoader.Load(path);

        // Assert
        load.Should().Throw<FileNotFoundException>()
            .Where(exception => exception.FileName == path && exception.Message.Contains(path));
    }
}


===== tests\InternHub.Tests\Unit\AI\Evaluation\Dataset\EvaluationDatasetTests.cs =====

using System.Text.RegularExpressions;
using FluentAssertions;
using InternHub.Tests.AI.Evaluation.Dataset;
using InternHub.Tests.AI.Evaluation.Metrics.Core;

namespace InternHub.Tests.Unit.AI.Evaluation.Dataset;

/// <summary>Unit tests for EvaluationDataset.</summary>
public sealed class EvaluationDatasetTests
{
    private static readonly EvaluationDataset Dataset = EvaluationDatasetLoader.Load();

    private static readonly SkillNormalizer Normalizer = new(Dataset.Aliases);

    public static TheoryData<string> CaseIds() => new(Dataset.Cases.Select(evaluationCase => evaluationCase.Id));

    [Fact]
    public void Given_DatasetFile_When_Loading_Then_IsMarkedSynthetic()
    {
        // Arrange
        var path = EvaluationDatasetLoader.DefaultPath;

        // Act
        var dataset = EvaluationDatasetLoader.Load(path);

        // Assert
        dataset.Synthetic.Should().BeTrue();
        dataset.DatasetVersion.Should().NotBeNullOrWhiteSpace();
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Given_Dataset_When_ReadingCaseIds_Then_IdsAreUnique()
    {
        // Arrange
        var cases = Dataset.Cases;

        // Act
        var ids = cases.Select(evaluationCase => evaluationCase.Id).ToList();

        // Assert
        ids.Should().OnlyHaveUniqueItems();
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Given_Dataset_When_CountingCases_Then_ContainsExactlyFifteen()
    {
        // Arrange
        var cases = Dataset.Cases;

        // Act
        var count = cases.Count;

        // Assert
        count.Should().Be(15);
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData(EvaluationCategory.Clear, 3)]
    [InlineData(EvaluationCategory.Synonyms, 2)]
    [InlineData(EvaluationCategory.Negation, 2)]
    [InlineData(EvaluationCategory.Implicit, 2)]
    [InlineData(EvaluationCategory.Noise, 2)]
    [InlineData(EvaluationCategory.Minimal, 2)]
    [InlineData(EvaluationCategory.PromptInjection, 2)]
    public void Given_Dataset_When_CountingCasesPerCategory_Then_MatchesRequiredDistribution(
        EvaluationCategory category,
        int expectedCount)
    {
        // Arrange
        var cases = Dataset.Cases;

        // Act
        var count = cases.Count(evaluationCase => evaluationCase.Category == category);

        // Assert
        count.Should().Be(expectedCount);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Given_Aliases_When_ComparingTargetsWithKeys_Then_NoTargetIsAlsoAnAlias()
    {
        // Arrange
        var aliases = Dataset.Aliases;

        // Act
        var chainedTargets = aliases.Values.Intersect(aliases.Keys).ToList();

        // Assert
        chainedTargets.Should().BeEmpty();
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Given_Aliases_When_CheckingKeysAndTargets_Then_AllAreTrimmedAndLowercase()
    {
        // Arrange
        var aliases = Dataset.Aliases;

        // Act
        var unnormalizedValues = aliases.Keys
            .Concat(aliases.Values)
            .Where(value => value != value.Trim().ToLowerInvariant())
            .ToList();

        // Assert
        unnormalizedValues.Should().BeEmpty();
    }

    [Theory]
    [MemberData(nameof(CaseIds))]
    public void Given_Case_When_ReadingId_Then_IsPrefixedByKebabCaseCategory(string caseId)
    {
        // Arrange
        var evaluationCase = FindCase(caseId);
        var prefix = Regex.Replace(evaluationCase.Category.ToString(), "(?<!^)([A-Z])", "-$1").ToLowerInvariant();

        // Act
        var matchesPattern = Regex.IsMatch(caseId, $"^{Regex.Escape(prefix)}-[0-9]{{2}}$");

        // Assert
        matchesPattern.Should().BeTrue($"'{caseId}' must be '{prefix}-NN'");
    }

    [Theory]
    [MemberData(nameof(CaseIds))]
    public void Given_Case_When_NormalizingLabels_Then_MatchedAndMissingAreDisjoint(string caseId)
    {
        // Arrange
        var evaluationCase = FindCase(caseId);
        var matched = Normalizer.ToSet(evaluationCase.ExpectedMatched);
        var missing = Normalizer.ToSet(evaluationCase.ExpectedMissing);

        // Act
        var overlap = matched.Intersect(missing).ToList();

        // Assert
        overlap.Should().BeEmpty();
    }

    [Theory]
    [MemberData(nameof(CaseIds))]
    public void Given_Case_When_NormalizingLabels_Then_UnionEqualsRequiredSkills(string caseId)
    {
        // Arrange
        var evaluationCase = FindCase(caseId);
        var required = Normalizer.ToSet(evaluationCase.RequiredSkills);

        // Act
        var union = Normalizer.ToSet(evaluationCase.ExpectedMatched.Concat(evaluationCase.ExpectedMissing));

        // Assert
        union.Should().BeEquivalentTo(required);
    }

    [Theory]
    [MemberData(nameof(CaseIds))]
    public void Given_Case_When_SearchingRequirementsText_Then_EveryRequiredSkillOrAliasOccurs(string caseId)
    {
        // Arrange
        var evaluationCase = FindCase(caseId);
        var requirements = evaluationCase.RequirementsText.ToLowerInvariant();

        // Act
        var absentSkills = evaluationCase.RequiredSkills
            .Where(skill => !SpellingsOf(skill).Any(spelling => requirements.Contains(spelling, StringComparison.Ordinal)))
            .ToList();

        // Assert
        absentSkills.Should().BeEmpty();
    }

    [Theory]
    [MemberData(nameof(CaseIds))]
    public void Given_Case_When_ReadingRationale_Then_IsNotBlank(string caseId)
    {
        // Arrange
        var evaluationCase = FindCase(caseId);

        // Act
        var rationale = evaluationCase.Rationale;

        // Assert
        rationale.Should().NotBeNullOrWhiteSpace();
    }

    private static EvaluationCase FindCase(string caseId) =>
        Dataset.Cases.Single(evaluationCase => evaluationCase.Id == caseId);

    private static IEnumerable<string> SpellingsOf(string skill)
    {
        var canonical = Normalizer.Normalize(skill);

        return Dataset.Aliases
            .Where(alias => Normalizer.Normalize(alias.Value) == canonical)
            .Select(alias => alias.Key.ToLowerInvariant())
            .Append(canonical);
    }
}


===== tests\InternHub.Tests\Unit\AI\Evaluation\Metrics\Aggregation\CategoryBreakdownTests.cs =====

using FluentAssertions;
using InternHub.Api.Features.RecruiterEvaluation;
using InternHub.Tests.AI.Evaluation.Dataset;
using InternHub.Tests.AI.Evaluation.Metrics.Aggregation;
using InternHub.Tests.AI.Evaluation.Metrics.Core;
using InternHub.Tests.AI.Evaluation.Metrics.Strategies;
using InternHub.Tests.Unit.AI.Evaluation.TestDoubles;

namespace InternHub.Tests.Unit.AI.Evaluation.Metrics.Aggregation;

/// <summary>Unit tests for CategoryBreakdown.</summary>
public sealed class CategoryBreakdownTests
{
    private static readonly SkillNormalizer Normalizer = new(new Dictionary<string, string>());

    private static CategoryBreakdown CreateBreakdown() =>
        new(new MetricAggregator(CaseMetrics.Default, [SkillList.Matched, SkillList.Missing], Normalizer));

    // Clear: two perfect predictions; Negation: one disjoint prediction.
    private static List<(EvaluationCase Case, RecruiterEvaluationResult Result)> MixedCategories() =>
    [
        (EvaluationCaseBuilder.With(["c#"], []) with { Id = "clear-01" },
            new RecruiterEvaluationResult(["c#"], [], [], "Summary.")),
        (EvaluationCaseBuilder.With(["sql"], []) with { Id = "clear-02" },
            new RecruiterEvaluationResult(["sql"], [], [], "Summary.")),
        (EvaluationCaseBuilder.With(["docker"], []) with { Id = "negation-01", Category = EvaluationCategory.Negation },
            new RecruiterEvaluationResult(["java"], [], [], "Summary."))
    ];

    [Fact]
    public void Given_TwoCategories_When_Aggregating_Then_ReturnsOneEntryPerCategoryPresent()
    {
        // Arrange
        var breakdown = CreateBreakdown();
        var pairs = MixedCategories();

        // Act
        var scores = breakdown.Aggregate(pairs);

        // Assert
        scores.Keys.Should().BeEquivalentTo([EvaluationCategory.Clear, EvaluationCategory.Negation]);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Given_TwoCategories_When_Aggregating_Then_ClearUsesOnlyItsOwnCases()
    {
        // Arrange
        var breakdown = CreateBreakdown();
        var pairs = MixedCategories();

        // Act
        var clear = breakdown.Aggregate(pairs)[EvaluationCategory.Clear];

        // Assert
        clear.CaseCount.Should().Be(2);
        clear.Macro["Matched F1"].Should().BeApproximately(1, 0.0001);
        clear.Micro["Matched"].Should().Be(new ConfusionCounts(2, 0, 0));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Given_TwoCategories_When_Aggregating_Then_NegationUsesOnlyItsOwnCases()
    {
        // Arrange
        var breakdown = CreateBreakdown();
        var pairs = MixedCategories();

        // Act
        var negation = breakdown.Aggregate(pairs)[EvaluationCategory.Negation];

        // Assert
        negation.CaseCount.Should().Be(1);
        negation.Macro["Matched F1"].Should().BeApproximately(0, 0.0001);
        negation.Micro["Matched"].Should().Be(new ConfusionCounts(0, 1, 1));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Given_NoPairs_When_Aggregating_Then_ReturnsEmptyBreakdown()
    {
        // Arrange
        var breakdown = CreateBreakdown();
        List<(EvaluationCase Case, RecruiterEvaluationResult Result)> pairs = [];

        // Act
        var scores = breakdown.Aggregate(pairs);

        // Assert
        scores.Should().BeEmpty();
    }
}


===== tests\InternHub.Tests\Unit\AI\Evaluation\Metrics\Aggregation\MetricAggregatorTests.cs =====

using FluentAssertions;
using InternHub.Api.Features.RecruiterEvaluation;
using InternHub.Tests.AI.Evaluation.Dataset;
using InternHub.Tests.AI.Evaluation.Metrics.Aggregation;
using InternHub.Tests.AI.Evaluation.Metrics.Core;
using InternHub.Tests.AI.Evaluation.Metrics.Strategies;
using InternHub.Tests.Unit.AI.Evaluation.TestDoubles;

namespace InternHub.Tests.Unit.AI.Evaluation.Metrics.Aggregation;

/// <summary>Unit tests for MetricAggregator.</summary>
public sealed class MetricAggregatorTests
{
    private static readonly SkillNormalizer Normalizer = new(new Dictionary<string, string>());

    private static MetricAggregator CreateAggregator() =>
        new(CaseMetrics.Default, [SkillList.Matched, SkillList.Missing], Normalizer);

    // Case A: expected {a}, predicted {a}             -> TP 1, FP 0, FN 0; P 1,    R 1,      F1 1
    // Case B: expected {b, c, d}, predicted {b, x, y, z} -> TP 1, FP 3, FN 2; P 0.25, R 0.3333, F1 0.2857
    private static List<(EvaluationCase Case, RecruiterEvaluationResult Result)> TwoCases() =>
    [
        (EvaluationCaseBuilder.With(["a"], []),
            new RecruiterEvaluationResult(["a"], [], [], "Summary A.")),
        (EvaluationCaseBuilder.With(["b", "c", "d"], []),
            new RecruiterEvaluationResult(["b", "x", "y", "z"], [], [], "Summary B."))
    ];

    [Fact]
    public void Given_TwoCases_When_Aggregating_Then_MacroAveragesPerCaseMatchedScores()
    {
        // Arrange
        var aggregator = CreateAggregator();
        var pairs = TwoCases();

        // Act
        var scores = aggregator.Aggregate(pairs);

        // Assert
        scores.Macro["Matched precision"].Should().BeApproximately(0.625, 0.0001);
        scores.Macro["Matched recall"].Should().BeApproximately(0.6667, 0.0001);
        scores.Macro["Matched F1"].Should().BeApproximately(0.6429, 0.0001);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Given_TwoCases_When_Aggregating_Then_MicroComputesFromSummedMatchedCounts()
    {
        // Arrange
        var aggregator = CreateAggregator();
        var pairs = TwoCases();

        // Act
        var scores = aggregator.Aggregate(pairs);

        // Assert
        var matched = scores.Micro["Matched"];
        matched.Should().Be(new ConfusionCounts(2, 3, 2));
        matched.Precision.Should().BeApproximately(0.4, 0.0001);
        matched.Recall.Should().BeApproximately(0.5, 0.0001);
        matched.F1.Should().BeApproximately(0.4444, 0.0001);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Given_NoMissingSkillsExpectedOrPredicted_When_Aggregating_Then_MicroMissingScoresAreOne()
    {
        // Arrange
        var aggregator = CreateAggregator();
        var pairs = TwoCases();

        // Act
        var scores = aggregator.Aggregate(pairs);

        // Assert
        var missing = scores.Micro["Missing"];
        missing.Should().Be(ConfusionCounts.Zero);
        missing.Precision.Should().BeApproximately(1, 0.0001);
        missing.Recall.Should().BeApproximately(1, 0.0001);
        missing.F1.Should().BeApproximately(1, 0.0001);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Given_DefaultMetrics_When_Aggregating_Then_ReportsOneMacroValuePerMetricAndCaseCount()
    {
        // Arrange
        var aggregator = CreateAggregator();
        var pairs = TwoCases();

        // Act
        var scores = aggregator.Aggregate(pairs);

        // Assert
        scores.CaseCount.Should().Be(2);
        scores.Macro.Keys.Should().BeEquivalentTo(
            "Matched precision",
            "Matched recall",
            "Matched F1",
            "Missing precision",
            "Missing recall",
            "Missing F1",
            "Field completeness",
            "Hallucination rate",
            "Contradiction",
            "Coverage");
        scores.Micro.Keys.Should().BeEquivalentTo("Matched", "Missing");
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Given_NoPairs_When_Aggregating_Then_ThrowsArgumentException()
    {
        // Arrange
        var aggregator = CreateAggregator();
        List<(EvaluationCase Case, RecruiterEvaluationResult Result)> pairs = [];

        // Act
        var aggregate = () => aggregator.Aggregate(pairs);

        // Assert
        aggregate.Should().Throw<ArgumentException>()
            .WithParameterName("pairs");
    }
}


===== tests\InternHub.Tests\Unit\AI\Evaluation\Metrics\Core\ConfusionCountsTests.cs =====

using FluentAssertions;
using InternHub.Api.Features.RecruiterEvaluation;
using InternHub.Tests.AI.Evaluation.Dataset;
using InternHub.Tests.AI.Evaluation.Metrics.Core;
using InternHub.Tests.Unit.AI.Evaluation.TestDoubles;

namespace InternHub.Tests.Unit.AI.Evaluation.Metrics.Core;

/// <summary>Unit tests for ConfusionCounts.</summary>
public sealed class ConfusionCountsTests
{
    private static readonly SkillNormalizer Normalizer =
        new(new Dictionary<string, string> { ["csharp"] = "c#" });

    [Fact]
    public void Given_PartialOverlap_When_Counting_Then_ReturnsTruePositivesFalsePositivesAndFalseNegatives()
    {
        // Arrange
        var evaluationCase = EvaluationCaseBuilder.With(["c#", "sql", "docker"], []);
        var result = new RecruiterEvaluationResult(["c#", "java"], [], [], "Summary.");

        // Act
        var counts = ConfusionCounts.For(evaluationCase, result, Normalizer, SkillList.Matched);

        // Assert
        counts.Should().Be(new ConfusionCounts(1, 1, 2));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Given_PredictionsDifferingByCaseWhitespaceAliasAndDuplicates_When_Counting_Then_CountsEachSkillOnce()
    {
        // Arrange
        var evaluationCase = EvaluationCaseBuilder.With(["c#", "sql"], []);
        var result = new RecruiterEvaluationResult([" C# ", "csharp", "SQL", "sql"], [], [], "Summary.");

        // Act
        var counts = ConfusionCounts.For(evaluationCase, result, Normalizer, SkillList.Matched);

        // Assert
        counts.Should().Be(new ConfusionCounts(2, 0, 0));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Given_TwoCounts_When_Adding_Then_SumsEachComponent()
    {
        // Arrange
        var left = new ConfusionCounts(1, 2, 3);
        var right = new ConfusionCounts(4, 5, 6);

        // Act
        var sum = left + right;

        // Assert
        sum.Should().Be(new ConfusionCounts(5, 7, 9));
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData(0, 0, 0, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0)]
    [InlineData(0, 0, 2, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0)]
    [InlineData(0, 3, 0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0)]
    [InlineData(2, 3, 2, 0.4, 0.5, 0.4444)]
    public void Given_Counts_When_ComputingScores_Then_FollowsDefinitionsAndEmptySetConventions(
        int truePositives,
        int falsePositives,
        int falseNegatives,
        double expectedPrecision,
        double expectedRecall,
        double expectedF1)
    {
        // Arrange
        var counts = new ConfusionCounts(truePositives, falsePositives, falseNegatives);

        // Act
        var scores = (counts.Precision, counts.Recall, counts.F1);

        // Assert
        scores.Precision.Should().BeApproximately(expectedPrecision, 0.0001);
        scores.Recall.Should().BeApproximately(expectedRecall, 0.0001);
        scores.F1.Should().BeApproximately(expectedF1, 0.0001);
    }
}


===== tests\InternHub.Tests\Unit\AI\Evaluation\Metrics\Core\RatioTests.cs =====

using FluentAssertions;
using InternHub.Tests.AI.Evaluation.Metrics.Core;

namespace InternHub.Tests.Unit.AI.Evaluation.Metrics.Core;

/// <summary>Unit tests for Ratio.</summary>
public sealed class RatioTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void Given_NonZeroDenominator_When_Dividing_Then_ReturnsQuotient()
    {
        // Arrange
        var numerator = 1;
        var denominator = 4;

        // Act
        var value = Ratio.Divide(numerator, denominator, 1);

        // Assert
        value.Should().BeApproximately(0.25, 0.0001);
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData(0.0)]
    [InlineData(1.0)]
    public void Given_ZeroDenominator_When_Dividing_Then_ReturnsGivenEmptySetValue(double whenDenominatorIsZero)
    {
        // Arrange
        var numerator = 0;
        var denominator = 0;

        // Act
        var value = Ratio.Divide(numerator, denominator, whenDenominatorIsZero);

        // Assert
        value.Should().BeApproximately(whenDenominatorIsZero, 0.0001);
    }
}


===== tests\InternHub.Tests\Unit\AI\Evaluation\Metrics\Core\SkillNormalizerTests.cs =====

using FluentAssertions;
using InternHub.Tests.AI.Evaluation.Metrics.Core;

namespace InternHub.Tests.Unit.AI.Evaluation.Metrics.Core;

/// <summary>Unit tests for SkillNormalizer.</summary>
public sealed class SkillNormalizerTests
{
    private static readonly IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> Aliases =
        new Dictionary<string, string>
        {
            ["csharp"] = "c#",
            ["js"] = "javascript"
        };

    [Theory]
    [InlineData("  Docker ", "docker")]
    [InlineData("SQL", "sql")]
    [InlineData("\tGit\n", "git")]
    public void Given_SkillWithCaseAndWhitespace_When_Normalizing_Then_ReturnsTrimmedLowercase(
        string skill,
        string expected)
    {
        // Arrange
        var normalizer = new SkillNormalizer(Aliases);

        // Act
        var normalized = normalizer.Normalize(skill);

        // Assert
        normalized.Should().Be(expected);
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData("csharp", "c#")]
    [InlineData("js", "javascript")]
    public void Given_Alias_When_Normalizing_Then_ReturnsCanonicalSkill(string skill, string expected)
    {
        // Arrange
        var normalizer = new SkillNormalizer(Aliases);

        // Act
        var normalized = normalizer.Normalize(skill);

        // Assert
        normalized.Should().Be(expected);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Given_AliasWithCaseAndWhitespace_When_Normalizing_Then_ReturnsCanonicalSkill()
    {
        // Arrange
        var normalizer = new SkillNormalizer(Aliases);

        // Act
        var normalized = normalizer.Normalize("  CSharp ");

        // Assert
        normalized.Should().Be("c#");
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Given_SkillWithoutAlias_When_Normalizing_Then_ReturnsSkillUnchanged()
    {
        // Arrange
        var normalizer = new SkillNormalizer(Aliases);

        // Act
        var normalized = normalizer.Normalize("kubernetes");

        // Assert
        normalized.Should().Be("kubernetes");
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Given_DuplicatesDifferingByCaseAndAlias_When_ConvertingToSet_Then_RemovesDuplicates()
    {
        // Arrange
        var normalizer = new SkillNormalizer(Aliases);
        string[] skills = ["C#", "csharp", " c# ", "Docker", "docker"];

        // Act
        var set = normalizer.ToSet(skills);

        // Assert
        set.Should().BeEquivalentTo(["c#", "docker"]);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Given_EmptyList_When_ConvertingToSet_Then_ReturnsEmptySet()
    {
        // Arrange
        var normalizer = new SkillNormalizer(Aliases);
        string[] skills = [];

        // Act
        var set = normalizer.ToSet(skills);

        // Assert
        set.Should().BeEmpty();
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Given_NullAliasMap_When_Constructing_Then_ThrowsArgumentNullException()
    {
        // Arrange
        IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> aliases = null!;

        // Act
        var construct = () => new SkillNormalizer(aliases);

        // Assert
        construct.Should().Throw<ArgumentNullException>()
            .WithParameterName("aliases");
    }
}


===== tests\InternHub.Tests\Unit\AI\Evaluation\Metrics\Stability\StabilityCalculatorTests.cs =====

using FluentAssertions;
using InternHub.Api.Features.RecruiterEvaluation;
using InternHub.Tests.AI.Evaluation.Metrics.Core;
using InternHub.Tests.AI.Evaluation.Metrics.Stability;

namespace InternHub.Tests.Unit.AI.Evaluation.Metrics.Stability;

/// <summary>Unit tests for StabilityCalculator.</summary>
public sealed class StabilityCalculatorTests
{
    private static readonly SkillNormalizer Normalizer =
        new(new Dictionary<string, string> { ["csharp"] = "c#" });

    private static RecruiterEvaluationResult Run(string[] matched, string[] missing) =>
        new(matched, missing, ["Suggestion."], "Summary.");

    [Fact]
    public void Given_ThreeIdenticalRuns_When_ComputingMatchedStability_Then_ReturnsOne()
    {
        // Arrange
        var calculator = new StabilityCalculator(Normalizer);
        RecruiterEvaluationResult[] runs = [Run(["a", "b"], []), Run(["a", "b"], []), Run(["a", "b"], [])];

        // Act
        var value = calculator.Compute(runs, SkillList.Matched);

        // Assert
        value.Should().BeApproximately(1, 0.0001);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Given_RunsAbAbA_When_ComputingMatchedStability_Then_ReturnsMeanPairwiseJaccard()
    {
        // Arrange
        // Pairs: {a,b}-{a,b} = 1, {a,b}-{a} = 0.5, {a,b}-{a} = 0.5 -> (1 + 0.5 + 0.5) / 3
        var calculator = new StabilityCalculator(Normalizer);
        RecruiterEvaluationResult[] runs = [Run(["a", "b"], []), Run(["a", "b"], []), Run(["a"], [])];

        // Act
        var value = calculator.Compute(runs, SkillList.Matched);

        // Assert
        value.Should().BeApproximately(0.6667, 0.0001);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Given_TwoEmptySets_When_ComputingMatchedStability_Then_ReturnsOne()
    {
        // Arrange
        var calculator = new StabilityCalculator(Normalizer);
        RecruiterEvaluationResult[] runs = [Run([], ["c"]), Run([], ["c"])];

        // Act
        var value = calculator.Compute(runs, SkillList.Matched);

        // Assert
        value.Should().BeApproximately(1, 0.0001);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Given_RunsDifferingByCaseWhitespaceAndAlias_When_ComputingMatchedStability_Then_ReturnsOne()
    {
        // Arrange
        var calculator = new StabilityCalculator(Normalizer);
        RecruiterEvaluationResult[] runs = [Run(["C#"], []), Run([" csharp "], [])];

        // Act
        var value = calculator.Compute(runs, SkillList.Matched);

        // Assert
        value.Should().BeApproximately(1, 0.0001);
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData(0)]
    [InlineData(1)]
    public void Given_FewerThanTwoResults_When_ComputingStability_Then_ThrowsArgumentException(int count)
    {
        // Arrange
        var calculator = new StabilityCalculator(Normalizer);
        var runs = Enumerable.Repeat(Run(["a"], []), count).ToList();

        // Act
        var compute = () => calculator.Compute(runs, SkillList.Matched);

        // Assert
        compute.Should().Throw<ArgumentException>()
            .WithParameterName("results");
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Given_RunsDifferingOnlyInMatched_When_ComputingForCase_Then_ScoresMatchedAndMissingSeparately()
    {
        // Arrange
        // Matched: {a,b}-{a} = 0.5; Missing: {c}-{c} = 1
        var calculator = new StabilityCalculator(Normalizer);
        RecruiterEvaluationResult[] runs = [Run(["a", "b"], ["c"]), Run(["a"], ["c"])];

        // Act
        var scores = calculator.ComputeForCase(runs);

        // Assert
        scores.Matched.Should().BeApproximately(0.5, 0.0001);
        scores.Missing.Should().BeApproximately(1, 0.0001);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Given_TwoCases_When_ComputingMeanOverCases_Then_AveragesPerCaseScores()
    {
        // Arrange
        // Case 1: matched {a}-{a} = 1, missing {b}-{b} = 1
        // Case 2: matched {a,b}-{a} = 0.5, missing {c}-{d} = 0
        var calculator = new StabilityCalculator(Normalizer);
        IReadOnlyList<RecruiterEvaluationResult>[] resultsPerCase =
        [
            [Run(["a"], ["b"]), Run(["a"], ["b"])],
            [Run(["a", "b"], ["c"]), Run(["a"], ["d"])]
        ];

        // Act
        var scores = calculator.MeanOverCases(resultsPerCase);

        // Assert
        scores.Matched.Should().BeApproximately(0.75, 0.0001);
        scores.Missing.Should().BeApproximately(0.5, 0.0001);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Given_NoCases_When_ComputingMeanOverCases_Then_ThrowsArgumentException()
    {
        // Arrange
        var calculator = new StabilityCalculator(Normalizer);
        IReadOnlyList<RecruiterEvaluationResult>[] resultsPerCase = [];

        // Act
        var compute = () => calculator.MeanOverCases(resultsPerCase);

        // Assert
        compute.Should().Throw<ArgumentException>()
            .WithParameterName("resultsPerCase");
    }
}

using FluentAssertions;
using InternHub.Api.Features.RecruiterEvaluation;

/// <summary>Unit tests for ConfusionMetric.</summary>
public sealed class ConfusionMetricTests
{
    private static readonly SkillNormalizer AliasNormalizer =
        new(new Dictionary<string, string> { ["csharp"] = "c#" });

    private static readonly SkillNormalizer NoAliasNormalizer =
        new(new Dictionary<string, string>());

    private static readonly IReadOnlyDictionary<string, Func<SkillList, ConfusionMetric>> Factories =
        new Dictionary<string, Func<SkillList, ConfusionMetric>>
        {
            ["Precision"] = ConfusionMetric.Precision,
            ["Recall"] = ConfusionMetric.Recall,
            ["F1"] = ConfusionMetric.F1
        };

    private static readonly IReadOnlyDictionary<string, SkillList> Lists =
        new Dictionary<string, SkillList>
        {
            ["Matched"] = SkillList.Matched,
            ["Missing"] = SkillList.Missing
        };

    [Fact]
    public void Given_PerfectMatchWithDifferentCase_When_ComputingMatchedPrecision_Then_ReturnsOne()
    {
        // Arrange
        var evaluationCase = EvaluationCaseBuilder.With(["c#", "sql"], []);
        var result = new RecruiterEvaluationResult(["C#", "SQL"], [], [], "Summary.");
        var metric = ConfusionMetric.Precision(SkillList.Matched);

        // Act
        var value = metric.Compute(evaluationCase, result, AliasNormalizer);

        // Assert
        value.Should().BeApproximately(1, 0.0001);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Given_DisjointSets_When_ComputingMatchedPrecision_Then_ReturnsZero()
    {
        // Arrange
        var evaluationCase = EvaluationCaseBuilder.With(["c#"], []);
        var result = new RecruiterEvaluationResult(["java"], [], [], "Summary.");
        var metric = ConfusionMetric.Precision(SkillList.Matched);

        // Act

        // Assert
        value.Should().BeApproximately(0, 0.0001);
    }

        var metric = ConfusionMetric.Precision(SkillList.Matched);

        // Act
        var value = metric.Compute(evaluationCase, result, AliasNormalizer);

        // Assert
        value.Should().BeApproximately(0.5, 0.0001);
    }

    [InlineData(new string[] { }, new string[] { }, 1.0)]

    public void Given_EmptySet_When_ComputingMatchedPrecision_Then_FollowsEmptySetConvention(
        string[] predicted,
        string[] expected,
        double expectedValue)
    {
        // Arrange

    }

    [Fact]
    public void Given_MissingList_When_ComputingMissingPrecision_Then_UsesMissingSkillsOnly()
    {
        // Arrange
        var evaluationCase = EvaluationCaseBuilder.With(["c#"], ["docker"]);
        var result = new RecruiterEvaluationResult(["java"], ["docker", "git"], ["Learn Docker."], "Summary.");

        string[] predicted,
        string[] expected,

    {

    }

        // Arrange

        var result = new RecruiterEvaluationResult(["  CSharp "], [], [], "Summary.");
        var metric = ConfusionMetric.F1(SkillList.Matched);

        // Act

        // Assert

    }

        // Act

        // Assert

    [Theory]
    [InlineData("Precision", "Matched", "Matched precision")]
    [InlineData("Recall", "Matched", "Matched recall")]
    [InlineData("F1", "Matched", "Matched F1")]
    [InlineData("Precision", "Missing", "Missing precision")]
    [InlineData("Recall", "Missing", "Missing recall")]
    [InlineData("F1", "Missing", "Missing F1")]
    public void Given_FactoryAndSkillList_When_ReadingName_Then_ReturnsReportName(

using FluentAssertions;
using InternHub.Api.Features.RecruiterEvaluation;
using InternHub.Tests.AI.Evaluation.Dataset;

using FluentAssertions;
using InternHub.Tests.AI.Evaluation.Running;
using InternHub.Tests.AI.Evaluation.Running.Manual;

namespace InternHub.Tests.Unit.AI.Evaluation.Running.Manual;

/// <summary>Unit tests for ManualEvaluationSettings.</summary>
public sealed class ManualEvaluationSettingsTests
{
    private static Func<string, string?> Reader(Dictionary<string, string?> values) =>
        key => values.GetValueOrDefault(key);

    [Fact]
    public void Given_RunsNotSet_When_Reading_Then_UsesDefaultOfFive()
    {
        // Arrange
        var read = Reader(new Dictionary<string, string?>());

        // Act
        var settings = ManualEvaluationSettings.FromEnvironment(read);

        // Assert
        settings.RunsPerCase.Should().Be(5);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Given_RunsSetToThree_When_Reading_Then_UsesThree()
    {
        // Arrange
        var read = Reader(new Dictionary<string, string?> { ["INTERNHUB_AI_EVAL_RUNS"] = "3" });

        // Act
        var settings = ManualEvaluationSettings.FromEnvironment(read);

        // Assert
        settings.RunsPerCase.Should().Be(3);
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData("0")]
    [InlineData("-1")]
    [InlineData("abc")]
    public void Given_InvalidRuns_When_Reading_Then_ThrowsSetupException(string runs)
    {
        // Arrange
        var read = Reader(new Dictionary<string, string?> { ["INTERNHUB_AI_EVAL_RUNS"] = runs });

        // Act
        var readSettings = () => ManualEvaluationSettings.FromEnvironment(read);

        // Assert
        readSettings.Should().Throw<EvaluationSetupException>()
            .WithMessage("*INTERNHUB_AI_EVAL_RUNS*");
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Given_NoVariablesSet_When_Reading_Then_ContextValuesAreNotSetAndOllamaValuesAreNull()
    {
        // Arrange

        // Act

        // Assert
        settings.Should().Be(new ManualEvaluationSettings(
            null,
            null,
            5,
            "not set",
            "not set",
            "not set",
            "not set"));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Given_AllVariablesSet_When_Reading_Then_PassesValuesThrough()
    {
        // Arrange
        var read = Reader(new Dictionary<string, string?>
        {
            ["INTERNHUB_AI_EVAL_OLLAMA_ENDPOINT"] = "http://localhost:11434",
            ["INTERNHUB_AI_EVAL_OLLAMA_MODEL"] = "llama3.2:3b",
            ["INTERNHUB_AI_EVAL_RUNS"] = "2",
            ["INTERNHUB_AI_EVAL_TEMPERATURE"] = "0.1",
            ["INTERNHUB_AI_EVAL_PROMPT_VERSION"] = " internhub-recruiter-evaluation-v1 ",
            ["INTERNHUB_AI_EVAL_COMMIT"] = "abc1234",
            ["INTERNHUB_AI_EVAL_DATE"] = "2026-11-08"
        });

        // Act
        var settings = ManualEvaluationSettings.FromEnvironment(read);

        // Assert
        settings.Should().Be(new ManualEvaluationSettings(
            "http://localhost:11434",
            "llama3.2:3b",
            2,
            "0.1",
            "internhub-recruiter-evaluation-v1",
            "abc1234",
            "2026-11-08"));
    }

===== tests\InternHub.Tests\Unit\AI\Evaluation\Running\Outcomes\OutcomeClassifierTests.cs =====

using FluentAssertions;
using InternHub.Api.Features.RecruiterEvaluation;
using InternHub.Tests.AI.Evaluation.Running.Outcomes;

namespace InternHub.Tests.Unit.AI.Evaluation.Running.Outcomes;

/// <summary>Unit tests for OutcomeClassifier.</summary>
public sealed class OutcomeClassifierTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void Given_InvalidOperationException_When_Classifying_Then_ReturnsInvalidResponse()
    {
        // Arrange
        var classifier = new OutcomeClassifier();
        var exception = new InvalidOperationException("Invalid model output.");

        // Act
        var classified = classifier.TryClassify(exception, CancellationToken.None, out var kind);

        // Assert
        classified.Should().BeTrue();
        kind.Should().Be(OutcomeKind.InvalidResponse);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Given_HttpRequestException_When_Classifying_Then_ReturnsInfrastructureUnavailable()
    {
        // Arrange
        var classifier = new OutcomeClassifier();
        var exception = new HttpRequestException("Connection refused.");

        // Act
        var classified = classifier.TryClassify(exception, CancellationToken.None, out var kind);

        // Assert
        classified.Should().BeTrue();
        kind.Should().Be(OutcomeKind.InfrastructureUnavailable);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Given_TimeoutNotRequestedByCaller_When_Classifying_Then_ReturnsInfrastructureUnavailable()
    {
        // Arrange
        var classifier = new OutcomeClassifier();
        var exception = new TaskCanceledException("The request timed out.");

        // Act
        var classified = classifier.TryClassify(exception, CancellationToken.None, out var kind);

        // Assert
        classified.Should().BeTrue();
        kind.Should().Be(OutcomeKind.InfrastructureUnavailable);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Given_CancellationRequestedByCaller_When_Classifying_Then_IsNotClassified()
    {
        // Arrange
        var classifier = new OutcomeClassifier();
        using var cancellation = new CancellationTokenSource();
        cancellation.Cancel();
        var exception = new TaskCanceledException("Cancelled by caller.");

        // Act
        var classified = classifier.TryClassify(exception, cancellation.Token, out _);

        // Assert
        classified.Should().BeFalse();
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Given_UnknownExceptionType_When_Classifying_Then_IsNotClassified()
    {
        // Arrange
        var classifier = new OutcomeClassifier();
        var exception = new NotSupportedException("Unexpected.");

        // Act
        var classified = classifier.TryClassify(exception, CancellationToken.None, out _);

        // Assert
        classified.Should().BeFalse();
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Given_PlainOperationCanceledException_When_Classifying_Then_IsNotClassified()
    {
        // Arrange
        var classifier = new OutcomeClassifier();
        var exception = new OperationCanceledException("Not a timeout type.");

        // Act
        var classified = classifier.TryClassify(exception, CancellationToken.None, out _);

        // Assert
        classified.Should().BeFalse();
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Given_CompleteResult_When_ClassifyingResult_Then_ReturnsSuccess()
    {
        // Arrange
        var classifier = new OutcomeClassifier();
        var result = new RecruiterEvaluationResult(["c#"], ["docker"], ["Learn Docker."], "Summary.");

        // Act
        var kind = classifier.ClassifyResult(result);

        // Assert
        kind.Should().Be(OutcomeKind.Success);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Given_NullMatchedSkills_When_ClassifyingResult_Then_ReturnsInvalidResponse()
    {
        // Arrange
        var classifier = new OutcomeClassifier();
        var result = new RecruiterEvaluationResult(null!, [], [], "Summary.");

        // Act
        var kind = classifier.ClassifyResult(result);

        // Assert
        kind.Should().Be(OutcomeKind.InvalidResponse);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Given_NullMissingSkills_When_ClassifyingResult_Then_ReturnsInvalidResponse()
    {
        // Arrange
        var classifier = new OutcomeClassifier();
        var result = new RecruiterEvaluationResult([], null!, [], "Summary.");

        // Act
        var kind = classifier.ClassifyResult(result);

        // Assert
        kind.Should().Be(OutcomeKind.InvalidResponse);
    }

    [Fact]

        var result = new RecruiterEvaluationResult([], [], null!, "Summary.");
