===== tests\InternHub.Tests\Unit\AI\Evaluation\Running\Reporting\MarkdownReportWriterTests.cs =====

using FluentAssertions;
using InternHub.Api.Features.RecruiterEvaluation;
using InternHub.Tests.AI.Evaluation.Dataset;
using InternHub.Tests.AI.Evaluation.Running;
using InternHub.Tests.AI.Evaluation.Running.Outcomes;
using InternHub.Tests.AI.Evaluation.Running.Reporting;
using InternHub.Tests.Unit.AI.Evaluation.TestDoubles;

namespace InternHub.Tests.Unit.AI.Evaluation.Running.Reporting;

/// <summary>Unit tests for MarkdownReportWriter.</summary>
public sealed class MarkdownReportWriterTests
{
    private static readonly IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string?> NoSettings = new Dictionary<string, string?>();

    private static readonly EvaluationRunContext Context =
        new("stub-provider", "stub-model", "0.1", "prompt-v-test", 2, "2026-01-01", "abc1234");

    // Expected matched {c#}, missing {docker}. Predicted matched {c#, skillmarker}, missing {docker}.
    // Matched: TP 1, FP 1, FN 0 per run -> precision 0.5 (micro and macro), recall 1.
    private static EvaluationDataset MarkerDataset() =>
        new(
            "test",
            true,
            new Dictionary<string, string>(),
            [
                EvaluationCaseBuilder.With(["c#"], ["docker"]) with
                {
                    Id = "clear-01",
                    CvText = "CV-MARKER-7f3a",
                    RequirementsText = "REQ-MARKER-7f3a"
                }
            ]);

    private static readonly RecruiterEvaluationResult MarkerResult =
        new(["c#", "SKILL-MARKER-7f3a"], ["docker"], ["SUGGESTION-MARKER-7f3a"], "SUMMARY-MARKER-7f3a");

    private static Task<EvaluationRunReport> RunAsync(StubRecruiterEvaluationService service) =>
        new EvaluationRunner(new OutcomeClassifier()).RunAsync(MarkerDataset(), service, NoSettings, Context);

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_Report_When_Writing_Then_ContainsEveryContextValue()
    {
        // Arrange
        var report = await RunAsync(new StubRecruiterEvaluationService(() => MarkerResult));

        // Act
        var markdown = MarkdownReportWriter.Write(report);

        // Assert
        markdown.Should().ContainAll(
            "| Provider | stub-provider |",
            "| Model | stub-model |",
            "| Temperature | 0.1 |",
            "| Prompt version | prompt-v-test |",
            "| Runs per case (K) | 2 |",
            "| Date | 2026-01-01 |",
            "| Commit | abc1234 |");
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_Report_When_Writing_Then_ContainsMetricsCategoriesAndStability()
    {
        // Arrange
        var report = await RunAsync(new StubRecruiterEvaluationService(() => MarkerResult));

        // Act
        var markdown = MarkdownReportWriter.Write(report);

        // Assert
        markdown.Should().ContainAll(
            "| Matched precision | 0.5000 | 0.5000 |",
            "| Matched recall | 1.0000 | 1.0000 |",
            "| Hallucination rate |",
            "| Contradiction |",
            "| Coverage |",
            "| Field completeness |",
            "| Clear | 2 |",
            "| Matched | 1.0000 |",
            "| Success | 2 |");
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_Report_When_Writing_Then_StatesThatProviderRetriesAreInvisible()
    {
        // Arrange
        var report = await RunAsync(new StubRecruiterEvaluationService(() => MarkerResult));

        // Act
        var markdown = MarkdownReportWriter.Write(report);

        // Assert
        markdown.Should().Contain("Provider-internal retries are invisible to the evaluator");
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_CvAndGeneratedTextWithMarkers_When_Writing_Then_ContainsNoneOfThem()
    {
        // Arrange
        var report = await RunAsync(new StubRecruiterEvaluationService(() => MarkerResult));

        // Act
        var markdown = MarkdownReportWriter.Write(report);

        // Assert
        markdown.Should().NotContainAny("MARKER", "marker");
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_RunStoppedAfterFirstUnavailableCall_When_Writing_Then_ShowsStopNotice()
    {
        // Arrange
        var report = await RunAsync(new StubRecruiterEvaluationService(() => throw new HttpRequestException("Down.")));

        // Act
        var markdown = MarkdownReportWriter.Write(report);

        // Assert
        markdown.Should().ContainAll(
            "**Run stopped:**",
            "No successful outcomes; metrics were not computed.",
            "| clear-01 | Clear | 1 | InfrastructureUnavailable |");
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData("ollama", "llama3.2:3b", "ai-evaluation-ollama-llama3.2-3b.md")]
    [InlineData("keyword-baseline", "n/a", "ai-evaluation-keyword-baseline-n-a.md")]
    [InlineData("Ollama", "Qwen2.5 7B", "ai-evaluation-ollama-qwen2.5-7b.md")]
    public void Given_ProviderAndModel_When_BuildingFileName_Then_ReturnsSanitizedName(
        string provider,
        string model,
        string expected)
    {
        // Arrange
        var context = new EvaluationRunContext(provider, model, "0.1", "v1", 1, "2026-01-01", "abc1234");

        // Act
        var fileName = MarkdownReportWriter.FileName(context);

        // Assert
        fileName.Should().Be(expected);
    }
}


===== tests\InternHub.Tests\Unit\AI\Evaluation\Running\EvaluationRunnerTests.cs =====

using FluentAssertions;
using InternHub.Api.Features.RecruiterEvaluation;
using InternHub.Tests.AI.Evaluation.Dataset;
using InternHub.Tests.AI.Evaluation.Running;
using InternHub.Tests.AI.Evaluation.Running.Outcomes;
using InternHub.Tests.AI.Evaluation.Running.Reporting;
using InternHub.Tests.Unit.AI.Evaluation.TestDoubles;

namespace InternHub.Tests.Unit.AI.Evaluation.Running;

/// <summary>Unit tests for EvaluationRunner.</summary>
public sealed class EvaluationRunnerTests
{
    private static readonly IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string?> NoSettings = new Dictionary<string, string?>();

    private static readonly RecruiterEvaluationResult CSharpOnly =
        new(["c#"], [], [], "Summary.");

    private static EvaluationRunner CreateRunner() => new(new OutcomeClassifier());

    private static EvaluationRunContext Context(int runsPerCase) =>
        new("stub-provider", "stub-model", "0.1", "prompt-v-test", runsPerCase, "2026-01-01", "abc1234");

    // clear-01 expects matched {c#}; negation-01 expects matched {c#} and missing {docker}.
    private static EvaluationDataset TwoCaseDataset() =>
        new(
            "test",
            true,
            new Dictionary<string, string>(),
            [
                EvaluationCaseBuilder.With(["c#"], []) with { Id = "clear-01" },
                EvaluationCaseBuilder.With(["c#"], ["docker"]) with { Id = "negation-01", Category = EvaluationCategory.Negation }
            ]);

    private static EvaluationDataset ThreeCaseDataset() =>
        new(
            "test",
            true,
            new Dictionary<string, string>(),
            [
                EvaluationCaseBuilder.With(["c#"], []) with { Id = "clear-01" },
                EvaluationCaseBuilder.With(["c#"], []) with { Id = "clear-02" },
                EvaluationCaseBuilder.With(["c#"], []) with { Id = "clear-03" }
            ]);

    private static EvaluationDataset OneCaseDataset() =>
        new(
            "test",
            true,
            new Dictionary<string, string>(),
            [EvaluationCaseBuilder.With(["c#"], []) with { Id = "clear-01" }]);

    [Theory]
    [InlineData(null, "Ai:Ollama:Model")]
    [InlineData("", "Ai:Ollama:Model")]
    [InlineData("   ", "Ai:Ollama:Model")]
    public async Task Given_RequiredSettingMissingOrBlank_When_Running_Then_ThrowsSetupExceptionWithoutCallingProvider(
        string? modelValue,
        string expectedKey)
    {
        // Arrange
        var service = new StubRecruiterEvaluationService(() => CSharpOnly);
        var runner = CreateRunner();
        var requiredSettings = new Dictionary<string, string?>
        {
            ["Ai:Ollama:Endpoint"] = "http://localhost:11434",
            ["Ai:Ollama:Model"] = modelValue
        };

        // Act
        var run = () => runner.RunAsync(TwoCaseDataset(), service, requiredSettings, Context(1));

        // Assert
        await run.Should().ThrowAsync<EvaluationSetupException>().WithMessage($"*{expectedKey}*");
        service.CallCount.Should().Be(0);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_ThreeRunsPerCaseAndTwoCases_When_Running_Then_CallsProviderThreeTimesPerCase()
    {
        // Arrange
        var service = new StubRecruiterEvaluationService(() => CSharpOnly);
        var runner = CreateRunner();

        // Act
        var report = await runner.RunAsync(TwoCaseDataset(), service, NoSettings, Context(3));

        // Assert
        service.CallCount.Should().Be(6);
        report.TotalCalls.Should().Be(6);
        report.OutcomeCounts[OutcomeKind.Success].Should().Be(6);
        report.Outcomes.Count(outcome => outcome.CaseId == "clear-01").Should().Be(3);
        report.Outcomes.Count(outcome => outcome.CaseId == "negation-01").Should().Be(3);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_IdenticalResultsAndThreeRunsPerCase_When_Running_Then_StabilityIsOneOverBothCases()
    {
        // Arrange
        var service = new StubRecruiterEvaluationService(() => CSharpOnly);
        var runner = CreateRunner();

        // Act
        var report = await runner.RunAsync(TwoCaseDataset(), service, NoSettings, Context(3));

        // Assert

            .Which.Kind.Should().Be(OutcomeKind.InfrastructureUnavailable);

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_SuccessThenInvalidThenUnavailable_When_Running_Then_CountsEachOutcomeAndRatesSeparately()
    {
        // Arrange
        // Reached the model: 1 success + 1 invalid -> valid-response rate 1 / 2.
        // Unavailable: 1 of 3 calls -> unavailability rate 1 / 3.
        var service = new StubRecruiterEvaluationService(
            () => CSharpOnly,
            () => throw new InvalidOperationException("Invalid model output."),
            () => throw new HttpRequestException("Connection refused."));
        var runner = CreateRunner();

        report.OutcomeCounts[OutcomeKind.InvalidResponse].Should().Be(1);
        report.OutcomeCounts[OutcomeKind.InfrastructureUnavailable].Should().Be(1);
        report.ValidResponseRate!.Value.Should().BeApproximately(0.5, 0.0001);
        report.UnavailabilityRate.Should().BeApproximately(0.3333, 0.0001);
        report.Aggregate!.CaseCount.Should().Be(1);
    }

    [Fact]

    {

===== tests\InternHub.Tests\Unit\AI\Evaluation\TestDoubles\StubRecruiterEvaluationService.cs =====

using InternHub.Api.Features.RecruiterEvaluation;

namespace InternHub.Tests.Unit.AI.Evaluation.TestDoubles;

/// <summary>Hand-written stub provider: each call uses the next response (a result or an exception); the last response repeats.</summary>
internal sealed class StubRecruiterEvaluationService(params Func<RecruiterEvaluationResult>[] responses)
    : IRecruiterEvaluationService
{
    public int CallCount { get; private set; }

    public Task<RecruiterEvaluationResult> AnalyzeAsync(
        string cvContent,
        string offerRequirements,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        var response = responses[Math.Min(CallCount, responses.Length - 1)];
        CallCount++;

        return Task.FromResult(response());
    }
}


===== tests\InternHub.Tests\Unit\AI\Ollama\OllamaRecruiterEvaluationServiceTests.cs =====

using System.Net;
using System.Text;
using System.Text.Json;
using FluentAssertions;
using InternHub.Api.Infrastructure.AI.Ollama;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;

namespace InternHub.Tests.Unit.AI.Ollama;

public sealed class OllamaRecruiterEvaluationServiceTests
{
    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_ValidGeneratedEvaluation_When_Analyzing_Then_MapsAllFields()
    {
        // Arrange
        var handler = new FakeHttpMessageHandler(
            OllamaResponse("""{"matchedSkills":["C#"],"missingSkills":["Docker"],"suggestions":["Study Docker."],"summary":"Good match."}"""));
        var service = CreateService(handler);

        // Act
        var result = await service.AnalyzeAsync("C# developer", "C#, Docker");

        // Assert
        result.Should().BeEquivalentTo(new
        {
            MatchedSkills = (IReadOnlyList<string>)["C#"],
            MissingSkills = (IReadOnlyList<string>)["Docker"],
            Suggestions = (IReadOnlyList<string>)["Study Docker."],
            Summary = "Good match."
        });
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_AnalysisRequest_When_Analyzing_Then_SendsConfiguredOllamaPayload()
    {
        // Arrange
        var handler = new FakeHttpMessageHandler(
            OllamaResponse("""{"matchedSkills":[],"missingSkills":[],"suggestions":[],"summary":"No gaps."}"""));
        var service = CreateService(handler);

        // Act
        await service.AnalyzeAsync("Python", "Python");

        // Assert
        var request = handler.Requests.Should().ContainSingle().Which;
        request.Method.Should().Be(HttpMethod.Post);
        request.RequestUri.Should().Be("http://ollama.test:11434/api/generate");
        using var payload = JsonDocument.Parse(request.Body);
        payload.RootElement.GetProperty("model").GetString().Should().Be("test-model");
        payload.RootElement.GetProperty("stream").GetBoolean().Should().BeFalse();
        payload.RootElement.GetProperty("format").GetString().Should().Be("json");
        payload.RootElement.GetProperty("options").GetProperty("temperature")
            .GetDouble().Should().Be(0.1);
        payload.RootElement.GetProperty("prompt").GetString()
            .Should().Contain("internhub-recruiter-evaluation-v1");
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_MalformedFirstEvaluation_When_Analyzing_Then_RetriesOnceAndSucceeds()
    {
        // Arrange
        var handler = new FakeHttpMessageHandler(
            OllamaResponse("{not-json}"),
            OllamaResponse("""{"matchedSkills":[],"missingSkills":[],"suggestions":[],"summary":"Valid."}"""));
        var service = CreateService(handler);

        // Act
        var result = await service.AnalyzeAsync("CV", "Requirements");

        // Assert
        result.Summary.Should().Be("Valid.");
        handler.Requests.Should().HaveCount(2);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_InvalidEvaluationsOnBothAttempts_When_Analyzing_Then_ThrowsWithoutThirdRequest()
    {
        // Arrange
        var handler = new FakeHttpMessageHandler(
            OllamaResponse("{}"),
            OllamaResponse("{}"));
        var service = CreateService(handler);

        // Act
        var action = () => service.AnalyzeAsync("CV", "Requirements");

        // Assert
        await action.Should().ThrowAsync<InvalidOperationException>()
            .WithMessage("*invalid recruiter evaluation*");
        handler.Requests.Should().HaveCount(2);
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData("""{"missingSkills":[],"suggestions":[],"summary":"x"}""")]
    [InlineData("""{"matchedSkills":"C#","missingSkills":[],"suggestions":[],"summary":"x"}""")]
    [InlineData("""{"matchedSkills":[],"missingSkills":[],"suggestions":[],"summary":""}""")]
    public async Task Given_MissingOrInvalidRequiredField_When_Analyzing_Then_RetriesAndFails(
        string invalidEvaluation)
    {
        // Arrange
        var handler = new FakeHttpMessageHandler(
            OllamaResponse(invalidEvaluation),
            OllamaResponse(invalidEvaluation));
        var service = CreateService(handler);

        // Act
        var action = () => service.AnalyzeAsync("CV", "Requirements");

        // Assert
        await action.Should().ThrowAsync<InvalidOperationException>();
        handler.Requests.Should().HaveCount(2);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_HttpFailure_When_Analyzing_Then_PropagatesHttpFailureWithoutRetry()
    {
        // Arrange
        var handler = new FakeHttpMessageHandler(
            new HttpResponseMessage(HttpStatusCode.ServiceUnavailable));
        var service = CreateService(handler);

        // Act
        var action = () => service.AnalyzeAsync("CV", "Requirements");

        // Assert
        await action.Should().ThrowAsync<HttpRequestException>();
        handler.Requests.Should().ContainSingle();
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_CanceledToken_When_Analyzing_Then_PropagatesCancellation()
    {
        // Arrange
        var handler = new FakeHttpMessageHandler(
            OllamaResponse("""{"matchedSkills":[],"missingSkills":[],"suggestions":[],"summary":"x"}"""));
        var service = CreateService(handler);
        using var cancellationSource = new CancellationTokenSource();
        cancellationSource.Cancel();

        // Act
        var action = () => service.AnalyzeAsync(
            "CV",
            "Requirements",
            cancellationSource.Token);

        // Assert
        await action.Should().ThrowAsync<OperationCanceledException>();
        handler.Requests.Should().BeEmpty();
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_SlowOllamaResponse_When_HttpClientTimesOut_Then_PropagatesCancellation()
    {
        // Arrange
        var handler = new TimeoutHttpMessageHandler();
        using var httpClient = new HttpClient(handler)
        {
            Timeout = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(50)
        };
        var service = new OllamaRecruiterEvaluationService(
            httpClient,
            CreateConfiguration());

        // Act
        var action = () => service.AnalyzeAsync("CV", "Requirements");

        // Assert
        await action.Should().ThrowAsync<OperationCanceledException>();
        handler.Requests.Should().ContainSingle();
    }

    private static OllamaRecruiterEvaluationService CreateService(
        FakeHttpMessageHandler handler)
    {
        var client = new HttpClient(handler);
        return new OllamaRecruiterEvaluationService(client, CreateConfiguration());
    }

    private static IConfiguration CreateConfiguration() =>
        new ConfigurationBuilder()
            .AddInMemoryCollection(new Dictionary<string, string?>
            {
                ["Ai:Ollama:Endpoint"] = "http://ollama.test:11434",
                ["Ai:Ollama:Model"] = "test-model"
            })
            .Build();

    private static HttpResponseMessage OllamaResponse(string generatedJson) =>
        new(HttpStatusCode.OK)
        {
            Content = new StringContent(
                JsonSerializer.Serialize(new { response = generatedJson }),
                Encoding.UTF8,
                "application/json")
        };

    private sealed class FakeHttpMessageHandler : HttpMessageHandler
    {
        private readonly Queue<Func<HttpRequestMessage, CancellationToken, HttpResponseMessage>> _responses;

        public FakeHttpMessageHandler(params HttpResponseMessage[] responses)
            : this(responses
                .Select(response =>
                    (Func<HttpRequestMessage, CancellationToken, HttpResponseMessage>)
                    ((_, _) => response))
                .ToArray())
        {
        }

        public FakeHttpMessageHandler(
            params Func<HttpRequestMessage, CancellationToken, HttpResponseMessage>[] responses)
        {
            _responses = new Queue<Func<HttpRequestMessage, CancellationToken, HttpResponseMessage>>(responses);
        }

        public List<CapturedRequest> Requests { get; } = [];

        protected override async Task<HttpResponseMessage> SendAsync(
            HttpRequestMessage request,
            CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            Requests.Add(new CapturedRequest(
                request.Method,
                request.RequestUri,
                await request.Content!.ReadAsStringAsync(cancellationToken)));
            return _responses.Dequeue()(request, cancellationToken);
        }
    }

    private sealed record CapturedRequest(
        HttpMethod Method,
        Uri? RequestUri,
        string Body);

    private sealed class TimeoutHttpMessageHandler : HttpMessageHandler
    {
        public List<HttpRequestMessage> Requests { get; } = [];

        protected override async Task<HttpResponseMessage> SendAsync(
            HttpRequestMessage request,
            CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            Requests.Add(request);
            await Task.Delay(Timeout.Infinite, cancellationToken);
            throw new InvalidOperationException("The timeout should cancel the request.");
        }
    }
}

===== tests\InternHub.Tests\Unit\InternshipCandidacies\Fakes\FakeInternshipCandidacyRepository.cs =====

using InternHub.Api.Domain.InternshipCandidacies;

namespace InternHub.Tests.Unit.InternshipCandidacies.Fakes;

internal sealed class FakeInternshipCandidacyRepository : IInternshipCandidacyRepository
{
    private readonly List<InternshipCandidacy> _candidacies = [];

    public bool AddResult { get; set; } = true;
    public bool UpdateResult { get; set; } = true;
    public int AddCallCount { get; private set; }
    public int UpdateCallCount { get; private set; }
    public List<InternshipCandidacy> Candidacies => _candidacies;

    public void Seed(InternshipCandidacy candidacy) =>
        _candidacies.Add(candidacy);

    public bool Add(InternshipCandidacy candidacy)
    {
        AddCallCount++;

        if (!AddResult || _candidacies.Any(existing => existing.Id == candidacy.Id))
            return false;

        _candidacies.Add(candidacy);
        return true;
    }

    public InternshipCandidacy? GetById(Guid id) =>
        _candidacies.SingleOrDefault(candidacy => candidacy.Id == id);

    public IReadOnlyList<InternshipCandidacy> GetByStudent(Guid studentId) =>
        _candidacies.Where(candidacy => candidacy.StudentId == studentId).ToArray();

    public IReadOnlyList<InternshipCandidacy> GetByOffer(Guid offerId) =>
        _candidacies.Where(candidacy => candidacy.OfferId == offerId).ToArray();

    public bool HasActiveForStudentAndOffer(Guid studentId, Guid offerId) =>
        _candidacies.Any(candidacy =>
            candidacy.StudentId == studentId &&
            candidacy.OfferId == offerId &&
            IsActive(candidacy.Status));

    public int CountActiveForStudent(Guid studentId) =>
        _candidacies.Count(candidacy =>
            candidacy.StudentId == studentId &&
            IsActive(candidacy.Status));

    public int CountAcceptedForOffer(Guid offerId) =>
        _candidacies.Count(candidacy =>
            candidacy.OfferId == offerId &&
            candidacy.Status == InternshipCandidacyStatus.Accepted);

    public bool Update(InternshipCandidacy candidacy)
    {
        UpdateCallCount++;

        if (!UpdateResult)
            return false;

        var index =_candidacies.FindIndex(existing => existing.Id == candidacy.Id);
        if (index < 0)
            return false;

        _candidacies[index] = candidacy;
        return true;
    }

    private static bool IsActive(InternshipCandidacyStatus status) =>
        status is InternshipCandidacyStatus.Submitted
            or InternshipCandidacyStatus.Shortlisted
            or InternshipCandidacyStatus.Accepted
            or InternshipCandidacyStatus.Waitlisted;
}

using FluentAssertions;
using InternHub.Api.Domain.InternshipCandidacies;

    private static readonly Guid StudentId =
        Guid.Parse("22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222");

    private static readonly Guid OfferId =
        Guid.Parse("33333333-3333-3333-3333-333333333333");

    private static readonly DateTime ApplicationDate =
        new(2027, 1, 15, 0, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);

            InternshipCandidacyStatus.Submitted);

        repository.Candidacies.Add(candidacy);
        var handler = new GetInternshipCandidacyByIdHandler(repository);

        // Act

===== tests\InternHub.Tests\Unit\InternshipCandidacies\GetStudentCandidacySummary\GetStudentCandidacySummaryHandlerTests.cs =====

using FluentAssertions;
using InternHub.Api.Domain.InternshipCandidacies;
using InternHub.Api.Features.InternshipCandidacies.GetStudentCandidacySummary;
using InternHub.Api.Features.Shared;
using InternHub.Domain.Students;
using InternHub.Tests.Unit.InternshipCandidacies.Fakes;
using InternHub.Tests.Unit.Students.Fakes;

namespace InternHub.Tests.Unit.InternshipCandidacies.GetStudentCandidacySummary;

public sealed class GetStudentCandidacySummaryHandlerTests
{
    private static readonly DateTime ApplicationDate =
        new(2027, 1, 15, 12, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);

    [Fact]
    public void Given_MissingStudent_When_QueryingSummary_Then_ReturnsNotFoundWithoutDto()
    {
        // Arrange
        var students = new FakeStudentRepository();
        var candidacies = new FakeInternshipCandidacyRepository();
        var handler = new GetStudentCandidacySummaryHandler(students, candidacies);

        // Act

        // Assert
        result.Status.Should().Be(ResultStatus.NotFound);
        result.Value.Should().BeNull();
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Given_ExistingStudentWithoutCandidacies_When_QueryingSummary_Then_ReturnsZeroCounts()
    {
        // Arrange
        var student = CreateStudent();
        var students = new FakeStudentRepository();
        students.Add(student);
        var handler = new GetStudentCandidacySummaryHandler(
            students,
            new FakeInternshipCandidacyRepository());

        // Act
        var result = handler.Handle(new GetStudentCandidacySummaryQuery(student.Id));

        // Assert
        result.Status.Should().Be(ResultStatus.Success);
        result.Value.Should().NotBeNull();
        result.Value!.StudentId.Should().Be(student.Id);
        result.Value.TotalCount.Should().Be(0);
        result.Value.ActiveCount.Should().Be(0);
        result.Value.SubmittedCount.Should().Be(0);
        result.Value.ShortlistedCount.Should().Be(0);
        result.Value.AcceptedCount.Should().Be(0);
        result.Value.RejectedCount.Should().Be(0);
        result.Value.WaitlistedCount.Should().Be(0);
        result.Value.WithdrawnCount.Should().Be(0);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Given_StudentWithAllStatuses_When_QueryingSummary_Then_ReturnsCorrectCountsAndActivity()
    {
        // Arrange
        var student = CreateStudent();
        var candidacies = new FakeInternshipCandidacyRepository();
        var submitted = CreateCandidacy(student.Id, InternshipCandidacyStatus.Submitted);
        var shortlisted = CreateCandidacy(student.Id, InternshipCandidacyStatus.Shortlisted);
        var accepted = CreateCandidacy(student.Id, InternshipCandidacyStatus.Accepted);
        var rejected = CreateCandidacy(student.Id, InternshipCandidacyStatus.Rejected);
        var waitlisted = CreateCandidacy(student.Id, InternshipCandidacyStatus.Waitlisted);
        var withdrawn = CreateCandidacy(student.Id, InternshipCandidacyStatus.Withdrawn);
        candidacies.Seed(submitted);
        candidacies.Seed(shortlisted);
        candidacies.Seed(accepted);
        candidacies.Seed(rejected);
        candidacies.Seed(waitlisted);
        candidacies.Seed(withdrawn);

        var students = new FakeStudentRepository();
        students.Add(student);
        var handler = new GetStudentCandidacySummaryHandler(students, candidacies);

        // Act
        var result = handler.Handle(new GetStudentCandidacySummaryQuery(student.Id));

        // Assert
        result.Status.Should().Be(ResultStatus.Success);
        result.Value.Should().NotBeNull();
        result.Value!.TotalCount.Should().Be(6);
        result.Value.ActiveCount.Should().Be(4);
        result.Value.SubmittedCount.Should().Be(1);
        result.Value.ShortlistedCount.Should().Be(1);
        result.Value.AcceptedCount.Should().Be(1);
        result.Value.RejectedCount.Should().Be(1);
        result.Value.WaitlistedCount.Should().Be(1);
        result.Value.WithdrawnCount.Should().Be(1);
        accepted.IsActive.Should().BeTrue();
        waitlisted.IsActive.Should().BeTrue();
        rejected.IsActive.Should().BeFalse();
        withdrawn.IsActive.Should().BeFalse();
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Given_MultipleCandidaciesWithSameStatus_When_QueryingSummary_Then_AggregatesEachStatus()
    {
        // Arrange
        var student = CreateStudent();
        var candidacies = new FakeInternshipCandidacyRepository();
        candidacies.Seed(CreateCandidacy(student.Id, InternshipCandidacyStatus.Submitted));
        candidacies.Seed(CreateCandidacy(student.Id, InternshipCandidacyStatus.Submitted));
        candidacies.Seed(CreateCandidacy(student.Id, InternshipCandidacyStatus.Accepted));
        candidacies.Seed(CreateCandidacy(student.Id, InternshipCandidacyStatus.Accepted));
        candidacies.Seed(CreateCandidacy(student.Id, InternshipCandidacyStatus.Rejected));

        var students = new FakeStudentRepository();
        students.Add(student);
        var handler = new GetStudentCandidacySummaryHandler(students, candidacies);

        // Act
        var result = handler.Handle(new GetStudentCandidacySummaryQuery(student.Id));

        // Assert
        result.Status.Should().Be(ResultStatus.Success);
        result.Value.Should().NotBeNull();
        result.Value!.TotalCount.Should().Be(5);
        result.Value.ActiveCount.Should().Be(4);
        result.Value.SubmittedCount.Should().Be(2);
        result.Value.ShortlistedCount.Should().Be(0);
        result.Value.AcceptedCount.Should().Be(2);
        result.Value.RejectedCount.Should().Be(1);
        result.Value.WaitlistedCount.Should().Be(0);
        result.Value.WithdrawnCount.Should().Be(0);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Given_CandidaciesForMultipleStudents_When_QueryingSummary_Then_ExcludesOtherStudents()
    {
        // Arrange
        var student = CreateStudent();
        var otherStudent = CreateStudent();
        var candidacies = new FakeInternshipCandidacyRepository();
        candidacies.Seed(CreateCandidacy(student.Id, InternshipCandidacyStatus.Submitted));
        candidacies.Seed(CreateCandidacy(student.Id, InternshipCandidacyStatus.Rejected));
        candidacies.Seed(CreateCandidacy(otherStudent.Id, InternshipCandidacyStatus.Accepted));
        candidacies.Seed(CreateCandidacy(otherStudent.Id, InternshipCandidacyStatus.Withdrawn));

        var students = new FakeStudentRepository();
        students.Add(student);
        students.Add(otherStudent);
        var handler = new GetStudentCandidacySummaryHandler(students, candidacies);

        // Act
        var result = handler.Handle(new GetStudentCandidacySummaryQuery(student.Id));

        // Assert
        result.Status.Should().Be(ResultStatus.Success);
        result.Value.Should().NotBeNull();
        result.Value!.TotalCount.Should().Be(2);
        result.Value.ActiveCount.Should().Be(1);
        result.Value.SubmittedCount.Should().Be(1);
        result.Value.RejectedCount.Should().Be(1);
        result.Value.AcceptedCount.Should().Be(0);
        result.Value.WithdrawnCount.Should().Be(0);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Given_ExistingCandidacies_When_QueryingSummary_Then_DoesNotChangeRepositoryState()
    {
        // Arrange
        var student = CreateStudent();
        var candidacy = CreateCandidacy(student.Id, InternshipCandidacyStatus.Shortlisted);
        var candidacies = new FakeInternshipCandidacyRepository();
        candidacies.Seed(candidacy);
        var beforeList = candidacies.Candidacies.ToArray();
        var beforeStates = candidacies.Candidacies
            .Select(item => (item.Id, item.StudentId, item.OfferId, item.ApplicationDate, item.Status))
            .ToArray();

        var students = new FakeStudentRepository();
        students.Add(student);
        var handler = new GetStudentCandidacySummaryHandler(students, candidacies);

        // Act
        var result = handler.Handle(new GetStudentCandidacySummaryQuery(student.Id));

        // Assert
        result.Status.Should().Be(ResultStatus.Success);
        candidacies.Candidacies.Should().Equal(beforeList);
        candidacies.Candidacies
            .Select(item => (item.Id, item.StudentId, item.OfferId, item.ApplicationDate, item.Status))
            .Should().Equal(beforeStates);
        candidacies.AddCallCount.Should().Be(0);
        candidacies.UpdateCallCount.Should().Be(0);
    }

    private static Student CreateStudent() =>
        new(Guid.NewGuid(), "Test Student", "student@example.test");

    private static InternshipCandidacy CreateCandidacy(
        Guid studentId,
        InternshipCandidacyStatus status) =>
        new(
            Guid.NewGuid(),
            studentId,
            Guid.NewGuid(),
            ApplicationDate,
            status);
}


===== tests\InternHub.Tests\Unit\InternshipCandidacies\WithdrawInternshipCandidacy\WithdrawInternshipCandidacyHandlerTests.cs =====

using FluentAssertions;
using InternHub.Api.Domain.InternshipCandidacies;
using InternHub.Api.Features.InternshipCandidacies.WithdrawInternshipCandidacy;
using InternHub.Api.Features.Shared;
using InternHub.Tests.Unit.InternshipCandidacies.Fakes;

namespace InternHub.Tests.Unit.InternshipCandidacies.WithdrawInternshipCandidacy;

public sealed class WithdrawInternshipCandidacyHandlerTests
{
    private static readonly DateTime ApplicationDate =
        new(2027, 1, 15, 12, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);

    [Theory]
    [InlineData(InternshipCandidacyStatus.Submitted)]
    [InlineData(InternshipCandidacyStatus.Shortlisted)]
    public void Given_OpenCandidacy_When_Withdrawing_Then_ReturnsSuccessAndUpdates(
        InternshipCandidacyStatus initialStatus)
    {
        // Arrange
        var candidacy = CreateCandidacy(initialStatus);
        var candidacies = new FakeInternshipCandidacyRepository();
        candidacies.Seed(candidacy);
        var handler = new WithdrawInternshipCandidacyHandler(candidacies);

        // Act
        var result = handler.Handle(new WithdrawInternshipCandidacyCommand(candidacy.Id));

        // Assert
        result.Status.Should().Be(ResultStatus.Success);
        result.Value.Should().BeTrue();
        candidacy.Status.Should().Be(InternshipCandidacyStatus.Withdrawn);
        candidacies.UpdateCallCount.Should().Be(1);
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData(InternshipCandidacyStatus.Accepted)]
    [InlineData(InternshipCandidacyStatus.Rejected)]
    [InlineData(InternshipCandidacyStatus.Waitlisted)]
    [InlineData(InternshipCandidacyStatus.Withdrawn)]
    public void Given_FinalCandidacy_When_Withdrawing_Then_ReturnsConflictAndDoesNotUpdate(
        InternshipCandidacyStatus finalStatus)
    {
        // Arrange
        var candidacy = CreateCandidacy(finalStatus);
        var candidacies = new FakeInternshipCandidacyRepository();
        candidacies.Seed(candidacy);
        var handler = new WithdrawInternshipCandidacyHandler(candidacies);

        // Act
        var result = handler.Handle(new WithdrawInternshipCandidacyCommand(candidacy.Id));

        // Assert
        result.Status.Should().Be(ResultStatus.Conflict);
        result.Error.Should().Be(
            $"Candidacy {candidacy.Id} cannot be withdrawn from status {finalStatus}.");
        candidacy.Status.Should().Be(finalStatus);
        candidacies.UpdateCallCount.Should().Be(0);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Given_MissingCandidacy_When_Withdrawing_Then_ReturnsNotFoundAndDoesNotUpdate()
    {
        // Arrange
        var candidacyId = Guid.NewGuid();
        var candidacies = new FakeInternshipCandidacyRepository();
        var handler = new WithdrawInternshipCandidacyHandler(candidacies);

        // Act
        var result = handler.Handle(new WithdrawInternshipCandidacyCommand(candidacyId));

        // Assert
        result.Status.Should().Be(ResultStatus.NotFound);
        result.Error.Should().Be($"Candidacy {candidacyId} not found.");
        result.Value.Should().BeFalse();
        candidacies.UpdateCallCount.Should().Be(0);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Given_OpenCandidacyAndFailedRepositoryUpdate_When_Withdrawing_Then_ReturnsNotFound()
    {
        // Arrange
        var candidacy = CreateCandidacy(InternshipCandidacyStatus.Submitted);
        var candidacies = new FakeInternshipCandidacyRepository { UpdateResult = false };
        candidacies.Seed(candidacy);
        var handler = new WithdrawInternshipCandidacyHandler(candidacies);

        // Act
        var result = handler.Handle(new WithdrawInternshipCandidacyCommand(candidacy.Id));

        // Assert
        result.Status.Should().Be(ResultStatus.NotFound);
        result.Error.Should().Be($"Candidacy {candidacy.Id} not found.");
        result.Value.Should().BeFalse();
        candidacy.Status.Should().Be(InternshipCandidacyStatus.Withdrawn);
        candidacies.UpdateCallCount.Should().Be(1);
    }

    private static InternshipCandidacy CreateCandidacy(InternshipCandidacyStatus status) =>
        new(
            Guid.NewGuid(),
            Guid.NewGuid(),
            Guid.NewGuid(),
            ApplicationDate,
            status);
}


===== tests\InternHub.Tests\Unit\InternshipCandidacies\CreateInternshipCandidacyHandlerTests.cs =====

using FluentAssertions;
using InternHub.Api.Domain.InternshipCandidacies;
using InternHub.Api.Features.InternshipCandidacies.AtomicSubmission;
using InternHub.Api.Features.InternshipCandidacies.CreateInternshipCandidacy;
using InternHub.Api.Features.Shared;

namespace InternHub.Tests.Unit.InternshipCandidacies;

public sealed class CreateInternshipCandidacyHandlerTests
{
    private static readonly DateTime ApplicationDate =
        new(2027, 1, 15, 12, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_AtomicSubmissionSucceeds_When_Applying_Then_ReturnsCreatedCandidacy()
    {
        // Arrange
        var studentId = Guid.NewGuid();
        var offerId = Guid.NewGuid();
        var candidacy = CreateCandidacy(studentId, offerId);
        var submission = new FakeAtomicCandidacySubmission
        {
            Result = AtomicCandidacySubmissionResult.Success(candidacy)
        };
        var handler = new CreateInternshipCandidacyHandler(submission);
        using var cancellationSource = new CancellationTokenSource();

        // Act
        var result = await handler.HandleAsync(
            new CreateInternshipCandidacyCommand(studentId, offerId),
            cancellationSource.Token);

        // Assert
        result.Status.Should().Be(ResultStatus.Success);
        result.Value.Should().Be(new CreateInternshipCandidacyResponse(
            candidacy.Id,
            studentId,
            offerId,
            ApplicationDate,
            InternshipCandidacyStatus.Submitted));
        submission.StudentId.Should().Be(studentId);
        submission.OfferId.Should().Be(offerId);
        submission.CancellationToken.Should().Be(cancellationSource.Token);
        submission.CallCount.Should().Be(1);
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData(true)]
    [InlineData(false)]
    public async Task Given_EmptyIdentifier_When_Applying_Then_ReturnsValidationWithoutAtomicSubmit(
        bool emptyStudentId)
    {
        // Arrange
        var studentId = emptyStudentId ? Guid.Empty : Guid.NewGuid();
        var offerId = emptyStudentId ? Guid.NewGuid() : Guid.Empty;
        var submission = new FakeAtomicCandidacySubmission();
        var handler = new CreateInternshipCandidacyHandler(submission);

        // Act
        var result = await handler.HandleAsync(
            new CreateInternshipCandidacyCommand(studentId, offerId),
            CancellationToken.None);

        // Assert
        result.Status.Should().Be(ResultStatus.Validation);
        result.Error.Should().Contain("must not be empty");
        submission.CallCount.Should().Be(0);
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData(AtomicCandidacySubmissionStatus.StudentNotFound, ResultStatus.NotFound, "Student")]
    [InlineData(AtomicCandidacySubmissionStatus.OfferNotFound, ResultStatus.NotFound, "Offer")]
    [InlineData(AtomicCandidacySubmissionStatus.OfferClosed, ResultStatus.Conflict, "closed")]
    [InlineData(AtomicCandidacySubmissionStatus.DeadlineExpired, ResultStatus.Conflict, "deadline")]
    [InlineData(AtomicCandidacySubmissionStatus.DuplicateActive, ResultStatus.Conflict, "active candidacy")]
    [InlineData(AtomicCandidacySubmissionStatus.ActiveLimitReached, ResultStatus.Conflict, "maximum of 5")]
    public async Task Given_AtomicSubmissionBusinessFailure_When_Applying_Then_MapsFailureToResult(
        AtomicCandidacySubmissionStatus submissionStatus,
        ResultStatus expectedResultStatus,
        string expectedMessage)
    {
        // Arrange
        var studentId = Guid.NewGuid();
        var offerId = Guid.NewGuid();
        var submission = new FakeAtomicCandidacySubmission
        {
            Result = AtomicCandidacySubmissionResult.Failure(submissionStatus)
        };
        var handler = new CreateInternshipCandidacyHandler(submission);

        // Act
        var result = await handler.HandleAsync(
            new CreateInternshipCandidacyCommand(studentId, offerId),
            CancellationToken.None);

        // Assert
        result.Status.Should().Be(expectedResultStatus);
        result.Error.Should().Contain(expectedMessage);
        submission.CallCount.Should().Be(1);
    }

    private static InternshipCandidacy CreateCandidacy(Guid studentId, Guid offerId) =>
        new(
            Guid.NewGuid(),
            studentId,
            offerId,
            ApplicationDate,
            InternshipCandidacyStatus.Submitted);

    private sealed class FakeAtomicCandidacySubmission : IAtomicCandidacySubmission
    {
        public AtomicCandidacySubmissionResult? Result { get; init; }
        public int CallCount { get; private set; }
        public Guid StudentId { get; private set; }
        public Guid OfferId { get; private set; }
        public CancellationToken CancellationToken { get; private set; }

        public Task<AtomicCandidacySubmissionResult> SubmitAsync(
            Guid studentId,
            Guid offerId,
            CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            CallCount++;
            StudentId = studentId;
            OfferId = offerId;
            CancellationToken = cancellationToken;

            return Task.FromResult(
                Result ?? AtomicCandidacySubmissionResult.Failure(
                    AtomicCandidacySubmissionStatus.StudentNotFound));
        }
    }
}


===== tests\InternHub.Tests\Unit\InternshipCandidacies\DecideInternshipCandidacyHandlerTests.cs =====

using FluentAssertions;
using InternHub.Api.Domain.InternshipCandidacies;
using InternHub.Api.Features.InternshipCandidacies.AtomicDecision;
using InternHub.Api.Features.InternshipCandidacies.DecideInternshipCandidacy;
using InternHub.Api.Features.Shared;
using InternHub.Tests.Unit.InternshipCandidacies.Fakes;

namespace InternHub.Tests.Unit.InternshipCandidacies;

public sealed class DecideInternshipCandidacyHandlerTests
{
    private static readonly DateTime ApplicationDate = new(2027, 1, 15, 12, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);

    [Theory]
    [InlineData("1")]
    [InlineData("Shortlist,Accept")]
    [InlineData("")]
    [InlineData("   ")]
    [InlineData(null)]
    [InlineData("foo")]
    public async Task Given_InvalidAction_When_Deciding_Then_ReturnsValidationAndDoesNotCallAtomicDecision(string? action)
    {
        // Arrange
        var decisions = new FakeAtomicCandidacyDecision();
        var handler = new DecideInternshipCandidacyHandler(decisions);
        var command = new DecideInternshipCandidacyCommand(Guid.NewGuid(), action);

        // Act
        var result = await handler.HandleAsync(command);

        // Assert
        result.Status.Should().Be(ResultStatus.Validation);
        result.Error.Should().Be(
            $"Action '{action}' is not valid. Allowed values: Shortlist, Accept, Reject.");
        decisions.CallCount.Should().Be(0);
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData("Shortlist", CandidacyDecision.Shortlist)]
    [InlineData("shortlist", CandidacyDecision.Shortlist)]
    [InlineData("ACCEPT", CandidacyDecision.Accept)]
    [InlineData("Accept", CandidacyDecision.Accept)]
    [InlineData("reject", CandidacyDecision.Reject)]
    public async Task Given_ValidActionIgnoringCase_When_Deciding_Then_PassesParsedDecisionAndIdToAtomicDecision(
        string action,
        CandidacyDecision expectedDecision)
    {
        // Arrange
        var candidacyId = Guid.NewGuid();
        var decisions = new FakeAtomicCandidacyDecision();
        var handler = new DecideInternshipCandidacyHandler(decisions);
        var command = new DecideInternshipCandidacyCommand(candidacyId, action);

        // Act
        await handler.HandleAsync(command);

        // Assert
        decisions.CallCount.Should().Be(1);
        decisions.LastCandidacyId.Should().Be(candidacyId);
        decisions.LastDecision.Should().Be(expectedDecision);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_CancellationToken_When_Deciding_Then_PassesTokenToAtomicDecision()
    {
        // Arrange
        using var cancellationSource = new CancellationTokenSource();
        var decisions = new FakeAtomicCandidacyDecision();
        var handler = new DecideInternshipCandidacyHandler(decisions);
        var command = new DecideInternshipCandidacyCommand(Guid.NewGuid(), "Reject");

        // Act
        await handler.HandleAsync(command, cancellationSource.Token);

        // Assert
        decisions.LastCancellationToken.Should().Be(cancellationSource.Token);
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData(InternshipCandidacyStatus.Shortlisted)]
    [InlineData(InternshipCandidacyStatus.Accepted)]
    [InlineData(InternshipCandidacyStatus.Waitlisted)]
    [InlineData(InternshipCandidacyStatus.Rejected)]
    public async Task Given_AtomicDecisionDecided_When_Deciding_Then_ReturnsSuccessWithCandidacyIdAndStatus(
        InternshipCandidacyStatus decidedStatus)
    {
        // Arrange
        var candidacy = CreateCandidacy(decidedStatus);
        var decisions = new FakeAtomicCandidacyDecision
        {
            Result = AtomicCandidacyDecisionResult.Success(candidacy)
        };
        var handler = new DecideInternshipCandidacyHandler(decisions);
        var command = new DecideInternshipCandidacyCommand(candidacy.Id, "Accept");

        // Act
        var result = await handler.HandleAsync(command);

        // Assert
        result.Status.Should().Be(ResultStatus.Success);
        result.Value.Should().Be(new DecideInternshipCandidacyResponse(candidacy.Id, decidedStatus));
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_AtomicDecisionCandidacyNotFound_When_Deciding_Then_ReturnsNotFound()
    {
        // Arrange
        var candidacyId = Guid.NewGuid();
        var decisions = new FakeAtomicCandidacyDecision
        {
            Result = AtomicCandidacyDecisionResult.Failure(AtomicCandidacyDecisionStatus.CandidacyNotFound)
        };

            Result = AtomicCandidacyDecisionResult.Failure(AtomicCandidacyDecisionStatus.OfferNotFound)

    [InlineData("Shortlist", "shortlisted")]
    [InlineData("Accept", "accepted")]
    [InlineData("Reject", "rejected")]
    public async Task Given_AtomicDecisionInvalidTransition_When_Deciding_Then_ReturnsConflictWithActionVerb(

    }

===== tests\InternHub.Tests\Unit\InternshipCandidacies\GetOfferCandidaciesHandlerTests.cs =====

using FluentAssertions;
using InternHub.Api.Domain.InternshipCandidacies;
using InternHub.Api.Domain.Offers;
using InternHub.Api.Features.InternshipCandidacies.GetOfferCandidacies;
using InternHub.Api.Features.Shared;
using InternHub.Domain.Students;
using InternHub.Tests.Unit.InternshipCandidacies.Fakes;
using InternHub.Tests.Unit.Offers.Fakes;
using InternHub.Tests.Unit.Students.Fakes;

namespace InternHub.Tests.Unit.InternshipCandidacies;

public sealed class GetOfferCandidaciesHandlerTests
{
    private static readonly DateTime Now = new(2027, 1, 15, 12, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);

    [Fact]
    public void Given_MissingOffer_When_Querying_Then_ReturnsNotFound()
    {
        // Arrange
        var offerId = Guid.NewGuid();
        var handler = new GetOfferCandidaciesHandler(
            new FakeInternshipCandidacyRepository(),
            new FakeOfferRepository(),
            new FakeStudentRepository());

        // Act
        var result = handler.Handle(new GetOfferCandidaciesQuery(offerId));

        // Assert
        result.Status.Should().Be(ResultStatus.NotFound);
        result.Error.Should().Be($"Offer {offerId} not found.");
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Given_OfferWithoutCandidacies_When_Querying_Then_ReturnsEmptyList()
    {
        // Arrange
        var offer = CreateOffer();
        var offers = new FakeOfferRepository();
        offers.Add(offer);
        var handler = new GetOfferCandidaciesHandler(
            new FakeInternshipCandidacyRepository(),
            offers,
            new FakeStudentRepository());

        // Act
        var result = handler.Handle(new GetOfferCandidaciesQuery(offer.Id));

        // Assert
        result.Status.Should().Be(ResultStatus.Success);
        result.Value.Should().BeEmpty();
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Given_CandidaciesForMultipleOffers_When_Querying_Then_ReturnsOnlyRequestedOfferWithStudentName()
    {
        // Arrange
        var offer = CreateOffer();
        var otherOffer = CreateOffer();
        var student = new Student(Guid.NewGuid(), "Test Student", "student@example.test");
        var ownCandidacy = new InternshipCandidacy(
            Guid.NewGuid(),
            student.Id,
            offer.Id,
            Now,
            InternshipCandidacyStatus.Shortlisted);
        var otherCandidacy = new InternshipCandidacy(
            Guid.NewGuid(),
            student.Id,
            otherOffer.Id,
            Now,
            InternshipCandidacyStatus.Submitted);
        var candidacies = new FakeInternshipCandidacyRepository();
        candidacies.Seed(ownCandidacy);
        candidacies.Seed(otherCandidacy);

        var offers = new FakeOfferRepository();
        offers.Add(offer);
        offers.Add(otherOffer);

        var students = new FakeStudentRepository();
        students.Add(student);

        var handler = new GetOfferCandidaciesHandler(candidacies, offers, students);

        // Act
        var result = handler.Handle(new GetOfferCandidaciesQuery(offer.Id));

        // Assert
        result.Status.Should().Be(ResultStatus.Success);
        result.Value.Should().ContainSingle()
            .Which.Should().Be(new GetOfferCandidaciesResponse(
                ownCandidacy.Id,
                student.Id,
                "Test Student",
                Now,
                InternshipCandidacyStatus.Shortlisted));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Given_CandidaciesWithDifferentAndEqualDates_When_Querying_Then_OrdersByDateDescendingThenId()
    {
        // Arrange
        var offer = CreateOffer();
        var student = new Student(Guid.NewGuid(), "Test Student", "student@example.test");
        var older = CreateCandidacy("00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001", student.Id, offer.Id, Now.AddDays(-1));
        var sameDateSecondById = CreateCandidacy("00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003", student.Id, offer.Id, Now);
        var sameDateFirstById = CreateCandidacy("00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002", student.Id, offer.Id, Now);
        var candidacies = new FakeInternshipCandidacyRepository();
        candidacies.Seed(older);
        candidacies.Seed(sameDateSecondById);
        candidacies.Seed(sameDateFirstById);

        var offers = new FakeOfferRepository();
        offers.Add(offer);

        var students = new FakeStudentRepository();
        students.Add(student);

        var handler = new GetOfferCandidaciesHandler(candidacies, offers, students);

        // Act
        var result = handler.Handle(new GetOfferCandidaciesQuery(offer.Id));

        // Assert
        result.Value.Should().NotBeNull();
        result.Value!.Select(item => item.Id).Should().Equal(
            sameDateFirstById.Id,
            sameDateSecondById.Id,
            older.Id);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Given_ExistingCandidacies_When_Querying_Then_DoesNotCallAddOrUpdate()
    {
        // Arrange
        var offer = CreateOffer();
        var student = new Student(Guid.NewGuid(), "Test Student", "student@example.test");
        var candidacy = CreateCandidacy(Guid.NewGuid().ToString(), student.Id, offer.Id, Now);
        var candidacies = new FakeInternshipCandidacyRepository();
        candidacies.Seed(candidacy);
        var before = candidacies.Candidacies.ToArray();

        var offers = new FakeOfferRepository();
        offers.Add(offer);

        var students = new FakeStudentRepository();
        students.Add(student);

        var handler = new GetOfferCandidaciesHandler(candidacies, offers, students);

        // Act
        var result = handler.Handle(new GetOfferCandidaciesQuery(offer.Id));

        // Assert
        result.Status.Should().Be(ResultStatus.Success);
        candidacies.Candidacies.Should().Equal(before);
        candidacies.AddCallCount.Should().Be(0);
        candidacies.UpdateCallCount.Should().Be(0);
        candidacy.Status.Should().Be(InternshipCandidacyStatus.Submitted);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Given_CandidacyReferencesMissingStudent_When_Querying_Then_ThrowsInvalidOperationException()
    {
        // Arrange
        var offer = CreateOffer();
        var candidacy = CreateCandidacy(Guid.NewGuid().ToString(), Guid.NewGuid(), offer.Id, Now);
        var candidacies = new FakeInternshipCandidacyRepository();
        candidacies.Seed(candidacy);
        var offers = new FakeOfferRepository();
        offers.Add(offer);
        var handler = new GetOfferCandidaciesHandler(candidacies, offers, new FakeStudentRepository());

        // Act
        var act = () => handler.Handle(new GetOfferCandidaciesQuery(offer.Id));

        // Assert
        act.Should().Throw<InvalidOperationException>()
            .WithMessage("*referenced by candidacy*was not found*");
    }

    private static Offer CreateOffer() =>
        new("Offer", "Company", ".NET", Now.AddDays(10), 1);

    private static InternshipCandidacy CreateCandidacy(
        string id,
        Guid studentId,
        Guid offerId,
        DateTime applicationDate) =>
        new(
            Guid.Parse(id),
            studentId,
            offerId,
            applicationDate,
            InternshipCandidacyStatus.Submitted);
}


===== tests\InternHub.Tests\Unit\InternshipCandidacies\GetStudentCandidaciesHandlerTests.cs =====

using FluentAssertions;
using InternHub.Api.Domain.InternshipCandidacies;
using InternHub.Api.Domain.Offers;
using InternHub.Api.Features.InternshipCandidacies.GetStudentCandidacies;
using InternHub.Api.Features.Shared;
using InternHub.Domain.Students;
using InternHub.Tests.Unit.InternshipCandidacies.Fakes;
using InternHub.Tests.Unit.Offers.Fakes;
using InternHub.Tests.Unit.Students.Fakes;

namespace InternHub.Tests.Unit.InternshipCandidacies;

public sealed class GetStudentCandidaciesHandlerTests
{
    private static readonly DateTime Now = new(2027, 1, 15, 12, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);

    [Fact]
    public void Given_ExistingStudentWithCandidacies_When_Querying_Then_ReturnsNewestFirstWithOfferDetails()
    {
        // Arrange
        var student = new Student(Guid.NewGuid(), "Test Student", "student@example.test");
        var newerOffer = CreateOffer("New Offer", "New Company");
        var olderOffer = CreateOffer("Old Offer", "Old Company");
        var older = CreateCandidacy(student.Id, olderOffer.Id, Now.AddDays(-1));
        var newer = CreateCandidacy(student.Id, newerOffer.Id, Now);
        var candidacies = new FakeInternshipCandidacyRepository();
        candidacies.Seed(older);
        candidacies.Seed(newer);

        var students = new FakeStudentRepository();
        students.Add(student);

        var offers = new FakeOfferRepository();
        offers.Add(olderOffer);
        offers.Add(newerOffer);

        var handler = new GetStudentCandidaciesHandler(candidacies, students, offers);

        // Act
        var result = handler.Handle(new GetStudentCandidaciesQuery(student.Id));

        // Assert
        result.Status.Should().Be(ResultStatus.Success);
        result.Value.Should().NotBeNull();
        result.Value.Should().HaveCount(2);
        result.Value![0].Id.Should().Be(newer.Id);
        result.Value[0].OfferTitle.Should().Be("New Offer");
        result.Value[0].CompanyName.Should().Be("New Company");
        result.Value[0].Status.Should().Be(InternshipCandidacyStatus.Submitted);
        result.Value[1].Id.Should().Be(older.Id);
        result.Value[1].OfferTitle.Should().Be("Old Offer");
        result.Value[1].CompanyName.Should().Be("Old Company");
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Given_CandidaciesForMultipleStudents_When_Querying_Then_ExcludesOtherStudents()
    {
        // Arrange
        var student = new Student(Guid.NewGuid(), "Test Student", "student@example.test");
        var otherStudent = new Student(Guid.NewGuid(), "Other Student", "other@example.test");
        var offer = CreateOffer("Offer", "Company");
        var ownCandidacy = CreateCandidacy(student.Id, offer.Id, Now);
        var otherCandidacy = CreateCandidacy(otherStudent.Id, offer.Id, Now);
        var candidacies = new FakeInternshipCandidacyRepository();
        candidacies.Seed(ownCandidacy);
        candidacies.Seed(otherCandidacy);

        var students = new FakeStudentRepository();
        students.Add(student);
        students.Add(otherStudent);

        var offers = new FakeOfferRepository();
        offers.Add(offer);

        var handler = new GetStudentCandidaciesHandler(candidacies, students, offers);

        // Act
        var result = handler.Handle(new GetStudentCandidaciesQuery(student.Id));

        // Assert
        result.Status.Should().Be(ResultStatus.Success);
        result.Value.Should().ContainSingle()
            .Which.Id.Should().Be(ownCandidacy.Id);
        result.Value.Should().NotContain(item => item.Id == otherCandidacy.Id);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Given_MissingStudent_When_Querying_Then_ReturnsNotFound()
    {
        // Arrange
        var handler = new GetStudentCandidaciesHandler(
            new FakeInternshipCandidacyRepository(),
            new FakeStudentRepository(),
            new FakeOfferRepository());

        // Act
        var result = handler.Handle(new GetStudentCandidaciesQuery(Guid.NewGuid()));

        // Assert
        result.Status.Should().Be(ResultStatus.NotFound);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Given_ExistingStudentWithoutCandidacies_When_Querying_Then_ReturnsEmptyCollection()
    {
        // Arrange
        var student = new Student(Guid.NewGuid(), "Test Student", "student@example.test");
        var students = new FakeStudentRepository();
        students.Add(student);
        var candidacies = new FakeInternshipCandidacyRepository();
        var handler = new GetStudentCandidaciesHandler(
            candidacies,
            students,
            new FakeOfferRepository());

        // Act
        var result = handler.Handle(new GetStudentCandidaciesQuery(student.Id));

        // Assert
        result.Status.Should().Be(ResultStatus.Success);
        result.Value.Should().BeEmpty();
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Given_ExistingCandidacies_When_Querying_Then_DoesNotChangeRepositoryState()
    {
        // Arrange
        var student = new Student(Guid.NewGuid(), "Test Student", "student@example.test");
        var offer = CreateOffer("Offer", "Company");
        var candidacy = CreateCandidacy(student.Id, offer.Id, Now);
        var candidacies = new FakeInternshipCandidacyRepository();
        candidacies.Seed(candidacy);
        var before = candidacies.Candidacies.ToArray();

        var students = new FakeStudentRepository();
        students.Add(student);

        var offers = new FakeOfferRepository();
        offers.Add(offer);

        var handler = new GetStudentCandidaciesHandler(candidacies, students, offers);

        // Act
        var result = handler.Handle(new GetStudentCandidaciesQuery(student.Id));

        // Assert
        result.Status.Should().Be(ResultStatus.Success);
        candidacies.Candidacies.Should().Equal(before);
        candidacies.AddCallCount.Should().Be(0);
        candidacies.UpdateCallCount.Should().Be(0);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Given_CandidaciesWithSameApplicationDate_When_Querying_Then_OrdersByIdAscending()
    {
        // Arrange
        var student = new Student(Guid.NewGuid(), "Test Student", "student@example.test");
        var firstOffer = CreateOffer("First Offer", "Company");

            Guid.Parse("00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001"),
            student.Id,
            firstOffer.Id,
            Now,
            InternshipCandidacyStatus.Submitted);
        var secondById = new InternshipCandidacy(
            Guid.Parse("00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002"),
            student.Id,
            secondOffer.Id,
            Now,
            InternshipCandidacyStatus.Submitted);
        var candidacies = new FakeInternshipCandidacyRepository();
        candidacies.Seed(secondById);
        candidacies.Seed(firstById);

        var students = new FakeStudentRepository();
        students.Add(student);

        var offers = new FakeOfferRepository();
        offers.Add(firstOffer);
        offers.Add(secondOffer);

        var handler = new GetStudentCandidaciesHandler(candidacies, students, offers);

        // Act
        var result = handler.Handle(new GetStudentCandidaciesQuery(student.Id));

        // Assert
        result.Value.Should().NotBeNull();
        result.Value!.Select(item => item.Id).Should().Equal(firstById.Id, secondById.Id);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Given_CandidacyReferencesMissingOffer_When_Querying_Then_ThrowsInvalidOperationException()
    {
        // Arrange
        var student = new Student(Guid.NewGuid(), "Test Student", "student@example.test");

        var candidacies = new FakeInternshipCandidacyRepository();
        candidacies.Seed(candidacy);
        var students = new FakeStudentRepository();

            candidacies,
            students,
            new FakeOfferRepository());

        // Act
        var act = () => handler.Handle(new GetStudentCandidaciesQuery(student.Id));

        // Assert
        act.Should().Throw<InvalidOperationException>()
            .WithMessage("*referenced by candidacy*was not found*");
    }

    private static Offer CreateOffer(string title, string companyName) =>
        new(title, companyName, ".NET", Now.AddDays(10), 1);

    public void Given_AnyDefinedStatus_When_CreatingCandidacy_Then_StatusIsPreserved(
        InternshipCandidacyStatus status)
    {
        // Arrange
        var id = Guid.NewGuid();
        var studentId = Guid.NewGuid();
        var offerId = Guid.NewGuid();
        var applicationDate = new DateTime(2027, 1, 15, 0, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);

        // Act
        var candidacy = new InternshipCandidacy(
            id,
            studentId,
            offerId,
            applicationDate,
            status);

        // Assert
        candidacy.Status.Should().Be(status);
    }

===== tests\InternHub.Tests\Unit\Offers\CvFeedback\CvFeedbackHandlerTests.cs =====

using System.Net;
using FluentAssertions;
using InternHub.Api.Domain.Offers;
using InternHub.Api.Features.Offers.CvFeedback;
using InternHub.Api.Features.RecruiterEvaluation;
using InternHub.Api.Features.Shared;

namespace InternHub.Tests.Unit.Offers.CvFeedback;

public sealed class CvFeedbackHandlerTests
{
    private static readonly DateTime Deadline =
        new(2027, 1, 15, 0, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_ValidCvAndExistingOffer_When_Analyzing_Then_ReturnsMappedFeedback()
    {
        // Arrange
        var offer = CreateOffer();
        var evaluation = new RecruiterEvaluationResult(
            ["Python", "SQL"],
            ["Docker"],
            ["Consider gaining experience with Docker."],
            "Matched 2 of 3 recognized required skills.");
        var offers = new FakeOfferRepository();
        offers.Add(offer);
        var evaluator = new FakeRecruiterEvaluationService(evaluation);
        var handler = new CvFeedbackHandler(offers, evaluator);
        const string cvText = "Experience with Python and SQL.";

        // Act
        var result = await handler.HandleAsync(
            new CvFeedbackCommand(offer.Id, cvText),
            CancellationToken.None);

        // Assert
        result.Status.Should().Be(ResultStatus.Success);
        result.Value.Should().BeEquivalentTo(new CvFeedbackResponse(
            evaluation.MatchedSkills,
            evaluation.MissingSkills,
            evaluation.Suggestions,
            evaluation.Summary));
        evaluator.CvContent.Should().Be(cvText);
        evaluator.OfferRequirements.Should().Be(offer.Requirements);
        offers.GetByIdCallCount.Should().Be(1);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_MissingOffer_When_AnalyzingCv_Then_ReturnsNotFoundWithoutCallingEvaluator()
    {
        // Arrange
        var offers = new FakeOfferRepository();
        var evaluator = new FakeRecruiterEvaluationService();
        var handler = new CvFeedbackHandler(offers, evaluator);
        var offerId = Guid.NewGuid();

        // Act
        var result = await handler.HandleAsync(
            new CvFeedbackCommand(offerId, "A valid CV."),
            CancellationToken.None);

        // Assert
        result.Status.Should().Be(ResultStatus.NotFound);
        result.Error.Should().Contain(offerId.ToString());
        evaluator.CallCount.Should().Be(0);
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData(null)]
    [InlineData("")]
    [InlineData(" \t\r\n ")]
    public async Task Given_EmptyOrWhitespaceCv_When_Analyzing_Then_ReturnsValidation(
        string? cvText)
    {
        // Arrange
        var offers = new FakeOfferRepository();
        var evaluator = new FakeRecruiterEvaluationService();
        var handler = new CvFeedbackHandler(offers, evaluator);

        // Act
        var result = await handler.HandleAsync(
            new CvFeedbackCommand(Guid.NewGuid(), cvText),
            CancellationToken.None);

        // Assert
        result.Status.Should().Be(ResultStatus.Validation);
        evaluator.CallCount.Should().Be(0);
        offers.GetByIdCallCount.Should().Be(0);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_CvExceedingMaximumLength_When_Analyzing_Then_ReturnsValidation()
    {
        // Arrange
        var offers = new FakeOfferRepository();
        var evaluator = new FakeRecruiterEvaluationService();
        var handler = new CvFeedbackHandler(offers, evaluator);
        var cvText = new string('a', CvFeedbackHandler.MaximumCvLength + 1);

        // Act
        var result = await handler.HandleAsync(
            new CvFeedbackCommand(Guid.NewGuid(), cvText),
            CancellationToken.None);

        // Assert
        result.Status.Should().Be(ResultStatus.Validation);
        result.Error.Should().Contain(CvFeedbackHandler.MaximumCvLength.ToString());
        evaluator.CallCount.Should().Be(0);
        offers.GetByIdCallCount.Should().Be(0);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_CancellationToken_When_AnalyzingCv_Then_ForwardsTokenToEvaluator()
    {
        // Arrange
        var offer = CreateOffer();
        var offers = new FakeOfferRepository();
        offers.Add(offer);
        var evaluator = new FakeRecruiterEvaluationService();
        var handler = new CvFeedbackHandler(offers, evaluator);
        using var cancellationSource = new CancellationTokenSource();
        var cancellationToken = cancellationSource.Token;

        // Act
        var result = await handler.HandleAsync(
            new CvFeedbackCommand(offer.Id, "A valid CV."),
            cancellationToken);

        // Assert
        result.Status.Should().Be(ResultStatus.Success);
        evaluator.CancellationToken.Should().Be(cancellationToken);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_HttpProviderFailure_When_AnalyzingCv_Then_ReturnsServiceUnavailable()
    {
        // Arrange
        var offer = CreateOffer();
        var offers = new FakeOfferRepository();
        offers.Add(offer);
        var evaluator = new FakeRecruiterEvaluationService
        {
            Exception = new HttpRequestException("Provider unavailable.")
        };
        var handler = new CvFeedbackHandler(offers, evaluator);

        // Act
        var result = await handler.HandleAsync(
            new CvFeedbackCommand(offer.Id, "A valid CV."),
            CancellationToken.None);

        // Assert
        result.Status.Should().Be(ResultStatus.ServiceUnavailable);
        result.Error.Should().Be("CV feedback is temporarily unavailable.");
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_InvalidProviderResponse_When_AnalyzingCv_Then_ReturnsServiceUnavailable()
    {
        // Arrange
        var offer = CreateOffer();
        var offers = new FakeOfferRepository();
        offers.Add(offer);
        var evaluator = new FakeRecruiterEvaluationService
        {
            Exception = new InvalidOperationException("Invalid provider response.")
        };
        var handler = new CvFeedbackHandler(offers, evaluator);

        // Act
        var result = await handler.HandleAsync(
            new CvFeedbackCommand(offer.Id, "A valid CV."),
            CancellationToken.None);

        // Assert
        result.Status.Should().Be(ResultStatus.ServiceUnavailable);
        result.Error.Should().Be("CV feedback is temporarily unavailable.");
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Given_ProviderTimeout_When_AnalyzingCv_Then_ReturnsServiceUnavailable()
    {
        // Arrange
        var offer = CreateOffer();
        var offers = new FakeOfferRepository();
        offers.Add(offer);
        var evaluator = new FakeRecruiterEvaluationService
        {
            Exception = new OperationCanceledException("Provider timed out.")
        };
        var handler = new CvFeedbackHandler(offers, evaluator);

        // Act
        var result = await handler.HandleAsync(
            new CvFeedbackCommand(offer.Id, "A valid CV."),
            CancellationToken.None);

        // Assert
        result.Status.Should().Be(ResultStatus.ServiceUnavailable);
        result.Error.Should().Be("CV feedback is temporarily unavailable.");
    }

    private static Offer CreateOffer() =>
        new("Backend Intern", "Example Co", "Python, SQL, Docker", Deadline, 2);

    private sealed class FakeOfferRepository : IOfferRepository
    {
        private readonly List<Offer> _offers = [];

        public int GetByIdCallCount { get; private set; }

        public bool Add(Offer offer)
        {
            _offers.Add(offer);
            return true;
        }

        public Offer? GetById(Guid id)
        {
            GetByIdCallCount++;
            return _offers.SingleOrDefault(offer => offer.Id == id);
        }

        public IReadOnlyCollection<Offer> GetAll() => _offers.ToArray();

        public bool Update(Offer offer) =>
            _offers.Any(existingOffer => existingOffer.Id == offer.Id);

        public bool Delete(Guid id)
        {
            var offer = GetById(id);
            return offer is not null && _offers.Remove(offer);
        }
    }

    private sealed class FakeRecruiterEvaluationService(
        RecruiterEvaluationResult? evaluation = null) : IRecruiterEvaluationService
    {
        public Exception? Exception { get; init; }
        public int CallCount { get; private set; }
        public string? CvContent { get; private set; }
        public string? OfferRequirements { get; private set; }
        public CancellationToken CancellationToken { get; private set; }

        public Task<RecruiterEvaluationResult> AnalyzeAsync(
            string cvContent,
            string offerRequirements,
            CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            CallCount++;
            CvContent = cvContent;
            OfferRequirements = offerRequirements;
            CancellationToken = cancellationToken;

            return Exception is null
                ? Task.FromResult(evaluation ?? new RecruiterEvaluationResult(
                    [],
                    [],
                    [],
                    "No recognized skills were found in the internship requirements."))
                : Task.FromException<RecruiterEvaluationResult>(Exception);
        }
    }
}
