===== tests\InternHub.Tests\Unit\Offers\Fakes\FakeOfferRepository.cs =====

using InternHub.Api.Domain.Offers;

namespace InternHub.Tests.Unit.Offers.Fakes;

internal sealed class FakeOfferRepository : IOfferRepository
{
    public List<Offer> Offers { get; } = [];
    public bool AddResult { get; set; } = true;
    public List<Offer> AddedOffers { get; } = [];
    public int UpdateCallCount { get; private set; }
    public int DeleteCallCount { get; private set; }
    public Exception? UpdateException { get; set; }
    public bool UpdateResult { get; set; } = true;

    public bool Add(Offer offer)
    {
        if (!AddResult)
            return false;

        AddedOffers.Add(offer);
        Offers.Add(offer);
        return true;
    }

    public Offer? GetById(Guid id) =>
        Offers.SingleOrDefault(offer => offer.Id == id);

    public IReadOnlyCollection<Offer> GetAll() =>
        Offers.ToArray();

    public bool Update(Offer offer)
    {
        UpdateCallCount++;

        if (UpdateException is not null)
            throw UpdateException;

        return UpdateResult && Offers.Any(existing => existing.Id == offer.Id);
    }

    public bool Delete(Guid id)
    {
        DeleteCallCount++;
        var offer = GetById(id);
        return offer is not null && Offers.Remove(offer);
    }
}


===== tests\InternHub.Tests\Unit\Offers\UpdateOffer\UpdateOfferHandlerTests.cs =====

using FluentAssertions;
using InternHub.Api.Domain.Offers;
using InternHub.Api.Features.Offers.UpdateOffer;
using InternHub.Api.Features.Shared;
using InternHub.Tests.Unit.Offers.Fakes;

namespace InternHub.Tests.Unit.Offers.UpdateOffer;

public sealed class UpdateOfferHandlerTests
{
    private static readonly DateTime Deadline =
        new(2027, 1, 15, 0, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);

    [Fact]
    public void Given_ExistingOfferWithCurrentVersion_When_UpdatingOffer_Then_ReturnsSuccessAndPersistsChanges()
    {
        // Arrange
        var offer = new Offer("Old title", "Old company", "Old requirements", Deadline, 1);
        var repository = new FakeOfferRepository();
        repository.Offers.Add(offer);
        var handler = new UpdateOfferHandler(repository);
        var command = new UpdateOfferCommand(
            offer.Id,
            "New title",
            "New company",
            "New requirements",
            new DateTime(2027, 2, 20, 0, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc),
            4,
            offer.Version);

        // Act
        var result = handler.Handle(command);

        // Assert
        result.Status.Should().Be(ResultStatus.Success);
        result.Value.Should().BeTrue();
        repository.UpdateCallCount.Should().Be(1);
        offer.Title.Should().Be("New title");
        offer.CompanyName.Should().Be("New company");
        offer.Requirements.Should().Be("New requirements");
        offer.MaximumAvailableSlots.Should().Be(4);
        offer.Version.Should().Be(1);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Given_InvalidOfferData_When_UpdatingOffer_Then_ReturnsValidationWithoutPersisting()
    {
        // Arrange
        var offer = new Offer("Old title", "Old company", "Old requirements", Deadline, 1);
        var repository = new FakeOfferRepository();
        repository.Offers.Add(offer);
        var handler = new UpdateOfferHandler(repository);
        var command = new UpdateOfferCommand(
            offer.Id,
            "",
            "New company",
            "New requirements",
            Deadline,
            4,
            offer.Version);

        // Act
        var result = handler.Handle(command);

        // Assert
        result.Status.Should().Be(ResultStatus.Validation);
        result.Error.Should().Contain("Title is required.");
        repository.UpdateCallCount.Should().Be(0);
        offer.Title.Should().Be("Old title");
        offer.Version.Should().Be(0);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Given_MissingOffer_When_UpdatingOffer_Then_ReturnsNotFoundWithoutPersisting()
    {
        // Arrange
        var repository = new FakeOfferRepository();
        var handler = new UpdateOfferHandler(repository);
        var offerId = Guid.NewGuid();
        var command = new UpdateOfferCommand(
            offerId,
            "New title",
            "New company",
            "New requirements",
            Deadline,
            4,
            0);

        // Act
        var result = handler.Handle(command);

        // Assert
        result.Status.Should().Be(ResultStatus.NotFound);
        result.Error.Should().Contain(offerId.ToString());
        repository.UpdateCallCount.Should().Be(0);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Given_StaleOfferVersion_When_UpdatingOffer_Then_ReturnsConflictWithoutPersisting()
    {
        // Arrange
        var offer = new Offer("Current title", "Current company", "Current requirements", Deadline, 2);
        offer.Update("Newer title", "Current company", "Current requirements", Deadline, 2);
        var repository = new FakeOfferRepository();
        repository.Offers.Add(offer);
        var handler = new UpdateOfferHandler(repository);
        var command = new UpdateOfferCommand(
            offer.Id,
            "Stale title",
            "Stale company",
            "Stale requirements",
            Deadline,
            3,
            0);

        // Act
        var result = handler.Handle(command);

        // Assert
        result.Status.Should().Be(ResultStatus.Conflict);
        result.Error.Should().Contain("stale version");
        repository.UpdateCallCount.Should().Be(0);
        offer.Title.Should().Be("Newer title");
        offer.Version.Should().Be(1);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Given_ConcurrentRepositoryUpdate_When_UpdatingOffer_Then_ReturnsConflict()
    {
        // Arrange
        var offer = new Offer("Current title", "Current company", "Current requirements", Deadline, 2);
        var repository = new FakeOfferRepository
        {
            UpdateException = new OfferConcurrencyException(offer.Id, new Exception("concurrent update"))
        };
        repository.Offers.Add(offer);
        var handler = new UpdateOfferHandler(repository);
        var command = new UpdateOfferCommand(
            offer.Id,
            "New title",
            "New company",
            "New requirements",
            Deadline,
            3,
            offer.Version);

        // Act
        var result = handler.Handle(command);

        // Assert
        result.Status.Should().Be(ResultStatus.Conflict);
        result.Error.Should().Contain("modified concurrently");
        repository.UpdateCallCount.Should().Be(1);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Given_RepositoryCannotUpdateOffer_When_UpdatingOffer_Then_ReturnsNotFound()
    {
        // Arrange
        var offer = new Offer("Current title", "Current company", "Current requirements", Deadline, 2);
        var repository = new FakeOfferRepository { UpdateResult = false };
        repository.Offers.Add(offer);
        var handler = new UpdateOfferHandler(repository);
        var command = new UpdateOfferCommand(
            offer.Id,
            "New title",
            "New company",
            "New requirements",
            Deadline,
            3,
            offer.Version);

        // Act
        var result = handler.Handle(command);

        // Assert
        result.Status.Should().Be(ResultStatus.NotFound);
        result.Error.Should().Contain(offer.Id.ToString());
        repository.UpdateCallCount.Should().Be(1);
    }
}

===== tests\InternHub.Tests\Unit\Offers\GetOffersHandlerTests.cs =====

using FluentAssertions;
using InternHub.Api.Domain.Offers;
using InternHub.Api.Features.Offers.GetOffers;
using InternHub.Api.Features.Shared;
using InternHub.Tests.Unit.Offers.Fakes;

namespace InternHub.Tests.Unit.Offers;

public sealed class GetOffersHandlerTests
{
    private static readonly DateTime CurrentUtc =
        new(2027, 1, 15, 12, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);
    private static readonly DateTime FirstDeadline =
        new(2027, 1, 15, 0, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);
    private static readonly DateTime SecondDeadline =
        new(2027, 2, 20, 0, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);

    [Fact]
    public void Given_EmptyRepository_When_GettingOffers_Then_ReturnsEmptySuccessList()
    {
        // Arrange
        var repository = new FakeOfferRepository();
        var handler = new GetOffersHandler(
            repository,
            TimeProvider.System);

        // Act
        var result = handler.Handle(new GetOffersQuery());

        // Assert
        result.Status.Should().Be(ResultStatus.Success);
        result.Value.Should().NotBeNull();
        result.Value.Should().BeEmpty();
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Given_RepositoryOffers_When_GettingOffers_Then_ReturnsAllOfferResponses()
    {
        // Arrange
        var firstOffer = new Offer("Backend Intern", "Example Co", "C#", FirstDeadline, 2);
        var secondOffer = new Offer("Data Intern", "Other Co", "SQL", SecondDeadline, 1);
        var repository = new FakeOfferRepository();
        repository.Offers.Add(firstOffer);
        repository.Offers.Add(secondOffer);
        var handler = new GetOffersHandler(
            repository,
            TimeProvider.System);

        // Act
        var result = handler.Handle(new GetOffersQuery());

        // Assert
        result.Status.Should().Be(ResultStatus.Success);
        result.Value.Should().BeEquivalentTo(
            new[]
            {
                new GetOffersResponse(firstOffer.Id, "Backend Intern", "Example Co", "C#", FirstDeadline, 2, false, 0),
                new GetOffersResponse(secondOffer.Id, "Data Intern", "Other Co", "SQL", SecondDeadline, 1, false, 0)
            },
            options => options.WithStrictOrdering());
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Given_OpenOfferWithFutureDeadline_When_GettingActiveOffers_Then_IncludesOffer()
    {
        // Arrange
        var offer = new Offer(
            "Backend Intern",
            "Example Co",
            "C#",
            CurrentUtc.AddMinutes(1),
            2);
        var repository = new FakeOfferRepository();
        repository.Offers.Add(offer);
        var handler = new GetOffersHandler(
            repository,
            new FixedTimeProvider(CurrentUtc));

        // Act
        var result = handler.Handle(new GetOffersQuery(ActiveOnly: true));

        // Assert
        result.Status.Should().Be(ResultStatus.Success);
        result.Value.Should().ContainSingle()
            .Which.Id.Should().Be(offer.Id);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Given_ClosedOfferWithFutureDeadline_When_GettingActiveOffers_Then_ExcludesOffer()
    {
        // Arrange
        var offer = new Offer(
            "Backend Intern",
            "Example Co",
            "C#",
            CurrentUtc.AddMinutes(1),
            2);
        offer.Close();
        var repository = new FakeOfferRepository();
        repository.Offers.Add(offer);
        var handler = new GetOffersHandler(
            repository,
            new FixedTimeProvider(CurrentUtc));

        // Act
        var result = handler.Handle(new GetOffersQuery(ActiveOnly: true));

        // Assert
        result.Status.Should().Be(ResultStatus.Success);
        result.Value.Should().BeEmpty();
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Given_OpenExpiredOffer_When_GettingActiveOffers_Then_ExcludesOffer()
    {
        // Arrange
        var offer = new Offer(
            "Backend Intern",
            "Example Co",
            "C#",
            CurrentUtc.AddMinutes(-1),
            2);
        var repository = new FakeOfferRepository();
        repository.Offers.Add(offer);
        var handler = new GetOffersHandler(
            repository,
            new FixedTimeProvider(CurrentUtc));

        // Act
        var result = handler.Handle(new GetOffersQuery(ActiveOnly: true));

        // Assert
        result.Status.Should().Be(ResultStatus.Success);
        result.Value.Should().BeEmpty();
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Given_OpenOfferWhoseDeadlineEqualsCurrentTime_When_GettingActiveOffers_Then_ExcludesOffer()
    {
        // Arrange
        var offer = new Offer(
            "Backend Intern",
            "Example Co",
            "C#",
            CurrentUtc,
            2);
        var repository = new FakeOfferRepository();
        repository.Offers.Add(offer);
        var handler = new GetOffersHandler(
            repository,
            new FixedTimeProvider(CurrentUtc));

        // Act
        var result = handler.Handle(new GetOffersQuery(ActiveOnly: true));

        // Assert
        result.Status.Should().Be(ResultStatus.Success);
        result.Value.Should().BeEmpty();
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Given_OpenClosedAndExpiredOffers_When_GettingAllOffers_Then_ReturnsAllOffers()
    {
        // Arrange
        var openOffer = new Offer(
            "Open Intern",
            "Example Co",
            "C#",
            CurrentUtc.AddMinutes(1),
            2);
        var closedOffer = new Offer(
            "Closed Intern",
            "Example Co",
            "SQL",
            CurrentUtc.AddMinutes(1),
            1);
        closedOffer.Close();
        var expiredOffer = new Offer(
            "Expired Intern",
            "Example Co",
            "Git",
            CurrentUtc.AddMinutes(-1),
            3);
        var repository = new FakeOfferRepository();
        repository.Offers.Add(openOffer);
        repository.Offers.Add(closedOffer);
        repository.Offers.Add(expiredOffer);
        var handler = new GetOffersHandler(
            repository,
            new FixedTimeProvider(CurrentUtc));

        // Act
        var result = handler.Handle(new GetOffersQuery(ActiveOnly: false));

        // Assert
        result.Status.Should().Be(ResultStatus.Success);
        result.Value!.Select(response => response.Id).Should().BeEquivalentTo(
            new[] { openOffer.Id, closedOffer.Id, expiredOffer.Id },
            options => options.WithoutStrictOrdering());
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Given_NoActiveOffers_When_GettingActiveOffers_Then_ReturnsEmptySuccessList()
    {
        // Arrange
        var closedOffer = new Offer(
            "Closed Intern",
            "Example Co",
            "SQL",
            CurrentUtc.AddMinutes(1),
            1);
        closedOffer.Close();
        var expiredOffer = new Offer(
            "Expired Intern",
            "Example Co",
            "Git",
            CurrentUtc.AddMinutes(-1),
            3);
        var repository = new FakeOfferRepository();
        repository.Offers.Add(closedOffer);
        repository.Offers.Add(expiredOffer);
        var handler = new GetOffersHandler(
            repository,
            new FixedTimeProvider(CurrentUtc));

        // Act
        var result = handler.Handle(new GetOffersQuery(ActiveOnly: true));

        // Assert
        result.Status.Should().Be(ResultStatus.Success);
        result.Value.Should().NotBeNull();
        result.Value.Should().BeEmpty();
    }

    private sealed class FixedTimeProvider(DateTime utcNow) : TimeProvider
    {
        public override DateTimeOffset GetUtcNow() => new(utcNow);
    }
}

using FluentAssertions;
using InternHub.Api.Domain.InternshipCandidacies;
using InternHub.Api.Domain.Offers;

namespace InternHub.Tests.Unit.Offers;

public sealed class OfferTests
{
    private static readonly DateTime Deadline =
        new(2027, 1, 15, 0, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);

    [Fact]
    public void Given_ValidOfferData_When_CreatingOffer_Then_InitializesOfferState()
    {
        // Arrange

        // Act
        var offer = new Offer("Software Engineer Intern", "Microsoft", "C#, .NET, Git", Deadline, 3);

        // Assert
        offer.Id.Should().NotBe(Guid.Empty);
        offer.Title.Should().Be("Software Engineer Intern");
        offer.CompanyName.Should().Be("Microsoft");
        offer.Requirements.Should().Be("C#, .NET, Git");
        offer.Deadline.Should().Be(Deadline);
        offer.MaximumAvailableSlots.Should().Be(3);
        offer.IsClosed.Should().BeFalse();
        offer.Version.Should().Be(0);
        offer.InternshipCandidacies.Should().BeEmpty();
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData("")]
    [InlineData(" ")]
    [InlineData(null)]
    public void Given_InvalidTitle_When_CreatingOffer_Then_ThrowsArgumentException(string? title)
    {
        // Arrange

        // Act
        var action = () => new Offer(title!, "Microsoft", "C#, .NET", Deadline, 3);

        // Assert
        action.Should().Throw<ArgumentException>().WithMessage("*Title is required.*");
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData("")]
    [InlineData(" ")]
    [InlineData(null)]
    public void Given_InvalidCompanyName_When_CreatingOffer_Then_ThrowsArgumentException(string? companyName)
    {
        // Arrange

        // Act
        var action = () => new Offer("Software Engineer Intern", companyName!, "C#, .NET", Deadline, 3);

        // Assert
        action.Should().Throw<ArgumentException>().WithMessage("*Company name is required.*");
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData("")]
    [InlineData(" ")]
    [InlineData(null)]
    public void Given_InvalidRequirements_When_CreatingOffer_Then_ThrowsArgumentException(string? requirements)
    {
        // Arrange

        // Act
        var action = () => new Offer("Software Engineer Intern", "Microsoft", requirements!, Deadline, 3);

        // Assert
        action.Should().Throw<ArgumentException>().WithMessage("*Requirements are required.*");
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Given_ValidOfferData_When_UpdatingOffer_Then_UpdatesValuesAndIncrementsVersion()
    {
        // Arrange
        var offer = new Offer("Old title", "Old company", "Old requirements", Deadline, 1);
        var updatedDeadline = new DateTime(2027, 2, 20, 0, 0, 0, DateTimeKind.Utc);

        // Act
        offer.Update("New title", "New company", "New requirements", updatedDeadline, 4);

        // Assert
        offer.Title.Should().Be("New title");
        offer.CompanyName.Should().Be("New company");
        offer.Requirements.Should().Be("New requirements");
        offer.Deadline.Should().Be(updatedDeadline);
        offer.MaximumAvailableSlots.Should().Be(4);
        offer.Version.Should().Be(1);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Given_OpenOffer_When_ClosingOffer_Then_SetsIsClosedToTrue()
    {
        // Arrange
        var offer = new Offer("Title", "Company", "Requirements", Deadline, 1);

        // Act
        offer.Close();

        // Assert
        offer.IsClosed.Should().BeTrue();
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Given_OpenOffer_When_ClosingOffer_Then_IncrementsVersionExactlyOnce()
    {
        // Arrange
        var offer = new Offer("Title", "Company", "Requirements", Deadline, 1);

        // Act
        offer.Close();

        // Assert
        offer.Version.Should().Be(1);

    {
        // Arrange

        offer.Close();
        var versionAfterClosing = offer.Version;

        // Act

        offer.Version.Should().Be(versionAfterClosing);

    [Fact]

        var id = offer.Id;
        var title = offer.Title;
        var companyName = offer.CompanyName;

        offer.Deadline.Should().Be(deadline);

        offer.InternshipCandidacies.Should().BeEquivalentTo(internshipCandidacies);
    }

    [Theory]

    {

    [Fact]

    {

        offer.CompanyName.Should().Be(companyName);
        offer.Requirements.Should().Be(requirements);
        offer.Deadline.Should().Be(deadline);
        offer.MaximumAvailableSlots.Should().Be(maximumAvailableSlots);
        offer.IsClosed.Should().BeTrue();
        offer.InternshipCandidacies.Should().BeEquivalentTo(internshipCandidacies);
    }
}

using InternHub.Api.Domain.Offers;
using InternHub.Api.Infrastructure.Repositories;

namespace InternHub.Tests.Unit.Repositories;
public class InMemoryOfferRepositoryTests
{
    private static Offer CreateOffer()
    {
        return new Offer(
            "Software Engineer Intern",
            "Microsoft",
            "C#, .NET, Git",
            DateTime.UtcNow.AddDays(30),
            3);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Add_NewOffer_ReturnsTrue()
    {
        var repository = new InMemoryOfferRepository();
        var offer = CreateOffer();

        var result = repository.Add(offer);

        Assert.True(result);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Add_DuplicateOffer_ReturnsFalse()
    {
        var repository = new InMemoryOfferRepository();
        var offer = CreateOffer();

        repository.Add(offer);

        var result = repository.Add(offer);

        Assert.False(result);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void GetById_ExistingOffer_ReturnsOffer()
    {
        var repository = new InMemoryOfferRepository();
        var offer = CreateOffer();

        repository.Add(offer);

        var result = repository.GetById(offer.Id);

        Assert.NotNull(result);
        Assert.Equal(offer.Id, result.Id);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void GetById_MissingOffer_ReturnsNull()
    {
        var repository = new InMemoryOfferRepository();

        var result = repository.GetById(Guid.NewGuid());

        Assert.Null(result);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void GetAll_ReturnsAllOffers()
    {
        var repository = new InMemoryOfferRepository();

        repository.Add(CreateOffer());
        repository.Add(CreateOffer());

        var result = repository.GetAll();

        Assert.Equal(2, result.Count);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void GetAll_ReturnsSnapshot()
    {
        var repository = new InMemoryOfferRepository();

        var firstOffer = CreateOffer();
        repository.Add(firstOffer);

        var snapshot = repository.GetAll();

        repository.Add(CreateOffer());

        Assert.Single(snapshot);
        Assert.Equal(2, repository.GetAll().Count);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Update_ExistingOffer_ReturnsTrue()
    {
        var repository = new InMemoryOfferRepository();
        var offer = CreateOffer();

        repository.Add(offer);

        offer.Update(
            "Updated Software Engineer Intern",
            "Microsoft",
            "C#, .NET, Git, Azure",
            DateTime.UtcNow.AddDays(60),
            5);

        var result = repository.Update(offer);

        Assert.True(result);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Update_MissingOffer_ReturnsFalse()
    {
        var repository = new InMemoryOfferRepository();
        var offer = CreateOffer();

        var result = repository.Update(offer);

        Assert.False(result);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Delete_ExistingOffer_ReturnsTrue()
    {
        var repository = new InMemoryOfferRepository();
        var offer = CreateOffer();

        repository.Add(offer);

        var result = repository.Delete(offer.Id);

        Assert.True(result);
        Assert.Null(repository.GetById(offer.Id));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Delete_MissingOffer_ReturnsFalse()
    {
        var repository = new InMemoryOfferRepository();

        var result = repository.Delete(Guid.NewGuid());

        Assert.False(result);
    }
}

using InternHub.Domain.Students;
using InternHub.Infrastructure.Repositories;

namespace InternHub.Tests.Unit.Students;

public class InMemoryStudentRepositoryTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void Add_DuplicateId_ReturnsFalse()
    {
        var repository = new InMemoryStudentRepository();
        var id = Guid.NewGuid();

        Assert.True(
            repository.Add(
                new Student(
                    id,
                    "Ana",
                    "a@b.com")));

        Assert.False(
            repository.Add(
                new Student(
                    id,
                    "Alt Nume",
                    "x@y.com")));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void GetById_Existing_ReturnsStudent()
    {
        var repository = new InMemoryStudentRepository();

        var student = new Student(
            Guid.NewGuid(),
            "Ana",
            "a@b.com");

        repository.Add(student);

        var result = repository.GetById(student.Id);

        Assert.Same(student, result);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void GetById_Missing_ReturnsNull()
    {
        var repository = new InMemoryStudentRepository();

        var result =
            repository.GetById(Guid.NewGuid());

        Assert.Null(result);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void GetAll_ReturnsSnapshot()
    {
        var repository = new InMemoryStudentRepository();

        repository.Add(
            new Student(
                Guid.NewGuid(),
                "Ana",
                "a@b.com"));

        var snapshot = repository.GetAll();

        repository.Add(
            new Student(
                Guid.NewGuid(),
                "Ion",
                "i@b.com"));

        Assert.Single(snapshot);
        Assert.Equal(2, repository.GetAll().Count);
    }
    
    [Fact]
    public void Add_NewStudent_ReturnsTrue()
    {
        var repository = new InMemoryStudentRepository();

        var student = new Student(
            Guid.NewGuid(),
            "Ana Pop",
            "ana@mail.com");

        var result = repository.Add(student);

        Assert.True(result);
    }
    
    [Fact]
    public void GetAll_ReturnsAllStudents()
    {
        var repository = new InMemoryStudentRepository();

        var firstStudent = new Student(
            Guid.NewGuid(),
            "Ana Pop",
            "ana@mail.com");

        var secondStudent = new Student(
            Guid.NewGuid(),
            "Ion Popescu",
            "ion@mail.com");

        repository.Add(firstStudent);
        repository.Add(secondStudent);

        var result = repository.GetAll();

        Assert.Equal(2, result.Count);
        Assert.Contains(result, student => student.Id == firstStudent.Id);
        Assert.Contains(result, student => student.Id == secondStudent.Id);
    }
    
    [Fact]
    public void Update_ExistingStudent_ReturnsTrueAndUpdatesStudent()
    {
        var repository = new InMemoryStudentRepository();
        var id = Guid.NewGuid();

        var student = new Student(
            id,
            "Ana Pop",
            "ana@mail.com");

        repository.Add(student);

        var updatedStudent = new Student(
            id,
            "Ana Popescu",
            "ana.popescu@mail.com");

        var result = repository.Update(updatedStudent);

        Assert.True(result);

        var storedStudent = repository.GetById(id);

        Assert.NotNull(storedStudent);
        Assert.Equal("Ana Popescu", storedStudent.FullName);
        Assert.Equal("ana.popescu@mail.com", storedStudent.Email);
    }
    
    [Fact]
    public void Update_MissingStudent_ReturnsFalse()
    {
        var repository = new InMemoryStudentRepository();

        var student = new Student(
            Guid.NewGuid(),
            "Ana Pop",
            "ana@mail.com");

        var result = repository.Update(student);

        Assert.False(result);
    }
    
    [Fact]
    public void Delete_ExistingStudent_ReturnsTrueAndRemovesStudent()
    {
        var repository = new InMemoryStudentRepository();

        var student = new Student(
            Guid.NewGuid(),
            "Ana Pop",
            "ana@mail.com");

        repository.Add(student);

        var result = repository.Delete(student.Id);

        Assert.True(result);
        Assert.Null(repository.GetById(student.Id));
    }
    
    [Fact]
    public void Delete_MissingStudent_ReturnsFalse()
    {
        var repository = new InMemoryStudentRepository();

        var result = repository.Delete(Guid.NewGuid());

        Assert.False(result);
    }
}

===== tests\InternHub.Tests\Unit\Students\Fakes\FakeStudentRepository.cs =====

using InternHub.Domain.Students;

namespace InternHub.Tests.Unit.Students.Fakes;

internal sealed class FakeStudentRepository : IStudentRepository
{
    private readonly Dictionary<Guid, Student> _students = new();

    public bool AddResult { get; set; } = true;
    public bool UpdateResult { get; set; } = true;

    public bool Add(Student student) =>
        AddResult && _students.TryAdd(student.Id, student);

    public Student? GetById(Guid id) =>
        _students.TryGetValue(id, out var student) ? student : null;

    public IReadOnlyList<Student> GetAll() => _students.Values.ToList();

    public bool Update(Student student)
    {
        if (!UpdateResult)
            return false;

        if (!_students.ContainsKey(student.Id))
            return false;

        _students[student.Id] = student;
        return true;
    }

    public bool Delete(Guid id) => _students.Remove(id);
}

using FluentAssertions;
using InternHub.Api.Features.Shared;
using InternHub.Api.Features.Students.CreateStudent;
using InternHub.Tests.Unit.Students.Fakes;

namespace InternHub.Tests.Unit.Students;

public sealed class CreateStudentHandlerTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void Given_ValidCommand_When_CreatingStudent_Then_ReturnsSuccessAndPersistsStudent()
    {
        // Arrange
        var repository = new FakeStudentRepository();
        var handler = new CreateStudentHandler(repository);
        var command = new CreateStudentCommand("  Ana Pop  ", " ANA@MAIL.COM ");

        // Act
        var result = handler.Handle(command);

        // Assert
        result.Status.Should().Be(ResultStatus.Success);
        result.Value.Should().NotBeNull();
        result.Value!.Id.Should().NotBe(Guid.Empty);
        result.Value.FullName.Should().Be("Ana Pop");
        result.Value.Email.Should().Be("ana@mail.com");
        repository.GetById(result.Value.Id).Should().NotBeNull();
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Given_InvalidCommand_When_CreatingStudent_Then_ReturnsValidationWithoutPersistingStudent()
    {
        // Arrange
        var repository = new FakeStudentRepository();
        var handler = new CreateStudentHandler(repository);
        var command = new CreateStudentCommand(null, "ana@mail.com");

        // Act
        var result = handler.Handle(command);

        // Assert
        result.Status.Should().Be(ResultStatus.Validation);
        result.Error.Should().Contain("Full name is required.");
        result.Value.Should().BeNull();
        repository.GetAll().Should().BeEmpty();
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Given_RepositoryConflict_When_CreatingStudent_Then_ReturnsConflictWithoutValue()
    {
        // Arrange
        var repository = new FakeStudentRepository { AddResult = false };
        var handler = new CreateStudentHandler(repository);
        var command = new CreateStudentCommand("Ana Pop", "ana@mail.com");

        // Act
        var result = handler.Handle(command);

        // Assert
        result.Status.Should().Be(ResultStatus.Conflict);
        result.Error.Should().Contain("already exists");
        result.Value.Should().BeNull();
        repository.GetAll().Should().BeEmpty();
    }
}

using FluentAssertions;
using InternHub.Api.Features.Shared;
using InternHub.Api.Features.Students.GetStudents;
using InternHub.Domain.Students;
using InternHub.Tests.Unit.Students.Fakes;
using InternHub.Features.Students.GetStudents;

namespace InternHub.Tests.Unit.Students;

public sealed class GetStudentsHandlerTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void Given_EmptyRepository_When_GettingStudents_Then_ReturnsEmptySuccessList()
    {
        // Arrange
        var repository = new FakeStudentRepository();
        var handler = new GetStudentsHandler(repository);

        // Act
        var result = handler.Handle(new GetStudentsQuery());

        // Assert
        result.Status.Should().Be(ResultStatus.Success);
        result.Value.Should().NotBeNull();
        result.Value.Should().BeEmpty();
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Given_RepositoryStudents_When_GettingStudents_Then_ReturnsAllStudentResponses()
    {
        // Arrange
        var firstStudent = new Student(Guid.NewGuid(), "Ana Pop", "ana@mail.com");
        var secondStudent = new Student(Guid.NewGuid(), "Ion Pop", "ion@mail.com");
        var repository = new FakeStudentRepository();
        repository.Add(firstStudent);
        repository.Add(secondStudent);
        var handler = new GetStudentsHandler(repository);

        // Act
        var result = handler.Handle(new GetStudentsQuery());

        // Assert
        result.Status.Should().Be(ResultStatus.Success);
        result.Value.Should().BeEquivalentTo(
            new[]
            {
                new GetStudentsResponse(firstStudent.Id, "Ana Pop", "ana@mail.com"),
                new GetStudentsResponse(secondStudent.Id, "Ion Pop", "ion@mail.com")
            },
            options => options.WithoutStrictOrdering());
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Given_RepositoryStudents_When_GettingStudents_Then_DoesNotMutateRepository()
    {
        // Arrange
        var firstStudent = new Student(Guid.NewGuid(), "Ana Pop", "ana@mail.com");
        var secondStudent = new Student(Guid.NewGuid(), "Ion Pop", "ion@mail.com");
        var repository = new FakeStudentRepository();
        repository.Add(firstStudent);
        repository.Add(secondStudent);
        var handler = new GetStudentsHandler(repository);

        // Act
        handler.Handle(new GetStudentsQuery());

        // Assert
        repository.GetAll().Should().HaveCount(2);
        repository.GetById(firstStudent.Id).Should().BeSameAs(firstStudent);
        repository.GetById(secondStudent.Id).Should().BeSameAs(secondStudent);
    }
}


===== tests\InternHub.Tests\Unit\Students\StudentTest.cs =====

using InternHub.Domain.Students;
using Xunit;
using InternHub.Api.Domain.InternshipCandidacies;
using FluentAssertions;

namespace InternHub.Tests.Unit.Students;

public class StudentTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void Constructor_ValidData_CreatesStudent()
    {
        var student = new Student(
            Guid.NewGuid(),
            "  Ana Pop ",
            "ANA@mail.com");

        Assert.Equal("Ana Pop", student.FullName);
        Assert.Equal("ana@mail.com", student.Email);
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData("", "a@b.com")]
    [InlineData("Ana", "")]
    [InlineData("Ana", "not-an-email")]
    public void Constructor_InvalidData_Throws(string name, string email)
    {
        Assert.Throws<ArgumentException>(() =>
            new Student(
                Guid.NewGuid(),
                name,
                email));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Constructor_EmptyId_Throws()
    {
        Assert.Throws<ArgumentException>(() =>
            new Student(
                Guid.Empty,
                "Ana",
                "a@b.com"));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Update_ValidData_ChangesStudentDetails()
    {
        var student = new Student(
            Guid.NewGuid(),
            "Ana Pop",
            "ana@mail.com");

        student.Update(
            "Ion Pop",
            "ion@mail.com");

        Assert.Equal("Ion Pop", student.FullName);
        Assert.Equal("ion@mail.com", student.Email);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Update_InvalidData_DoesNotPartiallyChangeStudent()
    {
        var student = new Student(
            Guid.NewGuid(),
            "Ana Pop",
            "ana@mail.com");

        Assert.Throws<ArgumentException>(() =>
            student.Update(
                "",
                "updated@mail.com"));

        Assert.Equal("Ana Pop", student.FullName);
        Assert.Equal("ana@mail.com", student.Email);
    }
    
    [Fact]
    public void InternshipCandidacies_InitiallyIsEmpty()
    {
        var student = new Student(
            Guid.NewGuid(),
            "Ana Pop",
            "ana@mail.com");

        Assert.Empty(student.InternshipCandidacies);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void InternshipCandidacies_IsReadOnly()
    {
        var student = new Student(
            Guid.NewGuid(),
            "Ana Pop",
            "ana@mail.com");

        var collection =
            Assert.IsAssignableFrom<ICollection<InternshipCandidacy>>(
                student.InternshipCandidacies);

        Assert.True(collection.IsReadOnly);
    }
    
    [Fact]
    public void Update_WithInvalidEmail_DoesNotPartiallyChangeStudent()
    {
        var student = new Student(
            Guid.NewGuid(),
            "Ana Pop",
            "ana@mail.com");

        Assert.Throws<ArgumentException>(() =>
            student.Update(
                "Ana Popescu",
                "invalid-email"));

        Assert.Equal("Ana Pop", student.FullName);
        Assert.Equal("ana@mail.com", student.Email);
    }

	[Fact]
public void Given_FullNameLongerThan200Characters_When_CreatingStudent_Then_ThrowsArgumentException()
{
    // Arrange
    var fullName = new string('A', 201);

    // Act
    Action act = () => new Student(
        Guid.NewGuid(),
        fullName,
        "ana@mail.com");

    // Assert
    act.Should()
        .Throw<ArgumentException>()
        .WithMessage("*Full name must be at most 200 characters.*");
}
}

===== tests\InternHub.Tests\Unit\Students\UpdateStudentHandlerTests.cs =====

using FluentAssertions;
using InternHub.Api.Features.Shared;
using InternHub.Api.Features.Students.UpdateStudent;
using InternHub.Domain.Students;
using InternHub.Tests.Unit.Students.Fakes;

namespace InternHub.Tests.Unit.Students;

public sealed class UpdateStudentHandlerTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void Given_ExistingStudentWithValidData_When_UpdatingStudent_Then_ReturnsSuccess()
    {
        // Arrange
        var student = new Student(Guid.NewGuid(), "Ana Pop", "ana@mail.com");
        var repository = new FakeStudentRepository();
        repository.Add(student);
        var handler = new UpdateStudentHandler(repository);

        // Act
        var result = handler.Handle(
            new UpdateStudentCommand(student.Id, "Ana Popescu", "ana.popescu@mail.com"));

        // Assert
        result.Status.Should().Be(ResultStatus.Success);
        result.Value.Should().BeTrue();
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Given_ExistingStudentWithInvalidData_When_UpdatingStudent_Then_ReturnsValidation()
    {
        // Arrange
        var student = new Student(Guid.NewGuid(), "Ana Pop", "ana@mail.com");
        var repository = new FakeStudentRepository();
        repository.Add(student);
        var handler = new UpdateStudentHandler(repository);

        // Act
        var result = handler.Handle(
            new UpdateStudentCommand(student.Id, "", "updated@mail.com"));

        // Assert
        result.Status.Should().Be(ResultStatus.Validation);
        result.Error.Should().Contain("Full name is required.");
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Given_MissingStudent_When_UpdatingStudent_Then_ReturnsNotFound()
    {
        // Arrange
        var repository = new FakeStudentRepository();
        var handler = new UpdateStudentHandler(repository);
        var missingId = Guid.NewGuid();

        // Act
        var result = handler.Handle(
            new UpdateStudentCommand(missingId, "Ana Pop", "ana@mail.com"));

        // Assert
        result.Status.Should().Be(ResultStatus.NotFound);
        result.Error.Should().Be($"Student {missingId} not found.");
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Given_ExistingStudent_When_UpdatingWithValidData_Then_PersistsExpectedChanges()
    {
        // Arrange
        var student = new Student(Guid.NewGuid(), "Ana Pop", "ana@mail.com");
        var repository = new FakeStudentRepository();
        repository.Add(student);
        var handler = new UpdateStudentHandler(repository);

        // Act
        handler.Handle(
            new UpdateStudentCommand(student.Id, "Ana Popescu", "updated@mail.com"));

        // Assert
        var updatedStudent = repository.GetById(student.Id);
        updatedStudent.Should().NotBeNull();
        updatedStudent!.FullName.Should().Be("Ana Popescu");
        updatedStudent.Email.Should().Be("updated@mail.com");
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Given_RepositoryConflict_When_UpdatingStudent_Then_ReturnsConflict()
    {
        // Arrange
        var student = new Student(Guid.NewGuid(), "Ana Pop", "ana@mail.com");
        var repository = new FakeStudentRepository { UpdateResult = false };
        repository.Add(student);
        var handler = new UpdateStudentHandler(repository);

        // Act
        var result = handler.Handle(
            new UpdateStudentCommand(student.Id, "Ana Popescu", "updated@mail.com"));

        // Assert
        result.Status.Should().Be(ResultStatus.Conflict);
        result.Error.Should().Contain("already exists");
    }
}

===== README.md =====

# InternHub

InternHub is a platform for managing internship offers and student internship candidacies. Students can discover internship opportunities, apply to offers, track and withdraw internship candidacies when permitted, and request AI-assisted feedback about how well their CV matches an internship offer. Recruiters can publish and close offers, evaluate internship candidacies, and optionally use AI-assisted CV analysis to support that evaluation.

The AI component is advisory only. It provides CV feedback to students and can also help recruiters evaluate internship candidacies by comparing a candidate's CV with the selected offer requirements. It highlights matched skills, missing or unclear skills, supporting evidence, and a concise summary. The AI does not make the final recruitment decision, automatically accept or reject candidates, or replace recruiter judgment.



## 1. Repository Information

- **Repository name:** `InternHub`
- **Development model:** Scrum
- **Sprint duration:** 1 week
- **Team size:** 4 people - Roberta, Carina, Daria, Ariana
- **Architecture approach:** vertical slices

### Recommended GitHub workflow

1. Keep `main` stable.
2. Create a branch for each feature or technical task.
3. Open a Pull Request before merging.
4. Run automated tests before merge.
5. Require at least one team review for non-trivial changes.
6. Merge only when the applicable Definition of Done criteria are satisfied.

Example branch names:

```text
feature/student-profile
feature/publish-offer
feature/apply-offer
feature/cv-feedback
feature/recruiter-ai-review
feature/decide-internship-candidacy
fix/internship-candidacy-deadline-validation
```
### Running the Project

#### Prerequisites

- .NET SDK 10

#### Build

From the repository root:

```bash
dotnet build
```

#### Run the API

```bash
dotnet run --project ./src/InternHub.Api/InternHub.Api.csproj
```

The API address will be displayed in the terminal after the application starts.

The current implementation uses in-memory repositories, so stored Students and Offers are reset when the application is restarted.

#### Run Tests

```bash
dotnet test ./tests/InternHub.Tests/InternHub.Tests.csproj
```

#### Run Tests with Coverage

```bash
dotnet test ./tests/InternHub.Tests/InternHub.Tests.csproj --collect:"XPlat Code Coverage" --results-directory ./TestResults
```

This creates a `coverage.cobertura.xml` report under a generated `TestResults/<GUID>/` folder. The same command is used in CI and the coverage file is uploaded as a workflow artifact.

## 2. Project Goals

InternHub aims to:

- provide students with access to active internship offers;
- allow students to create and manage internship internship candidacies;
- allow recruiters to publish and close internship offers;
- allow recruiters to accept or reject candidates;
- allow recruiters to request AI-assisted analysis of candidate CVs against offer requirements;
- enforce internship candidacy limits, deadlines, slot limits, and other business rules;
- safely handle concurrent decisions for the final available internship slot;
- provide local AI-assisted CV feedback for students;
- provide local AI-assisted internship candidacy review for recruiters;
- keep final recruitment decisions under recruiter control;
- keep CV content private and outside the application database and logs.



## 3. Main Actors

### Student

A student can:

- create a student profile;
- browse active internship offers;
- view offer details;
- apply to an internship offer;
- view submitted internship candidacies;
- withdraw an internship candidacy when the current state allows it;
- request AI-assisted CV feedback for a selected offer.

### Recruiter

A recruiter can:

- publish internship offers;
- define requirements, deadline, and maximum available slots;
- evaluate internship candidacies;
- request AI-assisted analysis for a selected internship candidacy;
- review matched skills, missing or unclear skills, supporting evidence, and an AI-generated summary;
- accept or reject candidates based on their own evaluation;
- manually close an internship offer.

### Local AI Service

InternHub uses a local Ollama-based AI service for CV analysis. The same AI capability supports two user-facing scenarios:

1. student CV feedback before or during the internship candidacy process;
2. recruiter-assisted internship candidacy review.

Input:

```text
CV text
+
Selected offer requirements
```

Student-facing output:

```json
{
  "matchedSkills": [],
  "missingSkills": [],
  "suggestions": []
}
```

Recruiter-facing output:

```json
{
  "matchedSkills": [],
  "missingOrUnclearSkills": [],
  "evidence": [],
  "summary": ""
}
```

For recruiters, the AI analysis is requested on demand for a selected internship candidacy. It helps the recruiter identify how the CV relates to the offer requirements, but it does not change the internship candidacy status automatically.

The final decision always belongs to the recruiter. Only an explicit recruiter action can accept or reject a candidate.

## 5. Team Organization

The project is developed by **4 team members**. The team uses vertical slices, so nobody is assigned permanently only to frontend, backend, database, AI, or testing.

Each team member is responsible for implementing complete features end-to-end, including the applicable parts of:

- frontend;
- backend / application logic;
- REST APIs;
- persistence;
- business rules;
- validation;
- AI-related work;
- unit tests;
- integration tests;
- integration with other slices;
- documentation.

### Person 1 - Student Profile + Offer Discovery

**Main backlog items**

- PB-01 - Create Student Profile
- PB-03 - Browse Active Offers
- PB-04 - View Offer Details

**Main responsibilities**

- Student Profile UI and backend flow;
- browse active offers;
- view offer details;
- Student persistence;
- student-side integration of CV feedback;
- display `matchedSkills`, `missingSkills`, and `suggestions`;
- ensure CV feedback is independent from internship candidacy submission;
- tests for Student and Offer discovery flows.

**AI responsibility**

Student-facing CV Feedback integration.

**Coordination responsibility**

Shared API contracts and DTO consistency.



### Person 2 - Internship Candidacy Lifecycle

**Main backlog items**

- PB-05 - Apply to an Offer
- PB-06 - Withdraw Internship Candidacy
- PB-08 - View My Internship Candidacies

**Main responsibilities**

- Submit Internship Candidacy;
- View My Internship Candidacies;
- Withdraw Internship Candidacy;
- InternshipCandidacy persistence;
- deadline validation;
- duplicate internship candidacy prevention;
- maximum active-internship-candidacy limit;
- closed-offer validation;
- allowed withdrawal states;
- recruiter notification for a withdrawn `Shortlisted` internship candidacy;
- success/failure handling using `Result<T>`;
- unit and integration tests for internship candidacy rules.

**AI responsibility**

Deterministic Fake `ICvFeedbackProvider` used by automated tests for both student-facing CV feedback and recruiter-facing internship candidacy review.

**Coordination responsibility**

Database migrations and data-integrity conventions.


### Person 3 - Internship Offer Management

**Main backlog items**

**Main responsibilities**

- recruiter UI for publishing offers;
- recruiter UI/action for closing offers;
- Offer API;
- Offer persistence;
- shared Offer contract;
- `IsClosed` handling;
- `Version` configuration for optimistic concurrency;
- integration with Student, InternshipCandidacy, recruiter-decision, and AI flows.

The shared Offer data includes:

```text
Id
Title
CompanyName
Requirements
Deadline
MaximumAvailableSlots
IsClosed
Version
```

**AI responsibility**

Local Ollama provider integration:

- send CV text and Offer requirements to the local model;
- support both student-facing feedback and recruiter-facing internship candidacy analysis;
- validate the structured AI output required by each use case;
- handle invalid responses;
- return a clear failure when the AI service is unavailable;
- ensure the rest of InternHub remains operational when AI fails.

**Coordination responsibility**

Docker / CI / reproducible local development environment.



### Person 4 - Internship Candidacy Evaluation + Slot Management

**Main backlog items**

- PB-07 - Decide Internship Candidacy
- PB-11 - AI-Assisted Internship Candidacy Review

**Main responsibilities**

- recruiter internship-candidacy-evaluation UI;
- on-demand AI analysis action for a selected internship candidacy;
- display recruiter-facing AI results: matched skills, missing or unclear skills, evidence, and summary;
- keep AI analysis separate from the final recruiter decision;
- Accept / Reject actions;
- `Accepted`, `Rejected`, and `Waitlisted` outcomes;
- available-slot enforcement;
- optimistic concurrency;
- simultaneous decisions for the final available slot;
- InternshipCandidacy status updates;
- concurrency and integration testing.

The system must guarantee that the configured slot limit is never exceeded.

When two decisions compete for the final available slot:

```text
Request A ----\
               >---- Offer Version / optimistic concurrency
Request B ----/                   |
                                    +--> one Accepted
                                    +--> one Waitlisted
```

**AI / ML responsibility**

Recruiter-facing AI review and AI model evaluation:

- integrate AI analysis into the recruiter internship-candidacy-review flow;
- prepare synthetic CV-offer test pairs;
- manually label expected skills;
- compare multiple models;
- measure structured-output validity;
- compare AI output with manual labels;
- verify that AI results remain advisory;
- document evaluation results.

**Coordination responsibility**

Testing strategy, security, and quality conventions.



## 6. Collaboration Model

The team follows the rule:

> **Contract first, implementation independently, integration afterwards.**

When two slices depend on the same entity or API:

1. agree on the shared contract;
2. define request/response DTOs;
3. use seeded data, Fake providers, or in-memory implementations where necessary;
4. implement the slices independently;
5. replace temporary implementations with the real dependency;
6. run integration tests before merge.

## 8. Internship Candidacy Flow

A simplified student internship candidacy flow is:

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A["Student selects offer"] --> B{"Offer active?"}
    B -- No --> X["Failure Result"]
    B -- Yes --> C{"Deadline passed?"}
    C -- Yes --> X
    C -- No --> D{"Duplicate active internship candidacy?"}
    D -- Yes --> X
    D -- No --> E{"Active internship candidacy limit reached?"}
    E -- Yes --> X
    E -- No --> F["Create InternshipCandidacy"]
    F --> G["Status = Submitted"]
```

All business rules are enforced in the backend, not only in the frontend.



## 9. Recruiter AI Review, Decision and Concurrency Flow

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A["Recruiter selects internship candidacy"] --> B{"Use AI assistance?"}
    B -->|Yes| C["Analyze CV against offer requirements"]
    C --> D["Show matched skills, missing or unclear skills, evidence, and summary"]
    D --> E{"Recruiter decision"}
    B -->|No| E
    E -->|Reject| F["Status = Rejected"]
    E -->|Accept| G{"Slot available?"}
    G -->|No| H["Status = Waitlisted"]
    G -->|Yes| I["Try optimistic-concurrency update"]
    I -->|Success| J["Status = Accepted"]
    I -->|Version conflict / slot consumed| H
```

AI assistance is optional and never changes an internship candidacy status by itself. The recruiter remains responsible for the final decision.

The Offer `Version` property protects the final available slot from concurrent acceptance.

## 12. Definition of Done

A user story is considered **Done** only when all applicable criteria are satisfied.

### Functionality

- all acceptance criteria are implemented and verified;
- relevant business rules are enforced;
- input validation and error handling are implemented;
- expected outcomes use success/failure `Result<T>`;
- existing functionality is not broken.

### Code and architecture

- code follows the agreed vertical-slice structure;
- business rules are not implemented only in the UI;
- external dependencies are accessed through abstractions where applicable;
- shared contracts remain consistent.

### Testing

- relevant unit tests exist;
- persistence interactions have integration tests where applicable;
- both success and failure scenarios are tested;
- time-dependent logic is deterministic;
- concurrency behavior is tested where applicable;
- all automated tests pass.

### AI and privacy

- AI feedback remains advisory for both students and recruiters;
- recruiter-facing AI analysis compares the candidate CV with the selected offer requirements;
- recruiter-facing output exposes matched skills, missing or unclear skills, evidence, and a concise summary;
- AI never accepts, rejects, waitlists, or otherwise changes an internship candidacy status automatically;
- final recruitment decisions require an explicit recruiter action;
- automated tests do not depend on live Ollama;
- raw CV text is not stored in the application database;
- raw CV text is not written to logs or error messages;
- AI-service failure does not break standard application functionality.

### Delivery

- endpoints and request/response formats are documented;
- the application builds successfully;
- changes are reviewed before merge.



## 13. Open Requirements

The team must **not hard-code assumptions** for requirements that are still unclear.

The following points require clarification:

- how recruiters are represented and authenticated;
- which internship candidacy statuses count as active;
- how the waiting list is ordered;
- whether an `Accepted` candidate may withdraw and free a slot;
- whether a closed offer can be reopened;
- the exact expected behavior when local Ollama is unavailable.

These decisions will be updated in the requirements, backlog, tests, and README once clarified.

### Minor Issue Remediation (`Undefined InternshipCandidacyStatus` â€” P2.1)

- **Root cause:** The public `InternshipCandidacy` constructor accepted any castable `InternshipCandidacyStatus` value without verifying that it was a defined enum member, allowing invalid domain state.
- **Remediation:** Added validation in `src/InternHub.Api/Domain/InternshipCandidacies/InternshipCandidacy.cs` (`!Enum.IsDefined(status)`) throwing `ArgumentOutOfRangeException` for the `status` parameter (`nameof(status)`), and aligned the CQRS domain skill specification in `.claude/skills/cqrs/SKILL.md`.
- **Remediation commit:** `c0ff0e9` (`c0ff0e9f8a229bd92a74b44d2619a5ac3df74683` â€” *fix internship candidacy status*).
- **Testing & regression:**
  - Added unit tests in `tests/InternHub.Tests/Unit/InternshipCandidacies/InternshipCandidacyTests.cs` verifying that all 6 valid `InternshipCandidacyStatus` values (`Submitted`, `Shortlisted`, `Accepted`, `Rejected`, `Waitlisted`, `Withdrawn`) are accepted and that undefined cast values `(InternshipCandidacyStatus)999` and `(InternshipCandidacyStatus)(-1)` throw `ArgumentOutOfRangeException` with `ParamName == "status"`.
  - Existing regression tests continue to pass without modification.
  - Confirmed by live Sprint 4 test execution (`dotnet test`): **349/349** tests passed (0 failures, 0 skips), preserving the historical Sprint 3 baseline of **314/314** tests above.
- **Read-only `code-review` verification:** A read-only verification following `.claude/skills/code-review/SKILL.md` was executed across `InternshipCandidacy`, `InternshipCandidacyTests`, handlers, and EF Core/SQLite persistence contracts, confirming that the Minor `InternshipCandidacyStatus` domain-invariant finding is resolved (0 remaining findings in P2.1 scope) while the three Major concurrency findings remain `Pending` with no verifiable remediation in persistence or handlers yet.

### Major Issue Remediation (`Accepted slots concurrency` â€” P4.1)

- **Root cause:** `DecideInternshipCandidacyHandler` counted `Accepted` candidacies (`CountAcceptedForOffer`) and saved the decision (`Update`) in separate repository operations, each with its own `SaveChanges` (check-then-act / write skew). Concurrent accept decisions on the last slot could both observe a free slot and persist `Accepted`, exceeding `MaximumAvailableSlots` (US5 AC3, BR-09, BR-10).
- **Remediation:**
  - Added the atomic persistence contract `IAtomicCandidacyDecision.DecideAsync(candidacyId, decision, cancellationToken)` and the typed `AtomicCandidacyDecisionResult` (`Decided`, `CandidacyNotFound`, `OfferNotFound`, `InvalidTransition`, `ConcurrencyConflict`) in `src/InternHub.Api/Features/InternshipCandidacies/AtomicDecision/`.
  - `DecideInternshipCandidacyHandler` now depends only on `IAtomicCandidacyDecision` and exposes `HandleAsync`. It validates the action before calling the contract and maps each status to exactly one `Result` through a lookup table (`Decided` â†’ 200, `CandidacyNotFound` / `OfferNotFound` â†’ 404, `InvalidTransition` / `ConcurrencyConflict` â†’ 409).
  - `EfCoreAtomicCandidacyDecision` (`src/InternHub.Api/Infrastructure/Persistence/AtomicDecision/`) runs each attempt in one transaction. It loads the candidacy; for `Accept` it loads the offer, re-counts `Accepted` candidacies inside the transaction and calls `Accept(acceptedCount < MaximumAvailableSlots)` (â†’ `Accepted` or `Waitlisted`); it then performs a single `SaveChangesAsync` + `CommitAsync`. It clears the change tracker and retries up to 3 attempts on `DbUpdateConcurrencyException` and SQLite busy/locked (codes 5/6); after the last attempt it returns `ConcurrencyConflict` (HTTP 409). `IsClosed` and `Deadline` are not checked (BR-11).
  - Added `Offer.RegisterAcceptedSlot()` in `src/InternHub.Api/Domain/Offers/Offer.cs`, which increments the `Version` concurrency token. It is called only when the candidacy becomes `Accepted`, in the same `SaveChanges`, so concurrent slot-consuming accepts collide on the same `Offers` row.
  - Registered `IAtomicCandidacyDecision` â†’ `EfCoreAtomicCandidacyDecision` as Scoped in `PersistenceExtensions.AddPersistence`.
  - Updated `.claude/skills/cqrs/SKILL.md` Â§13, `.claude/skills/efcore-sqlite-repositories/SKILL.md` Â§11/Â§20/Â§21 and `.claude/skills/integration-testing/SKILL.md` Â§4b/Â§6b; `.claude/skills/unit-testing/SKILL.md` was not changed.
  - The HTTP contract is unchanged: route `POST /api/v1/candidacies/{id}/decision`, `DecideInternshipCandidacyRequest`, `DecideInternshipCandidacyResponse` and status codes 200/400/404/409. Only two error texts changed: `Candidacy {id} cannot be {verb} from its current status.` and `Offer of candidacy {id} not found.`
